jobs.title: Technology Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Organization**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward, to progress, make the right financial decisions, and achieve their dreams, targets and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organization, your initiative, talent, ideas and energy contribute to the impact we can make. Together, we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Our purpose**
: Building a brighter future for all.
  
  
**Business & Team**
As we continue our pursuit of NPS +30, we need to transform how we engage with customers and colleagues. This requires moving from a two-track digital versus assisted approach to a deeply personal and empathic end-to-end digital experience, enriched and augmented by our colleagues.
  
  
The Gen AI Domain within CDAO has been established to build the tools and capabilities needed across the Group and to lead the “Transformer Banking” initiative. The domain focuses on solution practices, tools and platforms required to leverage Large Language Models safely and effectively, rather than creating foundation models.
  
  
The domain is building technology platforms and tools such as the Gen AI Hub, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access and control planes; business platforms such as Customer Conversation Manager and Customer Activity Manager; and reusable patterns and practices for Gen AI-enabled solutions across CBA.
  
  
The team enables crews across CBA to use Generative AI as part of traditional solutions in a heavily regulated environment. We are looking for people who thrive in ambiguity, build strong team cultures, remain focused on customer needs, manage risk thoughtfully, and are passionate about enterprise transformation through Gen AI.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution**
As Product Owner, you will be accountable for a portfolio of Gen AI platforms and services used across CBA to solve important customer and colleague’s needs. You will deeply understand end-customer and internal-consumer needs, own the product roadmap, ensure the products meet those needs, and partner with the Group Practice Lead - Gen AI Solutions to drive customer success.
  
  
**Reporting Line**
Direct line reporting to CAL, Gen AI.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Define the product vision, direction and goals for the development team.
* Work with knowledge engineers, prompt engineers, platform engineers, data scientists and analysts to build reliable, resilient and adaptable Gen AI applications and deployable solutions.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog, features and user stories, ensuring the development team works on the highest-value outcomes.
* Use your engineering background to understand customer needs for platforms serving internal engineers and assess the feasibility of transformative business capabilities.
* Balance business partner demands with the long-term sustainability of products and services to optimize customer experience, NPS, cost and risk outcomes.
* Partner with SRE teams, consuming service owners, controls teams and risk communities to embed risk management and platform resilience.
* Manage delivery expectations and provide clear status reporting to technology and business stakeholders.
* Own the risks, costs and benefits of platforms and services, while driving reliability, testing practices and Responsible AI.
* Help engineering squads determine which parts of fast-evolving Gen AI solutions require variability and which require stability.
* Continue learning while delivering tangible customer outcomes.
* Act as an ambassador for Gen AI transformation across the bank, sharing knowledge and supporting an open learning culture.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Minimum 12-14 years of relevant experience.
* Product ownership experience delivering complex, high-profile digital capabilities, technology platforms and services.
* Strong understanding of banking workflows and customer experiences, such as dispute-management processes and orchestration of multiple workflows to execute a case.
* Engineering background in software development, data engineering or data science.
* Experience building and operating technology platforms used internally or externally within an organization.
* Experience leading engineering teams that build and scale distributed systems, tools and frameworks across public, private or hybrid cloud environments.
* Exceptional stakeholder engagement, attention to detail, and verbal and written communication skills.
* Customer-focused approach with the ability to identify unmet needs and champion innovative experiences and product practices.
* Ability to drive safe and responsible Gen AI solutions by challenging technology limitations and improving systems, processes and methods.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

**Technical Skills**

* Cloud solution architecture, preferably AWS and Azure; exposure to services such as Amazon SageMaker or equivalent AI platforms is valuable.
* Strong software-development practices, including Git, debugging, automated testing and documentation.
* Experience or exposure to Python, TypeScript and/or C#.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Prompt engineering and non-deterministic automated testing.
* System Reliability Engineering, secure coding, and software security pipeline tools for installation, configuration, operation and monitoring.
* Customer engagement systems and workflow platforms.
* Jira, Confluence and Microsoft Power Platform, including Copilot Studio.

**Good to Have**

* Understanding of machine-learning models and how generative architectures such as GANs, VAEs and Transformers are deployed at scale across cloud or on-premises infrastructure.
* Hands-on knowledge of scalable AI application patterns, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access or control planes.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with developments in AI and machine learning.

**People Capabilities**
**Customer Focus:**
Creates value in every customer interaction and considers the total customer experience.
  
  
**Team and Culture:**
Inspires others to demonstrate CBA Group values and contributes to a passionate, high-performing culture.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Continuously improves and innovates to make experience simpler for customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Effective Communication:**
Communicates clearly and with impact to build understanding, engagement and commitment to action.
  
  
**Judgement:**
Uses CBA knowledge, industry information and financial drivers to guide decisions and actions.
  
  
**Drive Results:**
Takes initiative and accountability to achieve business outcomes.
  
  
**Education Qualification**
Bachelor’s degree in engineering or Master’s degree in Computer Science.
  
  
If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Consumer Growth
jobs.description:
**About Rupeek**

Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Bangalore, Rupeek is an asset-backed digital lending fintech making credit more accessible by helping Indians unlock the value of their gold. We combine technology, customer-focused design, and on-ground execution to make borrowing simpler and more convenient.

Rupeek is backed by leading investors including
**Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & Southeast Asia), Accel, Bertelsmann India Investments, and Elevation Capital**
.

Join us to solve meaningful challenges at the intersection of consumer experience, technology, and financial services—with ownership to shape products and see their impact on customers and the business.

**Work directly with leadership:**
Collaborate with
**Sumit Maniyar
, Founder & CEO**
,
**Setu Poddar
, CTO**
, and Rupeek’s business and operations leaders. Gain firsthand exposure to company strategy, contribute to important product decisions, and build products alongside the people shaping Rupeek’s next phase of growth.

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Experience:**
3–5 years in product management

**The opportunity**

**Help more customers discover Rupeek, take their first loan, and choose us again.**

As Product Manager for Consumer Growth, you’ll own growth opportunities across our app and web journeys—from initial discovery and onboarding to conversion, repeat borrowing, and referrals.

You’ll combine customer research, product analytics, and experimentation to make borrowing simpler and more intuitive. Your mandate is to deliver measurable, sustainable growth while building customer confidence at every step.

**What you’ll own**

* **Activation and conversion:**
  Identify where customers hesitate or drop off, and improve the journey from first visit to a successfully disbursed loan.
* **Customer understanding:**
  Use interviews, feedback, funnel analysis, and cohort insights to uncover customer needs and barriers.
* **Growth experimentation:**
  Develop hypotheses, prioritize opportunities, and run A/B tests or pilots with clear success criteria.
* **Retention and repeat usage:**
  Build relevant journeys that bring customers back when they need credit and encourage referrals.
* **Personalized experiences:**
  Partner with business and marketing teams on messaging, offers, and lifecycle engagement that reflect customer needs.
* **End-to-end execution:**
  Work with design, engineering, analytics, and operations to launch improvements, measure results, and scale what works.

**What success looks like**

Better onboarding completion, higher conversion to disbursal, stronger repeat usage and referrals, and improved funnel efficiency—with customer trust, satisfaction, and business economics as guardrails.

**What you’ll bring**

* 3–5 years of product management experience, preferably in consumer technology, fintech, or digital platforms.
* Evidence of improving a customer or business metric through product changes—and a clear explanation of what you learned.
* Strong understanding of funnels, cohorts, retention, and experimentation.
* Hands-on experience with analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Google Analytics. SQL proficiency is a plus.
* Strong product judgment: the ability to connect customer needs, user experience, and commercial outcomes.
* Clear communication and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into focused, testable opportunities.
* Experience in onboarding, conversion, lifecycle engagement, or referral products is valuable.

**Why this role**

* **Own measurable growth:**
  Connect your product decisions directly to customer and business outcomes.
* **Solve a meaningful consumer challenge:**
  Make a trust-sensitive financial journey easier to understand and complete.
* **Shape the full customer lifecycle:**
  Work across first-time adoption, engagement, repeat usage, and advocacy.
* **Build and learn:**
  Take ideas from customer insight to experiment to scale product improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
PhonePe is on a mission to change the landscape of digital payments and financial services in India. On this mission, we are committed to hiring the best while creating an environment of equal opportunity and empowerment. As a Senior Product Manager at PhonePe, you will own and drive the roadmap for our platform and user centric products. You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Identify large problem statements, break them down, and build consumer experiences and platforms to solve them
* Scope and phase product building meaningfully over and above standard use cases.
* Translate pod and product strategy into a crisp, annual roadmap and define measurable

objectives of a suite of products
  
  

* Be the subject matter expert in driving business decisions and fully understand the cost and revenue implications of your product suite.
* Drive annual and quarterly planning and execution cadences across pods.
* Be the thought leader for the product suite and evangelize goals and objectives. Drive alignment

across stakeholders by effectively engaging them with data.
  
  

* Participate in interviews for PM, APM roles and provide inputs for resource planning across

functions.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Excellent communication skills.
* At least 6+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development.
* Analytical and data-driven with the ability to to derive action and make decisions based on large

data sets.
  
  

* Good with scalable data modeling and abstractions on platform design. Can think over and above traditional use cases.
* Come with a strong point of view on all aspects of the business and balance between a data-backed view and ambiguity.
* Can own output metrics and impact while balancing priorities across pods.

jobs.title: Senior Product Lead
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, you will work in an environment that aims to combine the scale and responsibility of Australia's leading bank with empowered, product-led teams. Our best teams are outcome-focused and take end-to-end ownership. That means staying close to the customer problem, using evidence to make decisions, being clear about trade-offs, learning quickly and owning what we build through its full lifecycle. It also means delivering safely and sustainably: risk, resilience and controls are part of good product design, not something added at the end. We value people who demonstrate Care, Courage and Commitment. You will have the opportunity to work on a material payments problem, own an important product area within a new strategic capability, collaborate with deep payments and technology specialists, and explore how automation and emerging AI can responsibly transform payment servicing.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Senior Product Lead
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
As Product Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will own a defined product area within the broader Payment Exceptions & Investigations product stream. Working within the product strategy and direction established for the stream, you will translate customer and operational problems into clear product outcomes, priorities and an executable roadmap for your squad. You will lead the product lifecycle for your area from discovery and problem definition through delivery, adoption, run performance and continuous optimisation. You will make evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology and delivery considerations, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Architecture, Payments Operations, frontline teams, Risk and other specialist teams.
  
  
You will work closely with other Product Leads and Product Managers across the PEX stream to ensure your product area contributes to coherent end-to-end payment exception journeys and reusable capabilities rather than creating isolated solutions.
  
  
**Impact & contribution:**
As a Product Lead within the Payments Channel and Reporting Crew, you will work closely with the business to deliver exceptional outcomes for our business stakeholders and customers. You will be responsible for developing and delivering customer reporting capability for the Payments Domain. This will incorporate the delivery of reports, modernisation of existing reporting capabilities and development of the strategic roadmap for future state delivery. You will be leading a team of engineering experts to achieve this, while creating a psychologically safe, inclusive, accountable and high-performance culture, and working collaboratively within and across Crews.
  
  
**Reporting lines:**
Dhivya Elanchezhian – Senior Product Capability Lead
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the product vision, outcomes and roadmap for a defined Payment Exceptions & Investigations product area, aligned to the overall PEX product strategy.
* Deeply understand the customer, colleague and operational problems within your product area through discovery, data, research and engagement with frontline and operational teams.
* Translate those problems into clearly defined product opportunities, measurable outcomes and prioritised initiatives.
* Own squad-level prioritisation and roadmap decisions, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology, delivery constraints and expected business outcomes.
* Lead discovery and delivery of reusable product capabilities that contribute to the broader PEX target state rather than creating point solutions for individual processes or systems.
* Shape simple experiences for customers, bankers, investigators and payment operations colleagues within your product area.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on product and engineering trade-offs, feasibility, sequencing, integration and delivery confidence
* Identify opportunities to move journeys from manual handling toward assisted resolution and straight-through processing where policy, evidence and controls support it.
* Explore practical applications of automation and AI for use cases such as context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation support, next-best-action and response drafting.
* Ensure AI-enabled and automated outcomes within your product area are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.Use customer, operational and product data to understand product performance, identify recurring pain points and continuously optimise outcomes.Define and own measurable product outcomes relevant to your area, which may include resolution time, straightthrough-processing rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness and colleague adoption.Embed risk, controls, regulatory and operational resilience considerations throughout discovery, design, delivery and ongoing product management.Lead and develop Product Managers within your squad/product area and contribute to strong product discipline across the broader PEX stream.Partner with other PEX Product Leads and Product Managers to manage dependencies and deliver consistent endto-end customer and colleague outcomes.

**Essential Skills:**
We’re interested in hearing from people who:
  
  

* Bring strong product management and product leadership experience, with a track record of taking complex products from discovery through delivery, adoption and continuous optimisation.
* Have payments domain knowledge, ideally across Australian domestic and/or international payments, payment processing, exceptions or servicing.
* Understand, or are able to develop strong knowledge of, payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and international/correspondent banking.
* Have experience with payment investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments, mistaken payments or related exception-servicing journeys.
* Have worked with complex workflow, case-management, servicing, operational or platform products, preferably within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Demonstrate strong product discovery, customer research, roadmap, prioritisation and lifecycle-management disciplines.
* Can turn complex customer and operational problems into simple product propositions and pragmatic delivery increments.
* Are comfortable making evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational outcomes, technology, risk and delivery considerations.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and customer-facing teams.Understand risk, controls and operational resilience and embed them into product decisions rather than treating them as downstream gates.
* Are curious about automation, AI and emerging technologies and can identify where they create genuine customer or operational value.
* Coach Product Managers, create clarity through ambiguity and build collaborative, outcome-focused teams

**Years of Experience:**
11+
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Product Lead with business/product background and payments domain expertise.
  
  
**Qualifications:**
B.Tech

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager  – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
* Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
* Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
* Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
* Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
* On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
* Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product

**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
**The Role**

Having built strong foundations in India, we now operate across multiple international markets and are expanding into new ones. International Payments (i18n) takes Razorpay’s products into these markets: local payment methods, cross-border flows, and the partnerships with banks, wallets and schemes that make them work — on top of a platform and systems layer that has to be rebuilt for each market’s rails, currency, regulation and settlement cycle. Much of this is 0 to 1 work. You will be deciding what to build, building it with engineering, taking it to merchants, and growing it. There is no running playbook to inherit. You will write it.

This is a builder role as much as a product role. In a new market, Razorpay has no brand recall and few relationships, so you will open doors yourself and because a new market means new rails, you will also own the systems underneath — machinery that every downstream product depends on.

**What you will own**

* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist
* Business focus: Build business strategy around ecosystem product that would define the success for the Razorpay and the Ecosystem players

**Mandatory Qualifications:**

* You understand technology, but love customer-first & business-first thinking.
* You are comfortable working hands-on in a fast-paced start-up environment.
* You are curious about metrics, execution processes, macro trends.
* Problem-solving and detail orientation come naturally to you.
* You have an analytical and data-driven approach in day-to-day work. Energetic self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* You are entrepreneurial and have the hunger to solve problems end-to-end.
* You have at least 4 years of experience in Product Management.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Digital Channels
jobs.description:
**Organization Unit Purpose**

* The Transaction Banking Services (TBS) unit provides a full-featured product suite covering Trade and Supply Chain Finance, Cash Management and Payment Solutions which enables clients to optimize their working capital and also build efficiency and automation in their day-to-day business operations.
* TBS provides an integrated single window approach for all transactional requirements of its corporate clientele across various segments and sectors such as commercial, government and financial institutions. It aims at assisting them with innovative financing and payment solutions as well as offers the convenience of interacting with the bank, away from traditional means.
* The Transaction Banking team continuously interacts with CFO’s and Treasury Teams of its corporate clients and is committed to build strong relationships by meeting their underlying organizational objectives.

**Position Description:**

Product Owner (PO) is accountable for maximizing the value of the product resulting from the work of the Scrum Team by taking complete ownership of the Product and its delivery across ENBD UAE, Islamic and other international entities as per the product scope owned by the squad PO is a virtual leader of the squad and is product’s representative outside the squad for all functional, technical, operational as well as financial matters

**Job Purpose**

**Agile delivery and Channel Management – businessONLINE**

* Lead a team of Product owners and Business Analysts who are responsible for delivery of new products and services via agile delivery squads for businessONLINE (
  **web, mobile, Host to Host and API Banking**
  )
* Ensure that new products / features which have potential use cases for other entities (EI and International), are made available at an
  **enterprise level**
  based on demand and relevance.
* Ensure that all new (Business Requirement Document)
  **BRDs**
  are reviewed and accepted by all stakeholders
* For approved BRDs, ensure timely creation of Functional Specifications Document (
  **FSDs**
  ) and set delivery timelines with the vendor and impacted platform owners accordingly
* Review, prioritize and publish the
  **channel backlog**
  at regular intervals
* Conduct epic/feature prioritization and customer Usability Testing workshops
* Ensure that our
  **test case repositories**
  are constantly updated and include scenarios relevant to real business situations.
* Leverage automated testing tools and scripts to
  **optimize testing efficiency**
* Communicate the product release plan to all stakeholders
* Conduct comprehensive
  **production sanity**
  involving pilot clients prior to launch
* Owner of all Technology Risks, Issues, Problem Tickets, Audit Issues and Resiliency issues (Technical Debt) which exist on the business product
* and is responsible to get them resolved with the help of the squad as per defined SLAs and committed timelines
* Single Point of Contact to receive, collate and prioritize all product enhancements, bug fixes, regulatory and technical demands across all entities in the group
* Align and Execute Product Strategy with overall Business strategy globally while acting as voice of customer
* Manage Executive stakeholders globally and establish consistent communication channels
* Conflict Management and Issue Resolution within various Product Squads internally and Externally
* Responsible to create and implement Product Commercialization and Customer adoption strategies
* Drive campaigns to create channel awareness and identify the
  **right marketing channels**
  for promotion and awareness.
* Conduct periodic trainings and product familiarization sessions for BA’s and Testers.
* Product Ownership
* Owning the product including its strategy, delivery, commercialization and life cycle
* Owning the Product Financials and associated costs while maximizing ROI
* Owning the Technical Debt (Code Refactoring, Resiliency, Performance and Inefficiencies) and constantly working to reduce it
* Owning Product’s Operational Processes in the organization along with any Audit, Compliance, Risk and Security Issues related to product and ensuring
* their resolution as per committed SLAs
* Owning Product Technical Support including Incidents, Problem Tickets and customer queries/complains

**Product Backlog Management**

* Developing and explicitly communicating the Product Goal
* Creating clear, precise and well-articulated value driven backlog by describing items as Epics/Features/User Stories Acceptance Criteria
* Prioritization of Items in Product Backlog
* Ensuring that Product Backlog is transparent, visible and understood by all relevant stakeholders
* Keeping adequate work for the team by having a refined backlog of T+ 2 Sprints (where T is current sprint)

**Product Release Backlog**

* Creation of Release Backlog based to clearly define which feature is intended to be released when
* Creating the customer feedback loop to incorporate voice of customer
* Enabling Early Value Delivery for the Product to improve ROI by intelligently creating MVPs

**Demand Sizing and Prioritization**

* Receive Collate and Prioritize all demands (be it functional or technical) relevant to their product line with all the stakeholders across business
* segments and geographies
* Refine the demand and size it with the help of the team
* Communicating and aligning the Cost and Delivery Timelines for the demands with respective stakeholders

**Product Delivery**

* Accountable for end-to-end product delivery as per committed timelines/sizing as much as possible
* Responsible to conduct Refinement and Planning sessions
* Work with the Scrum Masters to identify the in efficiencies and impediments to improve team’s efficiency overall
* Provide support and required inputs to the team as needed in order to deliver the respective feature
* Aligning the Product delivery dependencies with other platforms with the help of Scrum Master and Agile Release Lead
* Ensuring right and efficient solution is being designed by Solution Architects to fulfill customers’ expectations

**Stakeholder Management**

* Responsible for Stakeholder identification and management for the product
* Responsible to conduct Feature Prioritization Sessions to seek Stakeholders Alignment
* Responsible to establish and maintain critical communication channels to keep Stakeholders informed
* Responsible to Conduct Product Demo sessions to seek stakeholder feedback

**Channel and platform production support for Account Information and Payment Services (for UAE, KSA, Egypt, India and EI)**

* Track all
  **production issues**
  related to account information and payment services across Corporate Channels and core platforms (Finacle, Payment Hub, BPM, Express Clear, SWIFT, FTS etc.
* Based on the severity and ageing of the issue, liaise with the respective platform owners for
  **prioritization**

jobs.title: Manager-Digital Product Management
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express' merchant and network-related businesses, including relationships with merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, and strategic partners globally.
  
  
The Network Product team develops and delivers secure, resilient, and scalable payment network capabilities. This includes Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations that support market expansion, regulatory requirements, and global interoperability.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Network Product professional to drive the development and delivery of strategic payment network capabilities. The role requires strong knowledge of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, transaction processing, and digital payments, along with the ability to translate business and partner needs into clear product requirements and executable delivery plans.
  
  
Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills are critical. The individual will coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, drive governance, and communicate progress and decisions effectively to senior leaders, internal teams, and external partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute product roadmaps for payment network capabilities aligned with enterprise priorities, market needs, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of capabilities across Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations.
* Translate business, customer, partner, and regulatory needs into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones.

* Coordinate execution across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and external partner teams.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and blockers, drive mitigation, and escalate matters requiring leadership attention.
* Prepare concise executive updates, dashboards, roadmaps, and governance materials, translating complex topics for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across global, cross-functional, and highly matrixed teams.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualification**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Management, or related field.
* Relevant experience in payment network products, digital payments, product management, network delivery, or payment technology.
* Strong understanding of the payment's ecosystem, including networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, and digital payment providers.
* Knowledge of payment transaction flows and capabilities such as authorization, authentication, tokenization, clearing, and settlement.
* Experience delivering products or capabilities through requirements, development, testing, implementation, and operational readiness.

* Strong written, verbal, presentation, executive communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualification**

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About mPokket**

Founded in 2016 by Gaurav Jalan, mPokket was born from a simple yet powerful realisation - while global youth enjoyed financial freedom, young Indians faced barriers. We set out to bridge the gap between aspirations and affordability by empowering the youth of Bharat.

At mPokket, we exist to remove the financial friction that stalls potential. We are on a mission to empower Young India, the Aspirants, and the Self-Starters to achieve their dreams with true financial independence.

Today, we bridge that gap by offering quick, dignified, and accessible instant loans up to Rs. 2,00,000. We are proud to be a trusted partner for over 65 million customers, maintaining a 4.6/5 rating on the Google Play Store.

The same belief shapes our commitment to communities, colleagues, and customers. We are a Great Place To Work Certified organisation, committed to high-performing teams, ownership and meaningful impact.

**Job Summary**

**Senior Product Manager**

Own the collections product for mPokket’s lending business. Improve recovery and reduce roll rates and collection costs while making agents more productive and treating borrowers in financial distress with dignity.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recovery & Roll-Rate Strategy**

Own recovery and roll rates across days-past-due (DPD) buckets, from DPD7 through DPD180+, with a focus on early delinquency.

Use cohort data, borrower interviews and agent observations to identify recovery opportunities. Test early-bucket reminders and improve settlement logic to protect margins.

**2. Cost to Collect & Agent Productivity**

Reduce the cost per rupee recovered by balancing automation, agent capacity and channel mix. Test voice-bot strategies against recovery and cost metrics.

Shadow collections agents and improve workflows, tooling and the way agents record call outcomes.

**3. Borrower Experience & Cross-functional Delivery**

Design collections and repayment journeys that help borrowers in financial distress resolve outstanding balances with dignity.

Work with Risk, Data Science, Collections Operations, Engineering, Compliance and Customer Support to run experiments and deliver product improvements.

**Success in the First Six Months**

Use your own analysis to identify and explain the biggest opportunities to improve recovery.

Run at least one live experiment that meaningfully improves recovery or roll rate.

Shadow agents and fix at least one recurring issue in their workflow.

Build trust with Risk and Collections Operations. Exercise independent judgment and demonstrate the outcome of a decision your manager initially questioned.

**What We’re Looking For**

Take ownership of ambiguous problems. Use data, borrower conversations and agent observations to diagnose the issue and write your own brief.

Build a plan when the next step is unclear. Aim to ship an initial version in two weeks and use the results to decide what to do next.

Interpret cohort data, spot anomalies and ask analysts precise follow-up questions. SQL is optional.

Show empathy for borrowers in financial distress and communicate your product reasoning clearly in writing.

Prior lending or fintech experience is welcome. We provide training in credit, DPD, regulation and collections strategy. An MBA and top-tier consulting experience are optional.

**Selection Process**

Roadmap exercise. Prepare a brief within 48 hours outlining your problem framing, the data you need, your top three ideas and what you would ship in the first two weeks.

Working session. Discuss the brief and explain how you would revise it as new information emerges.

Product discussion. Walk through one product decision that worked and one that did not.

Reference checks. We select references, including a peer, to discuss your ownership and judgment.

**How to Apply**

A 200–400 word note about an ambiguous problem you owned end to end. Explain the problem, your actions, the outcome and what you would do differently.

One writing sample, such as a product requirements document, strategy memo or post-mortem, that shows your reasoning.

Your résumé.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Tokenisation & Stablecoin Infrastructure
jobs.description:
BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Tokenization & Stablecoin Infrastructure team and drive the products that let institutions issue, mint, redeem, custody, and move stablecoins and tokenized real-world assets. You will work closely with stablecoin issuers, asset managers, banks, and token foundations, along with engineering, compliance, legal, and go-to-market teams, to bring new issuers and assets onto BitGo's regulated infrastructure.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role in a fast-moving, ambiguous space where regulation, market structure, and technology are evolving together. You will own the roadmap, shape strategy, and see products through from first customer conversation to launch and scale.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the roadmap, strategy, and execution for BitGo's tokenization and stablecoin infrastructure, including mint/burn and redemption flows, issuance workflows, reserve and settlement integrations, and tokenized asset lifecycle management.
* Lead and motivate a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and operations and compliance partners to build institutional-grade solutions.
* Scope and ship new issuer and asset integrations end to end: write PRDs, define order, fee, and settlement flows, align on custody and security models, and drive launch readiness.
* Partner with stablecoin issuers, tokenized fund and asset managers, banks, and ecosystem and blockchain foundations to understand needs, shape partnerships, and turn them into scalable product capabilities rather than one-off builds.
* Work with compliance, legal, and risk teams to make sure every product meets regulatory, security, and licensing requirements across jurisdictions.
* Evaluate new chains, token standards, and market-structure developments (for example, tokenized securities, tokenized deposits, and onchain settlement) and turn them into a clear point of view and prioritized opportunities.
* Define and track success metrics such as issuer onboarding time, volumes, revenue, and reliability, and iterate based on data and client feedback.
* Work with GTM, sales, and client success teams on positioning, pricing, and client enablement, and act as a trusted product partner to key clients.
* Mentor junior PMs and help raise the bar for product craft within the team.

**Who Would Be a Great Fit**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, payments, crypto, or financial infrastructure, with a record of shipping B2B or institutional products.
* Strong working knowledge of crypto and blockchain: token standards and mechanics, multiple L1/L2 ecosystems, wallets and custody, and onchain settlement.
* Understanding of stablecoin and tokenization models: issuance, mint/burn and redemption, reserves, fiat on/off-ramps, and how tokenized funds, securities, or deposits work.
* Familiarity with the regulatory landscape for stablecoins and digital assets (such as GENIUS Act, MiCA, and trust-bank or custody regulation) and the ability to work through it with legal and compliance partners.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams, with the ability to coordinate engineering, business, and external partners and to build consensus in ambiguous areas.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to write clear PRDs and explain complex technical or regulatory topics to executives and clients.
* Comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, balancing several projects with different priorities and a hands-on approach to execution.
* Prior startup or scale-up experience, showing adaptability, ownership, and sound judgment.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in traditional finance, capital markets, asset management, or banking infrastructure (custody, settlement, transfer agency).
* Hands-on exposure to institutional tokenization networks or permissioned chains.
* Technical background or comfort reading APIs, smart contracts, and architecture docs.
* Experience with enterprise partnerships and client-facing product work.

**Why Join BitGo?**
Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of open communication, collaboration, accountability, craftsmanship, and a client first approach. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want to be part of the team that changes the world's financial markets.
  
  
Here are some of the benefits of working at BitGo:
  
  

* Competitive salary
* IT equipment support for work
* Meal & commute allowance
* Medical insurance
* Attractive well-being allowance (covering medical, wellness, and fitness)
* Snacks on the house in the Bangalore office
* A great, talented workforce to learn and grow with

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed finance.
  
  
**Note:**
This role requires working onsite (Monday to Friday) at the Bangalore office.

jobs.title: Product Owner, SME Banking Digital
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner to lead the transformation of ideas into seamless, intuitive product experiences. The ideal candidate excels in planning, designing, scaling, and commercializing products, with a proven ability to test, validate, and optimize throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
This role requires a strong client focus and business acumen to effectively prioritize and deliver on competing demands. You will inspire and influence cross-functional teams to achieve positive outcomes with executional excellence. If you are a creative problem solver who thrives on tackling complex challenges and building products from inception to scale, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Key responsibilities include product management, governance, and commercialization activities to support client channel onboarding and the development of scalable digital solutions. Additionally, you will serve as a key point of contact for education, thought leadership, and product expertise related to client channel onboarding.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives, addressing key strategic issues and functional architecture in close collaboration with business, operations, and technology teams, with a focus on shaping and executing the client channel onboarding strategy to achieve business objectives.
* Ensure alignment of channel onboarding product goals with overall business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Drive the implementation of digital solutions across the channel onboarding domain and operations, fostering ongoing partnerships with internal stakeholders and clients.
* Facilitate business change management and process design by developing and reviewing detailed software/functional requirements and process flow diagrams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, communicating project progress to Senior Sponsors, Business Sponsors, Steering Committees, and the Program Management Office as appropriate.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for S2B channel onboarding to senior stakeholders and team members.
* Stay abreast of industry trends, technological advancements, and best practices within the channel onboarding domain.
* Leverage innovative solutions to enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction

**Business**

* As the product owner, responsible for crafting the product’s vision, roadmap, and maximizing the delivery of business value in SME CADM.
* Collaborate closely with channel operations team, business units, product owners and IT resources throughout all stages of project life cycle - including investigation, analysis, design, development, testing, and implementations - to ensure business requirements are successfully implemented.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPI’s) to measure the success of various initiatives
* Institutionalize innovative ideas to accelerate the Bank’s digital footprint.

**Processes**

* Manage the Book of Work, ensuring effective prioritization and alignment with stakeholder timelines.
* Oversee and streamline processes related to information controls, productivity, and regional/country enhancements, including workflows and procedures.
* Manage the product backlog and collaborate with technology teams to digitize client and internal operational workflows for onboarding.
* Review and approve use case scenarios and test cases; coordinate and support user acceptance testing and production verification.

* Deliver the digital strategy for client channel onboarding, ensuring global scalability while accommodating local requirements.
* Act as a people influencer and product owner to deliver proof of concepts and execute incubation ideas across business lines and locations, ensuring governance and controls.
* Develop and implement plans to increase awareness of digital transformation within client channel onboarding.
* Define and drive training programs to enhance digital automation capabilities among channel operations staff and stakeholders.
* Identify and address inefficiencies in channel operations, proposing workflow optimizations.
* Leverage data analysis to inform decisions and improve operational metrics.
* Identify and mitigate risks in channel operations.
* Partner with operations and business units to streamline processes, mitigate risks, and drive efficiencies.
* Measure and evaluate outcomes of change initiatives post-implementation.
* Assess the impact of process changes to ensure no additional manual touchpoints are introduced.

**People & Talent**
The role is not a people leader role however the role involves coordination between multiple parties
  
  

* Work Closely with channel operations team, business teams, peer product owners, engineering lead, architects to define and implement Solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams for successful implementation and deployment of client channel onboarding capabilities
* Engage actively with legal and compliance to raise awareness of new product features and secure acceptance of the changes.

**Risk Management**

* Ensure adherence to risk management framework.
* Act as the risk control owner under the Group’s risk management framework at the appropriate level.
* Ensure that bank is not exposed to risks due to client channel onboarding data management by enforcing role-based access control, embed market specific data localization as part of the product design.

**Governance**

* Oversee & track implementation timelines, resolve impediments / blockers, ensure change communication & transition
* Good understanding of change management and project management
* Identify, analyse, prepare risk mitigation tactics and manage anticipated resistances
* Good understanding of ADO dashboard, key metrices and functions

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Operations team
* IAM team
* Business Stakeholders across Cash, Trade, Financial Markets
* Channel product owners across Cash, Trade, Financial Markets
* Technology team
* DCS management team
* Agile Coach

**Skills And Experience**

* Strong business and product expertise on user entitlements and client onboarding
* Product Owner experience
* Understanding of product development lifecycle
* Strong project management and planning skills, including organizational & time management skills
* Clarity of communication style and ability to face off against senior stakeholders
* Digital Transformation

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in banking, with a strong focus on managing digital channels; experience in Fintech environments is highly desirable.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience in identity and access management or channel onboar

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bright Money**

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck-to-paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with a financial service marketplace revenues, for loans, credit cards, and credit building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.'

**What is the team & role about?**

We are hiring a Platform Product Manager - Banking Platform to own and scale core banking and money-movement platform capabilities that power multiple financial products. This role focuses on bank account lifecycles, payment rails, partner integrations, and regulatory-ready infrastructure, enabling product teams to build reliably and at scale.

This is a senior product leadership role combining deep platform ownership, people management, executive-level communication, and structured problem-solving. You will operate as a trusted partner to Engineering leadership and CXOs, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear decisions and execution plans.

**What will you do?**

**Product Ownership & Strategy**

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one or more Banking Services platform domains (e.g., account onboarding, verification, bank transfers, settlements).
* Define clear product goals, success metrics, and trade-offs across reliability, compliance, and feature delivery.
* Manage the full product lifecycle—from discovery and requirements to launch, adoption, and optimization.

**Banking Infrastructure & Money Movement**

* Drive platform capabilities supporting bank account lifecycles and money movement (e.g., ACH equivalents, local bank transfers, instant payments, reconciliation workflows).
* Lead integrations with banking partners, payment processors, and financial infrastructure providers.
* Ensure strong handling of edge cases such as failures, retries, reversals, exceptions, and settlements.

**Compliance, Risk & Resilience**

* Translate regulatory, scheme, and partner constraints into clear platform requirements (e.g., auditability, controls, data retention, reporting).
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to ensure controls are embedded into platform design.
* Drive platform resilience designing for partner outages, degraded modes, and recovery scenarios.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Write high-quality PRDs and platform requirements that engineers can execute against with clarity.
* Prioritize across run-the-business work, platform improvements, and new enablement initiatives.
* Lead cross-functional execution across multiple engineering teams.

**Stakeholder & Internal Customer Experience**

* Act as the product owner for internal consumers of the platform (Product, Engineering, Ops).
* Improve developer and internal product team experience through clear APIs, documentation, and self-serve capabilities.
* Communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to senior leadership.

**Ideal candidate profile looks like?**

**Experience & Background:**

* 5 - 12 years of Product Management experience, with strong exposure to backend, platform, or infrastructure products.
* Prior people management experience, including mentoring or managing Product Managers
* Exposure to high-scale, high-availability systems with strict SLAs.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud architectures.
* Strong systems thinking and technical fluency, comfortable working deeply with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Experience defining and using KPIs/OKRs to drive prioritization and outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex dependencies and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Non-Fit Profiles:**

* Domain experts without Platform Ownership experience.
* PMs from Low-Scale or Low-Reliability Environments.
* Product Managers without deep technical depth.
* Pure UI/ UX-First Product Managers.
* Program Manager or Project Managers.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience building internal platforms or developer-facing products.
* Exposure to global-scale, high-availability systems.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated systems.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You run your own BU with an independent P&L.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location flexibility: 5 days from the Bangalore office in a week

Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express' merchant and network-related businesses, including relationships with merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, and strategic partners globally.
  
  
The Network Product team develops and delivers secure, resilient, and scalable payment network capabilities. This includes Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations that support market expansion, regulatory requirements, and global interoperability.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Network Product professional to drive the development and delivery of strategic payment network capabilities. The role requires strong knowledge of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, transaction processing, and digital payments, along with the ability to translate business and partner needs into clear product requirements and executable delivery plans.
  
  
Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills are critical. The individual will coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, drive governance, and communicate progress and decisions effectively to senior leaders, internal teams, and external partners.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Core Network
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Part Of**
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
****What you'll be responsible for****
You will own the product strategy and evolution of the CPN Payments Engine — the core infrastructure that powers payment creation, routing, settlement, and lifecycle management across the network. You’ll define the long-term vision and roadmap for the engine, identifying opportunities to expand its capabilities while improving reliability, performance, and scale. Working across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams, you’ll lead complex product decisions and investments that enable OFIs and BFIs to move money efficiently across an expanding set of corridors and rails, translating platform improvements into measurable network and business outcomes.

We are looking for a
**Senior Product Designer – AI**
who is passionate about building intelligent, AI-powered product experiences that simplify complex problems and create meaningful customer impact.

You will work at the intersection of Product Design, AI and emerging technologies, designing intuitive experiences that make AI capabilities accessible, useful and trustworthy for customers.

You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, senior leadership and other stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can enhance customer experiences, rethink existing workflows and build innovative solutions.

We are looking for a designer who combines strong UI/UX fundamentals with curiosity about AI, understands how users interact with intelligent systems and can translate complex AI capabilities into simple, human-centric experiences.

**What You'll Do**

* Design end-to-end experiences for AI-powered products and features, from problem discovery and user journeys to high-fidelity UI and interaction design.

* Design intuitive conversational interfaces, AI assistants, chat-based experiences and intelligent user interactions.
* Translate complex AI capabilities, outputs and workflows into simple, understandable and user-friendly experiences.

**What You'll Bring**

jobs.title: Digital Channels Cash Product Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).
* Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
* Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**

* Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
* Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
* Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
* Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.

**Product execution and prioritisation**

* Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
* Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
* Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
* Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.

**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**

* Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
* Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
* Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**

* Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.
* Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.
* Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.

**People and talent**

* Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.
* Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.
* Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.
* Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.
* Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* Cash and Payments Product Strategy
* Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity
* Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition

**Other Skills**

* Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline
* Client and Market Insight
* Senior Stakeholder Influence
* People Leadership and Product Team Development

**Motivations**

* Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.
* Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.
* Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

* 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.
* Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.
* Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.
* Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.
* Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.
* Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.
* Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.

**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.
  
  
**Languages:**
English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.

* Core bank funding
