jobs.title: Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation Architect
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**   
Lead end-to-end simulation engagements across manufacturing plants, warehouses, intralogistics, and logistics networks.

Define simulation architecture, system boundaries, modelling approach, level of detail, assumptions, data requirements, and experiment strategy.  
Develop scalable and reusable models using Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation and related DES platforms.  
Model complex manufacturing processes including BIW, paint, trim & final assembly, EV/battery manufacturing, buffers, sequencing, downtime, rework, and quality constraints.  
Design and simulate AGV/AMR, conveyors, forklifts, tugger trains, ASRS, warehouse automation, and material-flow systems.  
Perform capacity planning, bottleneck analysis, line balancing, throughput optimization, WIP analysis, OEE improvement, and resource utilization studies.  
Lead Verification & Validation (V&V) through face-validity workshops, historical data comparison, acceptance criteria, and formal validation.  
Define and execute scenario analysis, sensitivity studies, statistical experiments, and simulation optimization.  
Integrate simulation solutions with MES, WMS, ERP, IoT and Digital Twin environments for data-driven decision support.  
Lead technical reviews, establish coding/model quality standards, and govern documentation, version control, and model lifecycle management.  
Translate simulation outputs into quantified operational recommendations, capacity roadmaps, automation business cases, and investment decisions.  
Manage technical risks, dependencies, delivery milestones, stakeholder expectations, and escalation activities.  
Mentor engineers and team leads conduct technical reviews, coaching, knowledge sharing, and capability development.  
Contribute to proposals, solution design, estimation, reusable model libraries, accelerators, playbooks, and CoE initiatives.  
Engage with senior client stakeholders and present simulation findings, recommendations, and transformation roadmaps.

**Technical Skills & Professional Skills**  
Siemens Tecnomatix Plant Simulation / SimTalk strong hands-on expertise.  
Strong knowledge of Discrete Event Simulation, manufacturing simulation, logistics simulation, and digital manufacturing.  
Experience with other DES platforms such as AnyLogic, FlexSim, Simio, Arena, WITNESS, DELMIA Quest, or equivalent.  
Strong scripting/programming skills using SimTalk, Python, Java, C#, or equivalent.  
Expertise in automotive manufacturing processes including BIW, paint, trim & final, powertrain, EV and battery manufacturing.  
Strong knowledge of intralogistics and warehouse automation including AGV/AMR, ASRS, conveyors, sortation, picking, kitting, and replenishment.  
Experience with MES/WMS/ERP integration, including platforms such as Siemens Opcenter, SAP ME/EWM, Manhattan, or Blue Yonder.  
Knowledge of Digital Twin, OPC-UA, MQTT, IoT, real-time data integration, and Industry 4.0 architectures.  
Strong understanding of statistical analysis, distribution fitting, warm-up analysis, confidence intervals, experimental design, sensitivity analysis, ANOVA, and optimization.  
Experience with LP/MIP, GA, metaheuristic optimization, or simulation-linked optimization.  
Proficiency in Python data analytics, including Pandas, SciPy, and visualization tools.  
Knowledge of AutoCAD/DWG/DXF, Plant 3D, BIM, or equivalent facility-layout technologies.  
Strong technical documentation, presentation, communication, stakeholder management, and client-facing consulting skills.  
Experience with Agile delivery, Jira/DevOps, Git, model version control, and delivery governance.  
Strong leadership capability with experience in team mentoring, technical governance, solution architecture, and program management.  
Ability to convert complex simulation results into business insights and actionable recommendations

jobs.title: Business Analyst — Avaloq Banking Transformation
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
As Business Analyst you are the bridge between business stakeholders and Avaloq delivery squads: you elicit and challenge requirements, shape them into Avaloq-executable functional designs, and stay accountable for them through build, SIT, UAT and go-live.
  
  
This is a hands-on delivery role on large, multi-workstream Avaloq programmes. You will own the requirement thread end to end — from a business pain point in the front office to a signed-off UAT result in production.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Finance, Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of Business Analysis experience, of which at least 3 years in banking or financial services.
* Avaloq: Hands-on delivery experience on the Avaloq Banking Suite — a firm requirement for this role. You must be able to discuss Avaloq business objects, parameters and functional design decisions unaided.
* Demonstrated delivery on at least one large-scale core banking transformation programme, end to end.
* Greenfield: Proven exposure to a greenfield implementation, with end-to-end command of your workstream from initial design through to go-live.
* Cross-workstream: Track record of coordinating across parallel workstreams — engaging other workstream owners to surface cross-impacts, agree interface and data dependencies, and keep design decisions aligned programme-wide.
* Proven authorship of BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process maps and traceability matrices.
* Experience in both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.
* Excellent written and verbal English, with the ability to write specifications that a developer can build from without further explanation.

**TOOLS & TECHNICAL SKILLS**
Avaloq Banking Suite (functional)
  
  

* Requirements management
* BPMN / Visio process modelling
* JIRA & Azure DevOps
* Confluence
* SQL (preferred)
* Advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliation)
* Functional testing, SIT & UAT management
* Business process re-engineering

**Job Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
2. Process Analysis & Avaloq Solution Design3. Stakeholder Engagement & Governance4. Agile Delivery & Backlog Management5. Delivery Assurance, Data Validation & Go-Live
  
  

* Requirements Engineering & Documentation
* Elicit requirements through workshops, stakeholder interviews and process observation across front, middle and back office.
* Translate business needs into Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Specification Documents (FSDs), user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Author Avaloq-specific functional designs covering impacted business objects, parameters, interfaces, reports and batch processing.

* Constructively challenge senior stakeholders where requirements conflict, and drive them to a single agreed position.

* Report progress, risks, issues and dependencies clearly to programme management.
* Build, refine and prioritise the backlog in JIRA or Azure DevOps alongside the Product Owner.

* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews and retrospectives; resolve requirement clarifications within the sprint.
* Design and review test scenarios and test cases; drive SIT, UAT and business validation to completion.

  .

jobs.title: Product Owner (SAP)
jobs.description:
**Product Owner**
Recruiter for this position: Vipin Yadav
  
  
Hiring Manager for this position: Jaya Dadlani
  
  
Division: Product Engineering O2C
  
  
Serrala is the global leader in finance process automation. For over 40 years, we have been advancing the office of the CFO with our award-winning suite of finance automation applications.
  
  
Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments.
  
  
Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community.
  
  
Join us as we lead the future of finance automation!
  
  
**Role Summary:**
We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to sit at the intersection of engineering and product for our Credit & Risk suite. This role is for someone who can go deep into ABAP, RAP and Fiori technical topics to design and guide developers, write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can implement and test without ambiguity, and — when dedicated QA capacity is limited — test the functionality themselves. Prior Product Owner experience is not required as long as strong Project Management and Agile delivery skills are in place.
  
  
The person will work closely with the Product Manager to understand, follow, and contribute to the Roadmap, and will collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting to explain the product, gather feedback, and turn it into actionable backlog items
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deep-dive into technical topics in SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori to design solutions and guide developers through implementation.
* Write clear, well-structured Epics and User Stories that are easy for developers and QA to implement and test.
* Perform hands-on testing / QA yourself for critical items when dedicated QA capacity is limited.
* Understand, follow, and actively contribute to the product Roadmap set by the Product Manager.
* Collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting teams — explaining the product, capturing feedback, and translating it into requirements.
* Bring significant/strategic topics to the Product Manager for joint discussion and decision-making.
* Apply a working understanding of SAP functional processes and Finance tables to ground technical decisions in real business context.
* Demonstrate excellent communication, active listening, and critical reasoning across technical and non-technical audiences.

**Must-Have:**

* Hands-on technical experience with SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori/UI5 — enough to design solutions and guide developers, not just review code.
* Strong Project Management / Agile delivery skills (Scrum, sprint planning, Backlog management) — Product Owner title/experience is not mandatory if this is solid.
* Basic understanding of SAP functional processes; exposure to Finance tables (e.g. BSEG, BSID, Credit Management tables) is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can pick up and implement/test with minimal back-and-forth.
* Willingness and ability to personally execute QA/Testing when QA capacity is constrained.
* Proven experience collaborating directly with customers, partners, or external agencies — explaining a product and incorporating feedback.
* Excellent communication and active-listening skills, with strong critical reasoning to navigate ambiguous, technical, and business conversations alike.

**Good-to-Have:**

* Prior experience as a Product Owner or in a similar product/technical-lead role.
* Domain exposure to Credit Management, Credit Risk, Order to Cash (O2C), or Accounts Receivable.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA (or ECC-to-S/4HANA migration context).
* Familiarity with JIRA/Confluence or similar Agile tooling for Epics/Story and Roadmap management.
* Exposure to integrations with external credit bureaus/agencies (e.g. credit reporting or credit insurance providers). Exposure to AI/ML-driven features such as credit exposure or risk-prediction models.
* Prior experience working with Solution Architects and Consulting teams in a customer-facing capacity.

Next steps: Simply apply here via the internal job market - we will contact you as soon as possible. Good to know: We will contact you first - your current manager will not be informed about your internal application.

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test & Learn), and data-driven information and risk management services.
  
  
As a member of the Business Experimentation Product Management team, you will build industry-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are rapidly building new products, evolving products in the age of AI, and expanding the ways we deliver Test & Learn to our clients. We are looking for AI native PMs who can execute and evolve our product strategy and help us build the AI enhanced version of Test & Learn.
  
  
Role

Can work closely with cross-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales, marketing, and users.

Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap.

jobs.title: Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

1. Join RENSAR hardware team utilizing your board level design skills to develop digital and analog circuits.

2. Be involved in all phases of board level hardware development in small self-motivated teams.

3. Perform design documentation, component selection, schematic edits, DFMEA, DFM, DFT etc. to ensure that your design is meeting the requirements, is competitive, production friendly and highly reliable.

4. Work with the board layout designers and support the layout by providing design constraints, rules, guidelines and reviews.

5. Validate your design using simulation tools and perform functional quality analysis of your design.

6. Make technical presentations on the details of your design and project status.

7. Interface with customers and field engineers on an as needed basis, helping to resolve field problems while learning more about applications and user habits.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

1. ME / M. tech., BE / B Tech. Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent.

2. 3-6 years of thorough hands-on experience of designing boards using 8 / 32-bit boards using MCUs like MSP 430, TMS320, STM32 etc. and analog mixed signal circuits.

3. Strong component engineering knowledge and exposure to semiconductor markets.

4. Strong knowledge of communication protocols like SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS-232, RS-485 etc.

5. Must have worked with PWB designers to review the board designs for signal integrity, EMI/EMC compliance etc. Should be well versed with DFM / DFT using Cadence development tools.

6. Thorough knowledge of EMC standards like IEC6100, IEC 61526, CISPR 11 etc. and their practical application through out the design life cycle.

7. Hardcore board bring-up & debugging experience using instruments like Logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and in-circuit emulators.

8. Ability to interact and work with external test & certification labs to validate the product compliance.

9. Excellent verbal & written communication in Hindi & English.

10. Ready to travel across the country for gaining field and application knowledge as well as trouble shooting.

11. Should have hands on experience of board Box-up using enclosures made of polymer, sheet metal and castings, enclosures.

12. Strong linguistic skill for documentation of the development efforts.

  

**Desired**

  

1. DSP based design experience.

2. Proven track record with both Analog and high-speed digital designs.

3. Experience with low level analog signal design techniques.

4. Experience designing with programmable logic devices.

5. Software experience to generate diagnostic code (C, C++, and/or assembly language).

**Job Title:**
Principal UX Designer

**About Backbase**

Backbase is a leading provider of digital banking solutions. Our mission is to help banks create seamless and engaging customer experiences. We are a global company with a strong presence across the globe in Europe, Asia, Africa, Middle East and the Americas. We value innovation, collaboration, and customer focus. Our team is passionate about making a difference in the financial industry.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Senior UX Designer to join our Services Middle East team in our Hyderabad office. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the user experience for our innovative digital banking products. You will be involved in the entire design process, from ideation to prototyping and testing. You will work closely with cross-functional client-facing teams, including Backbase team members: project managers, business analysts, solution architects and engineers. Externally, you will work closely with senior and leadership-level client stakeholders to deliver user-centered design solutions that meet their business goals. This is a hybrid position, requiring a mix of in-office and remote work, while being flexible for client travel.

As a client-facing UX Designer, you will be a key point of contact for our clients, leading workshops, gathering requirements, and presenting design solutions. This requires excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build rapport and work effectively with clients from diverse backgrounds.

**Responsibilities:**

* Create user flows, wireframes, and prototypes to communicate design concepts.
* Design high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes.
* Conduct usability testing to validate design decisions and iterate on designs.
* Lead client workshops to gather requirements and present design solutions.
* Confidently present and explain design decisions to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of design systems.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest UX design trends and best practices.
* Support development and QA teams regarding designs.

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience as a UX Designer, with experience in a client-facing role.
* A strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design solutions.
* Proficiency in Figma.
* Solid understanding of UX research methodologies and usability testing principles.
* Experience working with design systems.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Experience leading and facilitating workshops.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* Fluency in English.
* Ability to effectively convey design specifications and rationale to the technical members of the team.

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience working in the financial, consultancy or technology industry.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies.

**Please note:**

* We are looking for someone who is passionate about user-centered design and has a strong understanding of UX principles.
* Your portfolio should showcase your design process and demonstrate your ability to solve real-world problems.
* We are particularly interested in seeing examples of your work that demonstrate your skills in interaction design.
* We are looking for someone who is a team player and has excellent communication skills.

**Job Description**
**What We Do**
At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.
  
  
**Who Are We**
Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions in risk management, big data, mobile and more. We look for creative collaborators who evolve, adapt to change and thrive in a fast-paced global environment. The Digital Client Experience teams in Asset Management provide clients with innovative and customer-centered financial products to drive transformative changes. We bring the best qualities of a technology player and combine that with the best attributes of a large bank. Our Digital teams comprise of three main businesses, underpinned by engineering, product operations, security and risk management:
  
  

* Mosaic, an end-to-end open architecture technology platform and a digital product that provides trading, settlement, analytics, and reporting solutions to global liquidity clients.
* GSAM.com: GSAM is the asset management arm of Goldman Sachs, which supervises more than $1.8 trillion in assets. Goldman Sachs Asset Management has been providing discretionary investment advisory services since 1988 and has investment professionals in all major financial centers around the world.

Our team of engineers builds solutions to the most complex problems. We develop cutting-edge digital platform and processes that form the core of our key business and enable several marketing and sales. We develop global web and mobile platform for Third Party Distribution and Institutional businesses. Team members have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field.
  
  

* Advisor Portal : An external Advisor Portal is a key component of SMA expansion program. The aim of this portal is to provide an all-digital, best in class experience to Advisors such as advisor onboarding, application for new SMAs, track accounts status, access advisor tools etc. Retail distribution requires scaling our client onboarding and portfolio management to support tens of thousands of clients through diligence, onboarding, and ongoing lifecycle events.

Join us on our journey to deliver financial products and platforms that prioritize the customer and developer experience.
  
  
**Digital Client Experience Engineering**
Digital Client Experience Engineering teams build transformative cutting-edge digital platform and processes that form the core of our key business across liquidity, marketing and sales. Our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading-edge technology, data and design principals.
  
  
As an engineer on the Digital Client Experience team, you will have the opportunity to work at the forefront of technology innovation alongside industry leaders and make significant contributions to the field. You will be one the main drivers helping evolve our product strategy as we continue to ensure we are a market leader. This will involve you being asked to come up with creative and commercial solutions to the various problems the team is tackling, and also for us to be able to lean on your leadership when executing those choices.
  
  
We are looking for engineers who can drive a whole feature from design to execution, as well as engineers who can deep dive why an API is taking half a second longer than it should. Our team has a large variety of problems to tackle across the entire stack.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a full stack developer you will
  
  

* Drive the design of critical components in the technology stack as well as oversee the implementation of new features, focusing on code quality, automation and testability.
* Collaborate with a global cross functional team in building customer-centric products
* Contribute to the vision, understand our product roadmap and contribute to building an engineering culture within our global team.
* Design flows and systems using cloud and on-prem technologies to ensure performance, longevity, and scalability of infrastructure.
* Contribute to SDLC documentation and guidance including templates, patterns, and controls.
* Perform code reviews and system design reviews and establish code quality standards and software best practices for a distributed systems architecture.
* Mentor and help develop more junior technical talents.
* Communicate with leadership, engineers, and business teams.

We are looking for someone with lots of energy that enjoys engineering challenges and has a passion to deliver high quality technology solutions and is able to operate in a highly fluid, rapidly changing environment.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience with Java, JavaScript, and Spring Boot
* Bachelor’s degree (U.S. or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience with design and implementation of low latency, high throughput, and fault-tolerant distributed systems.
* Experience with microservices architecture and API development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Culture of excellence and collaboration
* Comfort with Agile operating models
* Energetic, self-directed, and self-motivated

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands on experience with Java and experience with any of the Rx\* variants
* Experience with Kafka or similar messaging technologies
* Experience with microservice architectures
* Experience with the Spring framework family
* Strong proficiency in: Distributed systems, Low-latency services, NoSQL and relational databases
* Experience with AWS
* Hands on experience with React and/or Angular
* Experience with external facing websites is a plus
* Experience working with clients / users a plus
* Experience with Adobe Experience Manager is a plus

**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**
At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.
  
  
Engineering is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here!

jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s). Digital products may have enterprise-wide implications.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.
  
  
This Product Manager will lead enhancements to the customer service and contact center tools used by our crew to serve clients, including the integration of AI capabilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.
* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.
* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.
* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.
* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource-efficient delivery.
* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go-to-market strategies.
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.
* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.
* Lead the modernization of contact-center desktop capabilities and supporting tools to improve the experience of contact-center staff and participants while enabling stronger customer relationships.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple applications and product teams by understanding interconnected roadmaps, managing delivery trade-offs, and balancing technical constraints with speed to market.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross-functional teams on major organizational projects.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.
* Proven ability to translate customer insights into product improvements and new features.
* Experience working with engineering teams to drive product development from concept to launch.
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities to align product strategy with business goals.
* Experience in a contact-center or service environment, including familiarity with contact-center operations, desktop platforms, and the tools that support customer-service teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross-product dependencies and collaborate with multiple product managers; financial-services experience is preferred but not mandatory, and relevant banking or healthcare customer-service systems experience may be considered.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

Principal Manager, Product Management (Comply Tech)
jobs.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are seeking an enthusiastic, analytical, and resourceful product manager to join our Investment Services Technology team, partnering closely with the Compliance team, based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. This position offers the opportunity for broad exposure to the firm’s trading, operations, and software development groups, as well as the chance to manage real-time issues related to the firm’s expanding suite of global investment products in a dynamic, constantly evolving regulatory environment. The role offers an inclusive and dynamic environment, with a focus on improving technology for efficiency, control, and scalability. The ideal candidate will bring exceptional product management fundamentals, experience in process optimization and workflow automation, and the judgment to operate effectively in a highly regulated and confidential environment with diverse stakeholders.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
You will drive technological solutions that support critical compliance functions across the firm, collaborating with cross-functional teams — engineering, design, business, and other front- and back-office partners — to develop and launch new products and features. You will develop and maintain a strategic product roadmap that aligns with the firm's overall goals and evolves continuously based on user feedback, prioritization, and other factors while working with senior leadership in Compliance. You will also partner closely with the business to understand their needs, define product requirements, scope open-ended projects, and conceptualize effective solutions across a broad range of functional areas, including pre-trade compliance and trade-restriction management, position-limit monitoring, trade surveillance, and regulatory and transaction reporting. Additionally, you will conduct technical design and architecture reviews to ensure alignment with the roadmap and end-user needs and partner with engineering to address technical challenges and deliver on time and to specification. You will evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, replace legacy and vendor systems with scalable in-house platforms, and develop AI- and data-enabled tools for monitoring, detection, and reporting — balancing near-term regulatory and operational needs against long-term strategic and architectural objectives, often building scalable infrastructure in areas with limited existing technology while serving as a senior point of coordination for compliance technology transformation. Furthermore, you will monitor product usage and feedback to identify areas for improvement and address technical debt in a timely manner, maintain product documentation (requirements documents, user guides, and more), conduct training and enablement as a subject-matter expert for the product suite, and manage product launches and backlogs — prioritizing features and enhancements based on end-user feedback and business needs.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, a related field, or an MBA, with 8+ years of product management experience, preferably within the financial services or investment management industry
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical and operational concepts clearly, influence decision-making through both meetings and written artifacts, and engage effectively with diverse stakeholder groups
* Excellent analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities, with proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques to generate product insights, prioritize initiatives, measure outcomes, and guide product strategy
* Proven adaptability in managing changing priorities, with robust project and delivery management skills in dynamic environments
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and business teams, translating nontechnical needs into clear requirements while balancing competing stakeholder priorities, building consensus, and delivering customer-focused outcomes
* A high degree of attention to detail and structured problem-solving abilities, with a consistent focus on quality, risk awareness, and operational excellence
* Hands-on experience owning and delivering technology products end-to-end in Agile environments, from product vision and discovery through backlog management, iterative delivery, launch, scaling, and ongoing maturation
* Demonstrated expertise in workflow automation and process optimization, applying structured approaches and tools to improve efficiency, transparency, and control
* A solid understanding of operational workflows within hedge funds and investment management firms, including how controls, data integrity, and regulatory considerations shape technology and product design

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Exposure to the investment management or hedge fund domain, with familiarity with pre-trade compliance, trade restrictions, position limits, trade surveillance, or regulatory and transaction reporting
* Experience partnering closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk, or other control functions to define requirements and deliver workflow-driven, compliant technology solutions

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PMComplyTechOct26

jobs.title: Senior, Delivery Product Owner - Tax Trasformation office - Hyderabad
jobs.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Senior Delivery Product Owner - Hyderabad
  
  
If you are energized by solving complex business problems through technology and want to help shape the future of global tax delivery, consider joining the US Tax Transformation technology team. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in Deloitte’s digital transformation by helping bring innovative products, capabilities, and experiences to life for our tax professionals and stakeholders around the world. You will work at the intersection of business, technology, and execution—partnering across teams to support high-impact initiatives that improve how we operate, serve clients, and create value at scale.
  
  
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option.
  
  
we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Delivery Product Owner Lead, you will play an important role in advancing product priorities across Deloitte Tax & Legal’s technology transformation portfolio. You will collaborate closely with Delivery Product Owners, product leadership, business stakeholders, and technology teams to help translate business needs into delivery-ready features, validate quality through detailed review and testing, and support the successful rollout of product capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to contribute across the full product lifecycle—from requirements refinement and acceptance criteria review to prioritization support, deployment readiness, process documentation, and end-user enablement. The required candidate is highly detail-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and energized by working across teams and domains in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Additional responsibilities include:
  
  

* Collaborate with Delivery Product Owners and development teams to help refine feature priorities, requirements, acceptance criteria, and expected business outcomes.
* Support prioritization discussions by organizing inputs, surfacing dependencies, and helping evaluate business value, risk, and readiness.
* Collaborate with the Technical Product Owners and broader team on scope, sequencing, sprint planning, feature readiness, deployment preparation, and progress tracking.
* Help build and apply cross-domain knowledge to work effectively across functional areas, connect related impacts and dependencies, and help sustain continuity as priorities evolve.
* Review bugs, support tickets, and business requests in depth to assess impact, clarify issues, and help prepare recommendations for prioritization and resolution.
* Support in executing regular sprint testing, Program Increment testing, and hands-on feature validation to help ensure functionality aligns with product specifications and user needs.
* Support the Program Increment demo and other showcase events by helping prepare features and validate readiness for demonstration.
* Contribute to process documentation, learning guides, and other end-user materials that support adoption, readiness, and ongoing operational effectiveness.
* Track product-related risks, issues, and defects, escalate concerns as needed, and adapt effectively to evolving priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**The Team**
Deloitte Tax LLP's Tax Transformation Office (TTO) is responsible to provide support for the design, development, and deployment of innovative, enterprise technology, tools, and standard processes to support the delivery of tax services. The TTO team focuses on enhancing Deloitte Tax LLP’s ability to provide comprehensive, value-added, and efficient tax services to our clients. It is a dynamic team with professionals of varying backgrounds from tax technical, technology development, change management, Six Sigma, and project management. The team consults and executes on a wide range of initiatives involving process and tool development and implementation including training development, engagement management, tool design, and implementation.
  
  
**Location –**
Hyderabad & Gurugram
  
  
**Shift Time –**
11 am to 8 pm or 2 pm to11 pm IST
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Required 6+ years experience
* 3+ years of experience supporting product delivery, business analysis, project coordination, or technology implementation teams.
* 3+ years supporting large-scale, full-lifecycle system implementation or modernization projects involving complex technical integrations, APIs, and middleware.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to review functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and defects thoroughly and identify business impacts, gaps, risks, and dependencies.
* Experience supporting testing activities, validating feature readiness, and contributing to process documentation, learning materials, or end-user enablement resources.
* Ability to synthesize information across stakeholders, modules, and workstreams to support well-informed product and support decisions.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and follow through on execution details.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, manage ambiguity, and adapt quickly to changing priorities.
* Curiosity, sound judgment, and a proactive mindset for working across teams, identifying issues early, and helping move priorities forward.
* Experience using development, design, and IT service management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps (AzDo), JIRA, ServiceNow, Sketch, Abstract, Figma) for ticketing, feature management, and tracking work across the delivery lifecycle.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams to apply Artificial Intelligence solutions to solve business problems.
* Understanding of LLMs, RAGs, Optical Character Recognition, and how these can be leveraged to solve business problems.
* Passionate interest in Generative and Agentic Artificial Intelligence.
* Agile and project management certifications preferred (e.g., SAFe Agilist, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMP, Lean Six Sigma)
* Ability to perform job responsibilities within a hybrid work model that may requires professionals to co-locate in person 2–3 days per week.
* Ability to travel up to 20%, on average, based on the need of the program and the work you do.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Techdome**
Techdome is a product engineering company that builds AI that works in the real world, not just in demos. Our teams of engineers, designers, and AI specialists deliver LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, conversational assistants, and workflow automation for enterprises in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Every product we ship is built to pass security reviews, integrate with existing systems, and meet compliance requirements from day one.
  
  
**The Role**
Anyone can get a GenAI prototype working in a week. Getting it to survive a security audit, hold its accuracy under real traffic, and stay profitable at scale is the hard part, and that is the part you will own.
  
  
As a Technical Product Manager at Techdome, you will guide AI products from the first client conversation to launch and beyond. You are the person who spots the vague requirement, the missed handoff, or the lurking risk while fixing it is still cheap.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
**Shaping the product**

* Turn a client’s rough idea into a clear product definition with scope, milestones, timelines, and budget.
* Understand each client’s industry, regulations, and compliance obligations, and convert them into requirements engineers can build from without guesswork.

**Taking GenAI to production**

* Partner with ML engineers to harden LLM, RAG, agent, and automation prototypes into reliable, scalable, safe systems.
* Define and track the metrics that decide success in production: accuracy, latency, evaluation scores, and cost per query.
* Make sure each AI feature connects to client systems through APIs and meets enterprise standards for security, privacy, and uptime.

**Keeping everyone aligned**

* Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so every handoff is explicit and nothing falls through.
* Plan team capacity and keep every party accountable to their commitments.
* Manage relationships with partners such as LLM and cloud providers.

**Managing risk and communication**

* Run formal change control whenever scope, timeline, or budget shifts.
* Surface delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks early: hallucinations, prompt injection, data leakage, bias, and runaway costs.
* Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and keep clients and leadership informed, with no surprises.
* Use AI tools yourself to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 2+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and on budget.
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally shipping an LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a practical grasp of the AI lifecycle and its risks.
* A record of leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps.
* Working knowledge of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, and tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Enough technical depth in the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD to challenge estimates and earn engineers’ respect.
* Sound judgment on risk, change, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Clear written and spoken communication, including with senior client executives.

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, guardrails, and cost optimization.
* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Domain experience in FinTech or Healthcare.
* Cross-industry exposure and the curiosity to pick up a new domain fast.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clients trust you. They get honest updates, early warnings, and no surprises.
* Engineers trust you. Your requirements are clear, your estimates are fair, and handoffs don’t leave them guessing.
* Risks surface early. Hallucination, data leakage, and cost issues are caught before launch, not after.
* Products reach production. AI features go live within budget, with accuracy, latency, and cost per query tracked and holding steady.
* The way we work improves. You leave behind at least one process, template, or habit that makes the next project easier.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Alpha Product, AVP
jobs.description:
**Role Summary**
The Business Analyst (BA) for the Alpha Index HUB (AIH) is a key contributor within the Product Organization, responsible for translating business, operational, and client needs into clear, actionable product requirements. The role supports the design, build, testing, and rollout of scalable index and benchmark data capabilities that are critical to Alpha’s data platform.
  
  
This position works closely with Product Owners, Engineering, Quality Assurance (QA), Operations, and third‑party data vendors to ensure product enhancements are well‑defined, operable, auditable, and aligned with Alpha product strategy and delivery standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product & Requirements Management**

* Partner with Product Owners to define, document, and refine product requirements aligned with Alpha Index HUB strategy and roadmap.
* Lead requirements elicitation through stakeholder interviews, workflow analysis, and data analysis.
* Produce high‑quality artifacts including Business Requirements Documents (BRDs), functional and non‑functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure requirements are clear, testable, and traceable through development and testing phases.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration**

* Act as the primary liaison between Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and external vendors.
* Facilitate discussions to ensure shared understanding of scope, dependencies, risks, and expected outcomes.
* Work closely with Operations teams to incorporate operational workflows, controls, and exception handling into product requirements.

**Delivery & Execution Support**

* Support Agile delivery activities including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and sprint reviews.
* Define detailed acceptance criteria, covering positive, negative, and edge‑case scenarios, to enable effective QA and UAT/CUAT execution.
* Participate in testing activities and support validation of delivered functionality against business intent.

**Operational Readiness & Risk Management**

* Ensure product requirements address data quality, auditability, operational transparency, and control considerations.
* Contribute to the definition of dashboards, status indicators, and monitoring frameworks that support daily operational validation and issue detection.
* Assist with documentation and communication of field definitions, status meanings, and operational behaviors to reduce ambiguity and risk.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, enhance usability, and improve operational efficiency.
* Support ongoing evolution and maturity of Alpha Index HUB capabilities in alignment with broader Alpha product and platform initiatives.

**Experience**
**Required Qualifications:**

* 15+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, with level determined by role (BA, BA II, Senior BA).
* Experience working in a product‑led or Agile/Scrum delivery environment.
* Proven experience producing BRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to translate complex technical and data concepts into clear business requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
* Effective stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
* Hands‑on experience writing and reviewing SQL queries to support data analysis, validation, and issue investigation.
* Working knowledge of running, monitoring, and validating processes in the Charles River Development (CRD) environment, including awareness of upstream/downstream dependencies, batch processing, and operational workflows.

**Preferred Domain Knowledge**

* Experience with financial services, index, benchmark, or market data platforms.
* Familiarity with large‑scale data pipelines, dashboards, or operational monitoring tools.
* Understanding of data governance, controls, and audit considerations.

**Reporting & Alignment**

* Reports into the Alpha Product Organization.
* Works in close partnership with Alpha Index HUB Product Owners, Engineering leads, QA teams, and Operations stakeholders.
* Embedded within product delivery cadence, including sprint planning, refinement, and release activities.

**Measures of Success**

* Requirements are clearly defined, consistently understood, and require minimal rework.
* Engineering and QA teams can deliver features efficiently with reduced clarification cycles.
* Operations teams gain improved visibility, consistency, and confidence in Alpha Index HUB processing.

jobs.title: Digital Solution Designer
jobs.description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Divami**

Divami is a design partner to product companies working on hard, high-stakes problems in AI-first platforms, enterprise SaaS, financial products, and category-defining tools. Our clients do not come to us because their designs need polish. They come to us because their product needs to become a decision engine rather than a well-styled interface, and we turn strategy into shipped work with the frameworks to make it repeatable.

**The role**

You would own the design solution across a client engagement end-to-end. That work starts before the brief, in the effort of framing what the actual problem is. It runs through information architecture, key decision moments, edge cases, and the invisible logic tying them together. And it continues past the handover into the health of the client relationship itself. You would be the person clients trust to sharpen their thinking rather than just deliver against it, and you would produce frameworks other people at Divami reuse without rework.

**What you’ll own**

* **Client success, not just deliverables.**
  You measure your work by renewal, expansion, and satisfaction rather than by whether the file was handed off on time. Accounts grow because of your ownership.
* **The problem before the solution.**
  You proactively close gaps in user or business understanding before anyone flags them. If something is fuzzy, you name it and go after it, rather than waiting for the brief to catch up.
* **The whole solution, not just the screens.**
  Information architecture, key decision moments, edge cases, empty states, and the invisible logic tying them together.
* **Direction, not just execution.**
  You shape client or product direction through design thinking and innovation judgment. When the situation calls for it, you push for disruptive or category-defining solutions rather than defending against safe defaults.
* **Design rationale others can rely on.**
  You document trade-offs, decisions, and the reasoning behind them so the next person on the account is not starting from zero.
* **Reusable IP.**
  You produce frameworks, patterns, and playbooks that other designers at Divami pick up and use as they are. Your work compounds beyond your own engagements.
* **The room.**
  You handle direct client pushback with reasoning rather than defensiveness. You walk into leadership presentations without a safety net and walk out with alignment.
* **The bench.**
  You coach other designers in business-first thinking, disruptive versus incremental framing, and client handling. Designers around you level up because you are on the account.

**How you’ll think**

* **Problems get sharpened before they get solved.**
  You find the 20 percent that drives 80 percent of the value, and you name it clearly enough that everyone on the account can see the same problem.
* **Outcomes are visible at the moment of decision.**
  Every screen should tell the user and the business what happens next, and why. If the outcome is invisible, the design is not done.
* **Reasoning is portable.**
  Trade-offs get documented, decisions get explained, and the thinking behind a call is captured so the next person picks up where you left off.
* **Disruptive or incremental is a choice, not a default.**
  You know when to push for the category-defining answer and when the safe one is genuinely the right call. You can defend both.
* **Client success is a design metric.**
  Renewal, expansion, and satisfaction sit inside how you measure your own work, not outside it.
* **Multiplication over addition.**
  Your best work compounds through the frameworks others use, not through the individual files you personally shipped.

**The craft**

* **UX and product design mastery.**
  Information architecture, interaction patterns, decision flows, edge cases, and design systems. Craft you can defend on principle rather than just on intuition.
* **Business fluency.**
  Reading the shape of a business, sizing an opportunity, and sizing the risk of a design choice. You can talk to a CXO in their language, not just yours.
* **Facilitation.**
  Workshops, alignment sessions, and co-creation with clients. You can hold a room when the room disagrees.
* **Executive presence.**
  Walking a leadership team through a hard call without breaking rapport, and reframing the conversation when the reasoning holds up.
* **Framework thinking.**
  Turning specific learnings from one engagement into reusable IP that helps the whole practice get better.
* **Written and visual communication that lands.**
  Strategy docs, decision memos, walkthroughs, and slides that carry an argument on their own.

**Signals we look for**

These are patterns we watch for in how you talk about past work rather than items to tick off a checklist.

* **You describe a project by its client outcome.**
  The deliverable list is the least interesting part of the story you tell.
* **You can point to a moment you disagreed with a client.**
  You held the line with reasoning, and it changed the direction of the work.
* **You have produced something others still use.**
  A framework, a playbook, a decision pattern, or a system that other designers pick up without rework.
* **When you describe ambiguity, you describe how you closed it,**
  not how you flagged it.
* **You have a view on when to build the incremental thing**
  and when to push for the disruptive one. You can defend both calls.
* **You measure your work by what happened after it shipped,**
  not by how it looked at handoff.

**Qualifications**

* **4 to 8 years**
  designing digital products across SaaS, enterprise, fintech, or platforms with real complexity. Meaningful time in senior IC or lead roles.
* **A portfolio of decisions, not just artifacts.**
  Case studies that show how you moved from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution, and where you traded off.
* **Evidence of account ownership.**
  Concrete examples of relationships you grew, renewed, or expanded because of how you showed up, not just because of what you shipped.
* **Executive-room confidence.**
  You can present to a CXO, hear a hard pushback, and respond with reasoning that reframes the conversation without getting defensive.

**Why this role**

* **Ownership that is real.**
  You own the account, the outcome, and the direction, not just a Figma file.
* **A new domain every quarter.**
  AI-first platforms, enterprise tools, financial products, and industry-defining software. Range that compresses years of learning.
* **Frameworks that are actually used.**
  Divami’s methodology (VEDA), empathy-led frameworks, and outcome-driven approaches we have validated across real client work.
* **Room to shape how we work,**
  not just what we ship. If you have opinions about how design should be practiced, we want them on the table.
* **A bench of people**
  who take craft and business seriously in equal measure.

The Digital Marketing Supervisor will be responsible for developing, executing, optimizing, and reporting on digital marketing campaigns designed to drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, and revenue growth across FinTech, gaming, sports betting, and other digital products. This role requires a combination of performance marketing, growth marketing, social media, content, SEO, CRM, analytics, conversion optimization, and campaign management. The Digital Marketing Supervisor will work closely with Product, Sales, Business Development, Compliance, Customer Support, Technology, Design, and Management teams to ensure marketing campaigns are commercially effective while complying with applicable laws, platform policies, responsible gaming requirements, financial-services regulations, and internal compliance standards. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, commercially minded, creative, data-driven, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving digital environment.

**Key Objective Of The Role**

The primary objective of this position is to build and execute a measurable digital growth engine that:

* Generates qualified customer acquisition.
* Increases registrations and verified accounts.
* Drives first-time deposits and transactions.
* Increases customer lifetime value.
* Improves customer retention and engagement.
* Builds strong digital brand visibility.
* Supports product launches and promotional campaigns.
* Improves conversion rates across digital channels.
* Reduces customer acquisition costs.
* Increases return on advertising spend.
* Develops scalable digital acquisition channels.
* Strengthens the company's competitive position within FinTech, gaming, and betting markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

Digital Marketing Strategy

Develop and implement comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with the company's commercial and growth objectives.

Responsibilities include:

* Develop annual, quarterly, and monthly digital marketing plans, create, implement and manage content aligning the plan.
* Translate business objectives into measurable digital marketing campaigns.
* Identify new customer acquisition opportunities and digital channels.
* Conduct competitor and market analysis.
* Monitor industry trends across FinTech, gaming, sportsbook, payments, and digital entertainment.
* Develop customer acquisition and retention strategies.
* Identify target customer segments and develop channel-specific strategies.
* Develop customer personas and audience segmentation.
* Establish campaign objectives, budgets, KPIs, and expected ROI.
* Develop growth strategies for new markets and geographic territories.
* Support market-entry campaigns and localized digital marketing initiatives.
* Continuously test and improve acquisition strategies.

Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising

Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize paid digital advertising campaigns.

The specialist will be responsible for:

* Managing paid search, display, social, video, native, affiliate, and programmatic campaigns where permitted.
* Developing customer acquisition campaigns across relevant advertising platforms.

* Scaling profitable campaigns while controlling acquisition costs.
* Working with designers and copywriters to produce high-performing advertising creatives.
* Continuously testing new messaging, offers, formats, audiences, and channels.

For FinTech, gaming, and betting campaigns, the specialist must ensure advertising activities are conducted only in permitted markets and in accordance with applicable advertising-platform rules and regulatory requirements.

Fintech Marketing

* Digital wallets.
* Payment applications.
* Payment gateways.
* Merchant payment solutions.
* Card products.
* Money-transfer services.
* Foreign exchange services.

jobs.description:
**Senior Platform Engineer (AI Gateway, Identity & Observability)**

**Agentic AI Platform | Financial Services | Full-time**

*Experience: 8+ years overall, including 5+ years hands-on API platform, identity or observability engineering*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
==================

We are building an enterprise agentic AI platform for a financial services client: the runtime, gateway, developer tooling and data interfaces that internal engineering teams will use to build and run AI agents in production.

You will build the control plane every agent passes through, regardless of where that agent runs. That means three connected things: the AI gateway that fronts all model traffic, the identity and registration path that governs which agents are allowed to call it, and the observability plane that makes the whole fleet visible and attributable.

These are deliberately held together in one position rather than split. The gateway is where identity is enforced and where much of the telemetry originates, so an engineer who understands only one of the three will build seams into what should be a single plane. You will be expected to work across all three, with depth in at least one and real working competence in the others.

This work is also the most time-critical on the platform: an external engineering team needs the gateway carrying production traffic early in the engagement, and the interface published to them cannot change afterwards.

This is a hands-on engineering position on a small, senior delivery team. It is not an oversight or coordination role.

**INDICATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES**
===============================

*The platform is being designed as the engagement progresses, so responsibilities will evolve. Indicative, and not limited to:*

**? Deliver the AI gateway** that routes model traffic across cloud-hosted models, other providers and on-premises inference, presenting one consistent, provider-agnostic interface to every consuming agent.

**? Implement gateway policy:** routing and backend pools, token-based rate limiting and quotas, retries, failover and circuit breaking, caching, and request and response transformation.

**? Harden an existing service for production** and run a controlled migration to the long-term gateway, moving consumers across without changing the contract they already integrated against.

**? Build the agent identity and registration path:** workload or service identity for agents, registration on deployment, and the promotion gate that governs what reaches production. Full automation is not assumed; part of the work is automating what can be automated and designing a clean, documented path for the steps that require human approval.

**? Design and implement the telemetry schema** and the OpenTelemetry pipelines that carry it, spanning agents in every runtime, so traces are consistent and attributable to an owning team.

**? Build the fleet view** showing each agent, its owner, version, environment, health and consumption, including the identifiers that make usage chargeable back to consuming teams.

**? Own the reliability view of the platform:** defining what good telemetry looks like, verifying that traces are complete and correctly attributed across every runtime, setting service level indicators and objectives for the gateway and the agent fleet, and building the alerting that surfaces failures, latency regressions and cost anomalies before consuming teams report them.

**? Apply guardrails at the gateway,** including content safety policy and a callout path to custom filtering services.

**? Establish the network and integration paths** the control plane depends on, including private connectivity or controlled egress to observability backends and third-party services, DNS and certificate handling, and the security review each path requires.

**? Load test and prove the gateway** under realistic production volume, and produce the runbooks and operational documentation the client will run it from.

**MUST HAVE**
=============

**? 5+ years hands-on engineering across API platforms, identity or observability,** with production depth in at least one and working competence in the others. All three areas are in scope for this position.

**? 4+ years building and operating API gateways in production:** routing, policy authoring, rate limiting and quotas, authentication, transformation and versioning. Azure API Management is strongly preferred; comparable depth in Apigee, Kong or an equivalent enterprise gateway is acceptable.

**? 3+ years enterprise identity and access engineering:** OAuth2, OpenID Connect and JWT validation, service principals and workload or managed identity, and secrets management using an enterprise vault.

**? 3+ years hands-on OpenTelemetry** or equivalent distributed tracing: instrumentation, collectors, resource attributes, span design, and trace, metric and log pipelines.

**? 3+ years in a site reliability, production engineering or platform operations role,** or equivalent hands-on responsibility for a service other teams depend on: service level objectives and error budgets, alerting design, on-call and incident response, and post-incident analysis. This position owns whether the telemetry is trustworthy, not only whether it is being collected.

**? 2+ years working with LLM or AI workloads in production,** including model routing across providers, token-based limits and quotas, streaming responses, content filtering, and how inference cost accrues and is attributed.

**? Experience with LLM observability tooling,** such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize or an equivalent platform, including how agent traces differ from conventional application traces.

**? 3+ years production API operations:** failover, circuit breaking, caching, load testing to prove capacity, and incident response for a service other teams depend on.

**? 2+ years integrating third-party or self-hosted services into an enterprise network,** including private connectivity or controlled egress, DNS resolution, TLS and certificate management, and working the firewall and security review needed to get each path approved.

**? Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure** on at least one major hyperscaler: networking, identity, container platforms and infrastructure-as-code.

**? Programming competence** in Python, C# or an equivalent language, sufficient to build and maintain policy extensions, callout services and instrumentation libraries.

**PREFERRED**
=============

**? Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry observability and Azure Monitor or Application Insights,** including agent tracing, continuous evaluation and how a managed observability plane compares with a self-hosted one such as Langfuse. This platform may run one, the other, or both, and the choice is still open.

**? Azure API Management depth,** including policy expressions, reusable policy fragments and the AI or LLM policy set.

**? Microsoft Entra ID experience,** including managed identity, app registrations and conditional access.

**? Experience with reliability engineering for AI or machine learning systems,** including quality regression detection, drift monitoring or evaluation-driven alerting.

**? Familiarity with emerging agent identity models** and how agent-to-service authentication differs from conventional service-to-service patterns.

**? Experience implementing chargeback or showback** for a shared platform service.

**? Content safety or guardrail services,** such as Azure AI Content Safety, or custom filtering and moderation services.

**? Enterprise workflow integration,** such as ServiceNow APIs for approval-driven provisioning.

**? Experience in financial services or another regulated industry,** where security review governs the pace of change.

**? Familiarity with agent frameworks** and how agents consume model endpoints, tools and memory.
