jobs.title: Global Head of Financial Cloud Product
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior product leader to lead our Internal Platform Product organization and build the systems that enable our financial and digital-asset businesses to operate efficiently, reliably, and at scale.

You will own the product strategy, architecture, roadmap, and team development for internal platform products spanning payments and assets, user and security systems, CRM, customer engagement, and multi-jurisdiction compliance infrastructure. Your mandate is to turn fragmented business requirements into coherent, reusable capabilities and move the organization from requirement-taking and feature delivery to end-to-end ownership of business outcomes.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a senior product leader who combines technical product judgment, financial-services knowledge, and commercialization experience to turn existing financial and digital-asset technology capabilities into enterprise products for external customers.

Financial Cloud aims to provide digital-asset and Web3 technology infrastructure to traditional financial institutions and other enterprise customers. Starting with customer needs, you will determine which capabilities, including trading technology, wallets, and custody-related technology, should be productized first. You will establish a focused product proposition, a viable commercial model, and a repeatable delivery approach, progressing from customer validation toward sustainable growth.

**What You Will Own**

* **Target customers and initial use cases.**
  Conduct customer discovery and market validation to identify priority customer segments, critical problems, buying motivations, and decision-makers. Select a focused initial product and use case rather than commercializing every available capability at once.
* **Financial Cloud product strategy.**
  Turn underlying technology into products that customers can evaluate, purchase, integrate, and use over time. Define the product portfolio, module catalog, value proposition, functional boundaries, API contracts, and roadmap.
* **Enterprise productization.**
  Partner with technical teams to define tenant and data isolation, access controls, configuration, auditability, APIs and SDKs, customer-facing management interfaces, monitoring, and operational requirements. Choose appropriate hosted, private, or other deployment models based on validated customer needs.
* **Commercial models.**
  Work with sales, finance, and relevant teams on product packaging, pricing, and billing. Validate willingness to pay, implementation economics, and ongoing service costs. Support presales, pilots, and the definition of product scope and commitments in customer contracts.
* **First-customer adoption.**
  Partner with sales, solution, and delivery teams to move customers through proof of concept, pilot, acceptance, and production use. Define clear success criteria and turn customer learning into product improvements without allowing customization to expand without limits.
* **Repeatable delivery.**
  Establish the boundary between standard products and customization. Improve documentation, onboarding, implementation standards, version compatibility, and lifecycle management to reduce per-customer delivery effort and improve the customer experience.
* **Technology-provider boundaries.**
  Work with legal, compliance, security, and architecture teams to clarify service scope, data and access responsibilities, key-control responsibilities, customer regulatory obligations, and service commitments. Ensure product design and commercial representations remain consistent with approved activities.
* **Team and investment priorities.**
  Build a product team suited to the zero-to-one stage and lead cross-functional execution. Align with the Internal Platform product leader on capability reuse, engineering dependencies, and priorities, avoiding customer-specific duplication of core systems.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Senior enterprise product experience, with end-to-end ownership of product definition, delivery, and commercialization from zero to one. You can explain how you selected customers, established product boundaries, and validated paid demand.
* Experience building platform or technical products such as financial infrastructure, developer platforms, API products, enterprise SaaS, financial cloud, payment infrastructure, or digital-asset infrastructure.
* A track record commercializing products for external enterprise customers, with an understanding of procurement, security reviews, pilots, contracts, deployment, acceptance, and ongoing service requirements.
* The ability to translate complex technology into customer value and engage deeply with engineering on architecture boundaries, APIs, data isolation, deployment models, and non-functional requirements.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Product Development
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Custody Product Manager**
**The opportunity & role purpose**
Emirates NBD Capital Custody is building a larger, more connected custody franchise combining high-touch local service, regional and international market access, the wider Emirates NBD ecosystem and institutional-grade control. We are seeking a commercially minded Product Manager to turn this ambition into a prioritized, scalable and profitable product roadmap.
  
  
**Role purpose**
Own the end-to-end Custody product agenda across strategy, proposition, commercial performance, governance and delivery. The role will optimize existing services, expand the product set and support new business across priority client segments.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
Product strategy and proposition
  
  

* Define and maintain a three-year product roadmap based on client demand, commercial value, strategic fit, delivery complexity, risk and scalability.
* Monitor market, competitor, regulatory and technology developments across local and global custody, sub-custody, funds, collateral and digital assets.
* Lead new-product development from concept through business case, approval, operating model, pricing, launch and adoption.
* Evaluate build, buy, partner and network options, ensuring solutions are commercially viable and operationally deliverable.

Commercial and business development
  
  

* Partner with Business Development, Relationship Management and the wider Emirates NBD franchise to convert client needs into viable solutions.
* Support pitches, RFPs, due diligence, pricing and solution design for new and existing clients.
* Create segment-led propositions, identify appropriate target clients and build profitability models for new products.
* Own product performance across Assets under Custody, revenue, pricing, yield, linked cash, FX, ancillary income and fee leakage.

Delivery, technology and client experience
  
  

* Act as product owner for priority change, defining scope, requirements, milestones, acceptance criteria, risks and benefits.
* Work with Technology and Operations to increase automation and straight-through processing across onboarding, settlement, corporate actions, reporting, reconciliations, billing and service quality.
* Advance client connectivity through portal, SWIFT, API, SFTP and configurable reporting; maintain a transparent backlog and escalate blockers early.

Governance and market engagement
  
  

* Ensure propositions meet product approval, legal, regulatory, tax, financial-crime, data, cyber-security and operational-risk requirements.
* Maintain a robust product-control framework with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Operations and Internal Audit.
* Manage relationships with exchanges, CSDs, ICSDs, global custodians and vendors; represent Emirates NBD Capital in relevant client and industry discussions.

**First 12 months**

* Diagnose - Validate the current product perimeter, client needs, operating constraints, economics, control gaps and in-flight change.
* Prioritize - Agree a funded three-year roadmap and decide what to accelerate, partner for, defer or stop.
* Deliver - Progress the highest-value capabilities, focusing on market connectivity, institutional and sub-custody readiness, digital servicing, reporting and automation.
* Commercialize - Package propositions by segment, equip client-facing teams and embed product-level pricing and profitability disciplines.
* Measure - Establish a monthly scorecard covering assets, revenue, profitability, linked cash, activity, adoption, delivery, service health and realised benefits.

Measures of success:
  
  

* Roadmap delivery against agreed milestones, budget and benefits.
* Incremental Assets under Custody and revenue enabled by new or enhanced products.
* Improved product yield, linked cash, ancillary wallet capture and pipeline conversion.
* Greater adoption of portal, SWIFT, API, SFTP and automated reporting.
* Reduced manual touchpoints, exceptions, service issues and operational risk.
* Timely product approvals, control remediation and effective change governance.

**Essential**
**Experience and capabilities**

* Minimum five years' relevant experience in custody, securities services, post-trade, transaction banking, market infrastructure or a related institutional financial-services business.
* Proven product-management experience across strategy, business cases, governance, requirements, delivery, launch and performance.
* Working knowledge of safekeeping, settlement, corporate actions, cash, FX, tax, reporting, reconciliations and custody operating models.
* Strong commercial judgement, linking client needs and product choices to pricing, profitability, assets, revenue and wider relationship value.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and work across Operations, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Sales and Relationship Management.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Highly desirable
  
  

* UAE or GCC custody experience and familiarity with SCA, UAE exchanges, CSDs and regional institutional clients.
* Knowledge of global-custody networks, ICSDs, sub-custody, fund settlement, collateral, securities financing or custody-linked lending.
* Exposure to TCS BaNCS, SWIFT, APIs, SFTP, client portals, institutional reporting, Agile delivery or digital-asset propositions.

The person we are looking for
  
  
You combine product depth with commercial energy. You can navigate operational details and bank governance while maintaining pace and ambition. You are credible with clients, precise with control functions, pragmatic with technology and comfortable presenting investment cases to senior management.
  
  
If you do not meet every requirement but believe you can materially contribute to our ambition, please apply with a covering letter explaining the value you would bring.
  
  
There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.
  
  
We’re one of the region’s most recognizable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.
  
  
At ENBD, we encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for positions that match their skills and capabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Payments Platform
jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.
  
  
Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.
  
  
The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.
  
  
**The opportunity**

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)
* Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases
* Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against
* Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale
* Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding
* Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business
* Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers
* Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers
* Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them
* Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect
* Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components
* Clear, structured writing. You turn complex system designs into docs that product, compliance and business stakeholders can all act on
* Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority
* Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

**Nice to haves**

* Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house
* Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms
* Familiarity with crypto, stablecoins or on/off-ramps
* Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

*Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.*
*Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.*
*We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*
**Our commitment**
Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.
  
  
We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

**Summary**

The
**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**
is responsible for the end to end product development, delivery, and continuous enhancement of consumer financial products, including credit cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, top ups, and related value added services.

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. **Product Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

* Lead the design and delivery of new products, product enhancements, and digital customer journeys from concept through implementation and post launch optimization.
* Define product requirements, customer journeys, business processes, and functional specifications in collaboration with Technology and Operations.

**Credit, Risk & Governance**

**Product Marketing & Customer Growth**

* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, utilization, retention, cross sell, and customer lifetime value.
* Use customer insights, behavioural data, and portfolio analytics to identify opportunities for targeted propositions and improved customer experiences.

**Stakeholder Management**

**Knowledge & Skill Requirements**

* Strong understanding of consumer credit, underwriting, pricing, portfolio risk, and lending economics.
* Good knowledge of card issuing, card processing, payment schemes, digital lending, credit decisioning, and digital onboarding platforms.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.
* Strong analytical, project management, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certification in Product Management, Agile, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.
* Proven track record of developing and launching products, enhancing existing propositions, and delivering measurable improvements in revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, or portfolio performance.

* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives involving digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, automation, or customer experience enhancement.

* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, preferably within the UAE or GCC.

* Experience delivering products with banks, payment rails or other regulated partners

jobs.title: Delivery Program Director
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

* Operational discipline and a data driven approach to managing a client portfolio.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, support tooling such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow, and customer success platforms such as Gainsight or equivalent.
* Technical enough to engage with Engineering on root causes across APIs, cloud platforms and mobile applications.
* Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve support and customer success at scale.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, banking products and the realities of running software in regulated financial institutions.
* Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person.
* Fluent English. French or Arabic is an advantage.

Education

* Degree in business, engineering, computer science or a related field. ITIL or customer success certification is a plus.

jobs.title: Client Consulting Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**Closing Date:**

11/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

jobs.title: Director/ Senior Director - Category (PnL / Product Lead)
Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
Payments work brilliantly when everything goes right. The real test is what happens when they do not. A payment may be rejected, delayed, returned or held; a customer may send funds to the wrong account; an international payment may need to be traced or recalled; or an operations team may need to investigate an ambiguous payment state across multiple systems and external institutions. Today these journeys can span payment rails, customer and banker channels, payment platforms, operational work queues, case-management tools, risk teams and external financial institutions. We want to fundamentally change that experience.
  
  
Within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew, we are shaping a channel-agnostic Payment Exception and Investigation capability that brings these journeys together. The ambition is one reusable product capability across Australian domestic and international payment exceptions - connecting customers, bankers, operations teams, payment platforms and external institutions while preserving clear system ownership and controls. This is an opportunity to build an enduring payments product, not simply deliver another workflow or operations screen. You will help shape a capability that can progressively move exception handling from manual investigation to intelligent assistance, straight-through processing and, ultimately, proactive exception prevention.
  
  
**Impact and Contribution:**
As Product Stream Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will lead the product vision, strategy and evolution of this capability within the Payments Servicing Solutions Crew. You will connect customer insight, operational pain points, payments expertise, enterprise priorities, technology possibilities and risk considerations into a clear product strategy and executable roadmap.
  
  
You will lead across related squads and partner closely with Product Leads, Product Managers, Engineering, Architecture, Payments Operations, Digital Channels, frontline teams, Financial Crime, Risk, Legal and Compliance. You will create alignment around shared outcomes, make evidence-based investment and sequencing trade-offs, and ensure the product is run safely and sustainably.
  
  
The product vision extends beyond a new workbench. It is about creating an intelligent payment exception orchestration capability that can ingest and correlate events from multiple rails and channels, create a consistent case and investigation journey, orchestrate controlled resolution actions, provide transparent status back to customers and colleagues, and use data and intelligence to improve both resolution and prevention.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for payment exceptions and investigations across domestic and international payments.
* Lead cross-squad prioritisation, sequencing and investment trade-offs, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk reduction, technology simplification and commercial outcomes.
* Build reusable product capabilities rather than point solutions for individual rails, channels, systems or operational teams.
* Deeply understand how exceptions arise across payment initiation, execution, settlement, investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments and servicing journeys.
* Shape simple experiences for retail and business customers, bankers/frontline colleagues, investigators and payment operations teams, with consistent status and required-action visibility across channels.
* Lead product outcomes for case and investigation management, event intake and correlation, workflow orchestration, operational work management, evidence and audit, communications and controlled resolution actions.
* Identify journeys that can move from manual handling to assisted resolution and straight-through processing, with clear policy, eligibility, approval and control boundaries.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to shape scalable APIs, event-driven integration, reusable channel experiences and clean ownership boundaries between servicing channels, exception orchestration and payment execution platforms.
* Explore practical applications of AI and agentic workflows for context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation planning, next-best-action, response drafting and cross-case root-cause intelligence.
* Ensure AI-enabled outcomes are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.
* Use customer, operational and product data to identify exception patterns and upstream causes, creating a prevention backlog that reduces avoidable exceptions over time.
* Define and own measurable outcomes including resolution time, STP rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness, colleague adoption and exception reduction.
* Coach and develop Product Leads and Product Managers, building strong product discipline and a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement.

**Essential Skills:**

* 14+ years of industry experience
* Bring significant product leadership experience, leading complex products or value streams from strategy through execution and value realisation.
* Have strong payments expertise, including domestic and/or international payments, processing, settlement and servicing.
* Understand payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and correspondent banking.
* Have experience across payment investigations and exceptions, including trace and recall, returns, repairs and failed or mistaken payments.
* Have built or transformed workflow, servicing, case-management or platform products within regulated financial services.
* Can turn fragmented processes and legacy journeys into scalable product capabilities, balancing long-term vision with pragmatic delivery.
* Have driven automation and straight-through processing across complex operational journeys.
* Bring strong commercial judgement and can make clear investment, prioritisation and scope trade-offs.
* Can influence across Product, Technology, Operations and Risk, embedding controls and operational resilience into product design.
* Are curious about AI and emerging technology, while distinguishing genuine customer and operational value from hype.
* Build high-performing teams and coach and develop product talent.

**Payments, Automation & Emerging Technology**
This is not an AI-first role. It is an opportunity to shape how automation and emerging technology can safely transform a complex, high-volume payments environment.
  
  

* Move journeys from manual handling toward intelligent assistance, bounded automation and straight-through processing.
* Determine where deterministic workflows are best and where AI can improve investigations, context-building and next-best actions.
* Explore agentic and orchestration approaches while retaining appropriate human oversight.
* Establish clear guardrails around approval, explainability, traceability, auditability, privacy and access.
* Use exception and outcome data to move from exception resolution toward exception prevention.

**The Mindset We’re Looking For**

* Think product, not project: Build enduring capabilities and measure outcomes, not just delivery.
* Start with the customer:

jobs.title: Business Head - BFSI
jobs.description:
Business Head – BFSI | OTPless

Bengaluru or Mumbai · On-site · 8–12 years

**ABOUT OTPLESS**

OTPless builds the authentication, identity and trust infrastructure for digital businesses. We power login and user journeys for Zepto, Meesho, Ixigo and ShareChat, we run 300Mn+ silent verifications a month, and we're backed by General Catalyst, FJ Labs, SIDBI, Amrish Rau and Kunal Shah. We were founded by the founding team at BharatPe.

Authentication is where we started — Smart Auth is live across some of India's largest consumer and financial businesses. Our next growth engine is OTPless Watch, a device and risk intelligence platform that combines device fingerprinting, app protection, telecom and IP signals, and identity data to help businesses spot suspicious activity and make better risk decisions. Watch sits right next to Smart Auth, so businesses get authentication and fraud intelligence from one place.

**THE ROLE**

We're hiring a Business Head to own the entire OTPless BFSI business — the full vertical, end to end, across Smart Auth, Watch and everything we take to market in financial services.

You'll own the BFSI P&L outright: the strategy, the revenue, the customers and the roadmap. That means growing and deepening our existing Smart Auth footprint in BFSI, and opening the next frontier with Watch — starting with fintechs and NBFCs, then banks and insurance. You'll find the market, prove the products, carry the number, and build the business.

You won't be starting from zero. Smart Auth is already live in production with Navi, Paytm and Bajaj, which gives you relationships, reference customers and a running start to expand across the vertical and pull Watch into live accounts.

This is a hands-on ownership role — you'll lead the biggest deals yourself and work directly with the CBO and the founders, with real influence over product, pricing and strategy.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* The business. The full BFSI P&L — strategy, revenue growth and ownership across the vertical. You decide which fintechs, NBFCs, banks and insurers to go after, grow the accounts we already have, build the relationships that matter across Product, Risk, Fraud and Business teams, and set the pricing and commercial models that make the motion repeatable.

* The market fit. Run discovery with real buyers, find the use cases where OTPless wins, and work directly with the Product and Engineering teams to turn what you hear into roadmap. Use our live Smart Auth relationships to expand accounts and pull Watch into them.

* The deals. Lead consultative engagements end to end — discovery, solution design, technical evaluation, POC, commercial close and expansion — across the full OTPless stack. Prove measurable outcomes, not demos.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

Above all, someone who can own and grow a BFSI business — a builder who carries revenue, closes senior deals and can be trusted with the full vertical. Beyond that, we're looking for:

Domain & experience

* 8–12 years across product, growth, strategy or business roles, with real ownership of revenue or outcomes
* Deep experience in fintech, payments, UPI, digital lending, NBFCs, banking or insurance, and a real grasp of the Indian BFSI ecosystem
* A track record on products or deals involving fraud, risk, trust and safety, identity, authentication or digital onboarding
* Live relationships inside fintechs and NBFCs; connections into banks and insurers are a plus

Product & technical depth

* You don't have to code, but you're technically credible — you can sit with an engineer, understand how it works, and shape what gets built
* Comfort with APIs, SDKs, device intelligence, fingerprinting, SIM binding, risk scoring and digital onboarding flows
* You can translate what a customer needs into product requirements, and work with Product and Engineering to get it built

Business & growth instinct

* You turn market opportunities into revenue — hunting new logos and growing the accounts you already have
* Strong consultative selling, senior stakeholder management and commercial negotiation
* An entrepreneurial streak — you can operate alone, build from nothing, and own the outcome end to end

**STRONG SIGNALS**

This is likely to fit people coming from:

* Payments & fintech: Juspay, Razorpay, PhonePe, Paytm, Cashfree, CRED
* Lending & NBFCs: Navi, KreditBee, Fibe, Lendingkart and other tech-led lenders
* Fraud, risk & identity: Bureau, SHIELD, Signzy, HyperVerge, IDfy, GoKwik
* Banks & financial institutions: product, digital banking, payments and fraud-risk leaders

We're especially keen on product, growth and strategy people who've worked close to business, tech and risk teams and now want to own a business, not a backlog.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 6 MONTHS)**

* A clear BFSI strategy and target-account universe across the full OTPless portfolio
* Existing Smart Auth accounts grown and deepened, with measurable revenue
* 5–10 lighthouse fintech/NBFC wins across Smart Auth and Watch, with banks and insurers seeded in the pipeline
* A repeatable business development and account-growth motion
* Validated high-value use cases that have moved the product roadmap
* Real cross-sell between Smart Auth and Watch

**WHY OTPLESS**

You'll own an entire vertical with real P&L responsibility, at the intersection of payments, identity and fraud — three of the spaces moving fastest in Indian financial services. You build on top of an authentication platform and customer base that already exist, not a blank page.

You'll work directly with the CBO and the founders — the founding team behind BharatPe — backed by General Catalyst, FJ Labs, SIDBI, Amrish Rau and Kunal Shah. It's early enough that you shape the business, the product and the commercial model, with the autonomy and ownership of a founder and the backing of a company that's already at scale.

If you're ready to move past managing a product and own a business, let's talk.

jobs.title: Head of Product, PhonePe Wealth
jobs.description:
**About PhonePe**
At PhonePe our vision is to provide financial inclusion to a billion Indians. Today we have made significant progress on this vision by making digital payments far simpler and ubiquitous than it has ever been. However we wish to make it so easy, safe, and universally accepted that people never feel the need to carry cash or cards again. And not just in Urban India. At PhonePe, our aim is to transform the entire Indian landscape so that every Indian, in every corner of the country, makes significant economic progress. Onwards and upwards! That is our goal.
  
  
**About PhonePe Invest**
PhonePe Invest is rebuilding trading and investing for India. It's a full-stack broking platform — stocks, F&O, ETFs, mutual funds, IPOs, and Wealth Baskets — with a research and intelligence layer (factor analysis on every stock, expert-curated baskets) sitting on top. It's a separate app from the main PhonePe one, and it's backed by PhonePe's reach, trust, and distribution.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Opportunity:**
As a Director of Product at PhonePe Invest, you will own and drive the roadmap for our PhonePe Invest products catering to for first time investors to seasoned traders. This is a hard but interesting product and design problem. You're working with regulated financial products, real money, and a spectrum of users that runs from a first-time investor buying their first stock to an active trader running F&O strategies. The job is to make something genuinely powerful feel calm and trustworthy — not to bolt more features onto a busy screen.
  
  
You will work with other pod members and a diverse set of stakeholders towards a collective set of objectives. We work on complex technology, scale while iterating quickly and have a bias for impact in everything we do. Leading our PhonePe Invest product portfolio, you will be working with leaders in PhonePe ecosystem to determine the portfolio product strategy. You will be responsible for evangelizing and aligning all the cross-functional stakeholders on the strategy and plans and work on the execution and delivery to realize the identified opportunity and impact.
  
  
You'll own all aspects of Product and Design for PhonePe Invest end to end. Today that means you, the craft, and a close partnership with Business, Engineering and regulated ecosystem.This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-a-distance one. As the product grows, you'll build and lead the team around it.
  
  
You'll set the Product and Design direction, ship the work yourself when it matters, and be the person accountable for the quality of the experience for all the users. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work alongside the broader PhonePe org.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**As a Director of Product, you will:**

* Define a portfolio product strategy from first principles that becomes the org’s reference point; drives multi-pod execution and measurable portfolio outcomes
* Identify and deliver multiple Annual Operating Plan-shaping bets; consistently make correct profitability vs growth calls across portfolio, shift business trajectory with durable levers (pricing, distribution, unit economics, cost-to-serve)
* Design pod-level org structure and capability plan that materially increases throughput and quality; shape cross-functional Hiring AOP with high accuracy; prevent bottlenecks before they form.
* Build a strong leadership bench; direct reports consistently progress levels. Establish pod-wide talent mechanisms with counterparts that raise performance across functions.
* Design and evolve the pod operating system (planning, decision forums, execution reviews, launch readiness, learning loops) with measurable improvements in reliability and speed.
* Demonstrate thought leadership and be the go to person for product decisions for internal and external stakeholders.
* Engage with external customers and stakeholders, communicate objectives and progress.
* Own the experience. Set the bar for what best looks like on PhonePe Invest, and hold it. Strategy, flows, visual craft, microcopy — you're accountable for all of it.
* Ship, don't just direct. Get into the file. Design the experience for our users e2e to give them maximum efficiency and wow during their financial, investment and trading journeys. Prototype to find the answer rather than arguing about it in a doc.
* Make complex things simple. Turn dense financial data and regulated flows into something a first-time investor trusts and a serious trader respects. This is the core craft of the job.
* Partner closely. Work shoulder to shoulder with Business and engineering as an equal. Bring the user's point of view to roadmap and tradeoff conversations early, not at the end.

**What we look for:**

* Excellent communication skills.
* At least 15+ years of experience in Product / Platform building and development.
* Strong business acumen and ability to partner with cross-functional teams.
* Contributes to business decisions regularly and proactively.
* Can build credibility via knowledge and judgment to persuade others.
* Conducts interviews for PM/SPM roles and for specific competencies.

**Additional Information**
**Culture:**
At PhonePe, we take extra care to make sure you give your best at work, Everyday! And creating the right environment for you is just one of the things we do. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. Being enthusiastic about tech is a big part of being at PhonePe. If you like building technology that impacts millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

jobs.title: Business Head - Navi UPI

**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

Since launching in August 2023, Navi UPI has grown from strength to strength to become India’s fourth-largest UPI TPAP. In a crowded market with large incumbents, Navi UPI has been able to capture a significant market share and win the loyalty of users on the back of a customer-first, product-led strategy. Our mission is clear: build on this foundation and become a leading and dominant player in India’s payments landscape.

**About the Role**

As Business Head, you will drive:

* The core acquisition engine of the group, bridging efforts across teams including product, growth, engineering, data and marketing; and
* The go-to-market strategy and execution of our to-be-launched PA (Payment Aggregator, i.e. merchant acquisition) business.

You will also act as the primary point of contact for our key partners and stakeholders including NPCI and work closely with our compliance, fraud, risk and engineering teams to ensure we deliver a stable and reliable experience to our customers. As a leader, you will be responsible for overseeing cross-functional efforts to build the Navi UPI user base, increase its loyalty and grow market share.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Proven experience in driving outcomes in business, sales, operations or other generalist roles;
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions and measure impact / ROI;
* Entrepreneurial mindset and work ethic with high ownership and comfort operating in a 0-to-1 setup;
* Sharp attention to detail and a strategic mindset for long-term process optimisation;
* Ability to think outside the box and be comfortable dealing with unstructured problem statements;
* Exceptional leadership, team management, collaboration and communication skills; and
* Adaptability to navigate the evolving payments landscape, leveraging new trends and technologies to drive innovation.

jobs.description:
The Role

Flipkart is looking for a high-impact leader to spearhead the growth of our Auto Loan Marketplace. As the

Senior Manager of Business Development, you will be the primary architect of our 2-Wheeler (2W) and

4-Wheeler (4W) financing ecosystem. You aren't just managing a product; you are building a scalable

business from the ground up within the Flipkart app, ensuring that millions of customers have seamless

access to vehicle credit.

Key Responsibilities

● Lender Onboarding: Identify, negotiate, and integrate with leading Banks, NBFCs, and Captive

Finance companies to build a diverse lending panel.

● OEM & Dealer Relations: Build strategic alliances with major 2W/4W manufacturers (OEMs) and

large dealer networks to integrate financing at the point of intent.

● Product Ecosystem: Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to build a frictionless

"Apply-to-Disburse" journey for users.

● Stakeholder Management: Ability to influence internal product teams and external C-suite

executives at banking institutions.

● Revenue Growth: Take full accountability for the Auto Loan P&L, focusing on Top-line

(Disbursement volumes) and Bottom-line (Commission/Fee income).

● Market Penetration: Design and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies to scale the business

across Pan India digitally.

● Incentive Design: Manage subvention programs and promotional budgets to drive conversion

without eroding margins.

● Entrepreneurial Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity and have the grit to build a vertical

in a fast-paced environment.

● Funnel Optimization: Deep-dive into the conversion funnel—from lead generation to loan

sanction—to identify and fix drop-offs.

● Risk & Quality: Work closely with the partners Risk team to ensure the lead quality meets lender

appetite while maintaining a healthy "Approval Rate."

● Analytical Rigor: You are a "Power User" of Excel. You don't just report numbers; you find the

story within them to drive strategy.

What We Are Looking For

● Experience: 6–10 years of experience, ideally in a FinTech, Digital Lending, or a high-growth

E-commerce environment. Direct experience in Auto Finance is a huge plus.

Qualifications:

Education: MBA in Finance, Banking or a related field.

Experience: 6 to 10 years of experience in lending operations, with at least 5 years in the Two-Wheeler

finance sector.

Why Join Flipkart Fintech?

You will be at the forefront of the "Credit Revolution" in India. With Flipkart's massive user base, you have

the unique opportunity to solve for credit under-penetration in the automobile sector using data and

technology at a scale very few companies globally can offer.

Note: This role requires a balance of "feet-on-street" partnership hustle and "office-at-desk" analytical

depth.

To succeed in this role – you should have the following: \*

● Strong understanding of the Indian two-wheeler market and lending landscape.

● Proficiency in financial modeling, budgeting, and forecasting.

● Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

● Ability to drive digital transformation and process automation in lending operations.

Mandatory Skills

Understanding of Two Wheeler & Four Wheeler Financing business, Ability to analyze data, Stakeholder

Management, Strong Problem Solving Skills, Strong Excel Skills

1. Strategic Partnerships & Marketplace Building

2. P&L Ownership & Scaling

3. Data-Driven Decision Making

We are looking for a techno-functional professional to join our Reg-Tech & Cyber Risk practice. The role sits at the intersection of technology, regulation, and compliance advisory requiring an individual who is equally at home reviewing IT systems and audit artefacts as they are interpreting RBI Master Directions and advising clients on compliance posture.

The successful candidate will work across regulatory compliance engagements covering the RBI IT Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance (ITGRCA) framework, IT Outsourcing and TPRM norms, Digital Lending guidelines, Payment and Settlement Systems regulations, and frameworks governing Payment Aggregators / Payment Gateways (PA/PG) and Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPI). This is a growth-track role with direct client interaction and practice development responsibilities.

  

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* 2-4 Years of experience in IT-GRC
* B.E. / BTech / B.Sc. (IT/CS/ECE) or BCom / BBA with strong technology orientation; MBA / MTech is an advantage.
* Certifications considered - CISA, CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, CRISC, CCSP

  

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Shall possess hands-on technical experience executing a diverse range of engagements, including IT General Controls (ITGC) audits, comprehensive Internal Audits of complex IT environments, and the evaluation/preparation of SOC reports.
* Shall independently drive and execute regulatory compliance audits spanning diverse financial entities, including Banks, NBFCs, Fintechs, Insurance Brokers, and Stockbrokers ensuring adherence to applicable RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI norms.
* Ability to critically evaluate technical evidence, identify inconsistencies, and detect control circumvention risks across applications, databases, and infrastructure.
* Shall independently verify that the organization’s IT strategy, policy frameworks, and Board level oversight (ITSC/ACB) strictly align with regulatory Master Directions and maintain a clear, independent reporting line for the CISO.
* Shall audit the security posture of the extended ecosystem, including third-party vendors, outsourced IT services.
* Capability to seamlessly bridge the gap between technical IT controls and broader regulatory expectations, translating complex cyber risks into clear business impacts.
* Shall validate the operational effectiveness of security monitoring (SOC), VAPT cycles, and BCP/DR readiness to ensure the institution can detect threats in real-time and recover from system failures within mandatory RPO/RTO targets.
* Strong understanding of the control environments surrounding complex payment systems, including Payment Aggregators/Payment Gateways (PA/PG), cross-border data flows, and third-party payment integrations.
* Supervise and review the fieldwork of senior associates/consultants, ensuring that audit working papers, test scripts, and documentation meet rigorous qualitative standards.
* Collaborating with IT process owners to design practical, risk-mitigating controls and actively tracking remediation plans to closure.
* Act as a key liaison during external regulatory inspections and statutory audits, facilitating clear communication between technical IT teams, external auditors, and senior management.

  

**Skills & Competencies:**

**Regulatory Knowledge — Essential**

* RBI IT Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance (ITGRCA) Master Direction
* RBI Master Direction on IT Outsourcing / Managing Risks in Outsourcing (NBFC / Banks)
* RBI Digital Lending Guidelines (2022 and subsequent updates)
* Payment and Settlement Systems (PSS) Act, 2007 and RBI DPSS frameworks
* Payment Aggregator / Payment Gateway (PA/PG) guidelines — Merchant onboarding, escrow, baseline security
* Prepaid Payment Instruments (PPI) Master Direction — wallet issuance, interoperability, KYC norms
* UPI ecosystem — NPCI operating guidelines, dispute resolution, fraud risk frameworks

  

**Technology & Control Domains**

* IT General Controls (ITGC) assessment — access management, change management, operations, BCP/DR
* Application controls review — input validation, processing controls, output reconciliation
* Cybersecurity frameworks — familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls
* Data protection and privacy — DPDP Act 2023 awareness; data classification and handling controls
* Third-party risk management (TPRM) — vendor assessment, contract review, SLA monitoring
* Cloud risk assessment — awareness of shared responsibility models, cloud-specific regulatory requirements

  

**Tools & Methodology**

* Proficiency in MS Excel (audit/risk workbooks, control matrices, scoring models)
* MS PowerPoint — client-facing deliverable and deck preparation
* Familiarity with GRC tools (e.g., SAP GRC, ServiceNow GRC, or similar) is an advantage
* Comfort with data analysis and log review as part of IT audit fieldwork

* Design, develop, test, and support **enterprise integrations and interfaces** across Finance Technology platforms.

* Develop and maintain **enterprise interfaces, APIs, batch integrations, and data movement processes**.
* Manage Finance data movement between source platforms, Finance applications, and downstream reporting or operational systems.
* Support **country rollouts and localization requirements**, including integration changes required for regional Finance processes.
* Analyze integration requirements, dependencies, data flows, and system impacts before implementation.
* Troubleshoot interface failures, data inconsistencies, and production integration issues.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes to improve integration reliability.
* Partner with Finance Technology, application development, architecture, product, infrastructure, and business teams to deliver integration requirements.
* Support testing activities including system integration testing, regression testing, deployment validation, and production verification.
* Maintain technical documentation covering integration architecture, interface specifications, data mappings, dependencies, and operational support procedures.
* Participate in production deployments and provide post-production support for critical integrations.
* Proactively identify integration risks, capacity constraints, and technical dependencies that could impact delivery timelines.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong hands-on experience with **enterprise application and system integration**.
* Experience designing and supporting **REST/SOAP APIs, web services, batch interfaces, file-based integrations, and data pipelines**.
* Strong understanding of **data integration, transformation, mapping, validation, and reconciliation**.
* Experience integrating Finance or ERP platforms with enterprise and downstream applications.
* Working knowledge of **SQL** and relational databases for data analysis and troubleshooting.
* Experience with integration/middleware platforms such as **MuleSoft, Informatica, Oracle Integration Cloud, Boomi, Kafka, or similar technologies**.
* Understanding of authentication and integration security concepts such as **OAuth, certificates, service accounts, and API security**.
* Experience troubleshooting complex production integration issues across multiple applications.
* Familiarity with CI/CD, source-control, release-management, and deployment practices.

Preferred Experience

* Experience supporting **Finance Technology, ERP, payments, banking, or financial services platforms**.
* Experience with **M&A system integration or technology onboarding programs**.
* Experience supporting global or multi-country technology implementations.
* Exposure to **Oracle ERP/EBS, financial data platforms, payment platforms, or similar enterprise Finance applications**.
* Experience working with geographically distributed engineering and business teams.
* Understanding of financial data flows, reconciliation, controls, and downstream reporting dependencies.

Qualifications

* Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Approximately **5+ years of experience** in application integration, middleware, enterprise interfaces, or related technology roles.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to independently investigate complex integration issues.
* Ability to manage multiple integration deliverables and priorities simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders.

Key Success Measures

The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Deliver integration requirements within committed project timelines.
* Maintain stable and reliable Finance Technology interfaces.
* Minimize integration-related production incidents and deployment failures.
* Reduce implementation backlog through timely development and issue resolution.
* Provide sufficient technical support capacity for strategic Finance initiatives
* Ensure effective knowledge transfer, technical documentation, and operational continuity.

jobs.description:

You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Risk, and Operations teams to develop and execute strategies that support sustainable growth while maintaining strong risk controls.

* Lead credit card strategy across acquisition, underwriting, credit line management, pricing, instalment programmes, and collections.
* Manage portfolio performance and drive sustainable, risk-adjusted growth.
* Develop and refine credit policies, risk appetite, decision frameworks, and portfolio guardrails.
* Monitor portfolio health, including delinquency, utilisation, profitability, customer behaviour, and vintage performance.

* Partner with cross-functional teams to design, test, and scale new credit strategies.

* Develop collections and recovery strategies to improve portfolio outcomes.

* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal governance standards.

Required:

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or a related field.
* 12+ years of experience in credit risk, portfolio management, credit analytics, or credit strategy within banking, lending, or fintech.

* Deep understanding of the consumer credit lifecycle, from acquisition through collections.
* Proven ability to manage portfolio performance and deliver strong risk-adjusted returns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with credit bureau data, scorecards, decision engines, and alternative data sources.
* Proven people leadership and stakeholder management experience.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.

Preferred:

* Exposure to credit policy, portfolio governance, or expected credit loss frameworks.
