jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.6 trillion and operations worldwide, and its Legal Department provides specialized legal support aligned to the firm's lines of business and corporate staff areas. Asset & Wealth Management is one of the largest asset and wealth managers in the world, serving institutional and retail clients through Asset Management and high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients through the Private Bank. The business offers global investment management across equities, fixed income, real estate, hedge funds, private equity, and liquidity, and provides trust and estate, banking, brokerage, and retirement services. The Legal Department is seeking an experienced lawyer to support cross-border efforts, focusing on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of asset and wealth management products and services, and helping document and communicate related legal and regulatory requirements.

This role is based in Mumbai, India, at the J.P. Morgan Mumbai Corporate Centre, and functionally reports to:

* A Managing Director and Associate General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United States
* An Executive Director and Assistant General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United Kingdom
* A local Asset & Wealth Management Legal supervisor in Mumbai

Job summary:

As an Associate Legal Counsel within Asset & Wealth Management Legal, you will support cross-border efforts with a primary focus on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of products and services. You will help drive documentation of cross-border laws and regulations and communicate related requirements to business stakeholders. You will partner with lawyers, compliance partners, business stakeholders, and external counsel to maintain clear, current, and usable guidance for the business.

Job responsibilities:

* Conduct the first review of new or updated legal opinions from external counsel and new or revised draft rules for the business to provide products and services on a cross-border basis, and facilitate periodic and ad hoc updates of existing materials based on legal or regulatory changes or business developments
* Draft summaries of updates to facilitate the review-and-approval process via an internal workflow tool
* Engage with external counsel, Asset & Wealth Management lawyers, Compliance, and business stakeholders to obtain and resolve feedback on updates
* Field stakeholders' basic queries concerning the materials and fact-specific queries
* Advise as the Legal Department's first point of contact on potential issues relating to cross-border materials
* Provide regular feedback to business stakeholders and cross-border forums on pending reviews
* Conduct additional research and assist on special projects as needed
* Create and enhance audit-ready processes in a highly regulated environment, including through the use of technology

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Demonstrate excellent English writing and communication skills
* Hold a law degree
* Be in compliance, prior to commencement of employment, with all relevant licensing requirements, including the requirements of the jurisdiction where the role will be located
* Be sufficiently well qualified to interpret and summarize external legal advice and articulate clear “rules of the road” for the business
* Operate as a self-starter who works collaboratively in a high-performing team, takes ownership of responsibilities and projects, and is results-oriented and flexible

* Demonstrate competence with Microsoft Office products, including Microsoft Excel, and the use of large language models and artificial intelligence
* Successfully complete a conflicts of interest clearance review prior to commencement of employment (applicable to all Legal Department roles)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Master of Laws (LLM) preferred
* 2–4 years of experience in financial services law
* Experience instructing and interacting with external counsel directly
* Experience working across jurisdictions and time zones

Morgan and Chase brands. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior product leader to lead our Internal Platform Product organization and build the systems that enable our financial and digital-asset businesses to operate efficiently, reliably, and at scale.

You will own the product strategy, architecture, roadmap, and team development for internal platform products spanning payments and assets, user and security systems, CRM, customer engagement, and multi-jurisdiction compliance infrastructure. Your mandate is to turn fragmented business requirements into coherent, reusable capabilities and move the organization from requirement-taking and feature delivery to end-to-end ownership of business outcomes.

What You Will Own

* **Internal platform product strategy.**
  Define the capability map, product boundaries, and roadmap across internal systems. Identify common needs and justified business differences, reduce duplicate investment, and balance near-term delivery with long-term platform quality.
* **End-to-end workflows and product architecture.**
  Define business models, module responsibilities, data definitions, and API contracts across user, account, payment, asset, permission, risk, and operational workflows. Partner with engineering, architecture, security, and compliance teams to translate these into practical solutions.
* **Business and operational efficiency.**
  Understand how internal users work and improve automation, self-service configuration, and cross-system workflows. Measure improvements through operational efficiency, error reduction, and effective adoption rather than launch checklists alone.
* **Multi-jurisdiction compliance enablement.**
  Translate business and regulatory requirements into configurable, auditable system capabilities, including jurisdiction-specific site setup, KYC/KYB workflows, access controls, and regulatory data reporting.
* **Portfolio governance and prioritization.**
  Manage requirements across multiple product teams, identify the highest-value problems, and make explicit decisions about scope, sequencing, dependencies, and resources. Establish outcome-based OKRs, delivery reviews, and product lifecycle discipline.
* **Product organization leadership.**
  Recruit, develop, and retain strong product talent. Establish clear ownership across product lines, develop product leaders, and strengthen systems thinking, independent judgment, and execution quality.
* **AI-enabled internal productivity.**
  Apply AI to requirement analysis, documentation, knowledge access, and suitable operational workflows. Demonstrate measurable efficiency and quality improvements while maintaining appropriate access controls, data protection, and human review.
* **Collaboration with Financial Cloud.**
  Define the reuse boundaries and change impacts of shared capabilities. Align with the Financial Cloud product leader and technology leadership on dependencies and priorities, avoiding duplicate builds and unmanaged disruption to critical internal work.

What We Are Looking For

* 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 5 years in senior product leadership, with direct responsibility for multi-team product organizations and the development of product leaders.
* A proven track record building and shipping complex internal platforms, financial systems, or infrastructure products. You can explain how you converted fragmented requirements into stable, reusable capabilities.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason about business models, product architecture, module catalogs, data governance, and API contracts beyond screens and user stories.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, digital assets, or another regulated environment, with an understanding of how security, audit, and regulatory requirements shape system design and workflows.
* Demonstrated experience in portfolio prioritization, cross-team decision-making, and outcome-based OKRs, supported by concrete business results.
* The ability to work effectively across business, operations, engineering, architecture, security, and compliance, making clear decisions when information is incomplete or stakeholders disagree.
* Fluency in Mandarin Chinese for in-depth communication with engineering teams and business stakeholders.

Strongly Preferred

* Experience with exchange platforms, payment and asset systems, account infrastructure, CRM, KYC/KYB, AML, or multi-jurisdiction compliance products.
* Experience leading product organizations through restructuring, rapid scaling, or legacy-system consolidation.
* Measurable results from self-service platforms, configurable systems, workflow automation, or AI-enabled productivity initiatives.
* Experience working with global teams and professional working proficiency in English.

Leadership Profile

You take ownership of problems and outcomes, not just coordination and delivery. You can narrow a broad portfolio to the most important priorities, explain trade-offs clearly, and acknowledge what remains unknown. You enable business growth while protecting platform consistency, compliance, and long-term maintainability, and you develop teams that can make sound decisions independently.

What Success Looks Like

* Core internal workflows become more efficient and accurate, with less manual work, duplicate entry, and rework.
* Shared capabilities are adopted and reused effectively, self-service improves, and duplicate system development declines.
* Business and compliance requirements are supported predictably and auditably, with the impact of major system changes actively managed.
* The product organization operates with clear accountability, credible priorities, and measurable outcome-based goals.

**Why Join Us**

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:

* Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
* Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
* Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
* Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
* Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About This Role**

You'll help us build a platform that works for One — the individual, whether that's a business owner, an artist, or a freelancer, not a segment or a balance. We focus on individuals, not numbers. You'll take ownership of our global product ecosystem from zero to one: first the minimal licensable product, then the agentic financial platform we build on top of it. You'll partner directly with the founders on strategic direction, operate with full autonomy, and build shared understanding across the organization.

**You'll Take Ownership Of**

* **Zero-to-One Product Delivery:**
  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for regulated financial products, from initial concept to launch, prioritizing value delivery over premature optimization.
* **Product & People Leadership:**
  Build and lead the product organization — hire, mentor, and grow product talent, and establish a culture of high performance, data literacy, and low ego. This is core to the role, not an adjunct to it.
* **Agentic Banking Architecture:**
  Architect a financial ecosystem built for autonomous agents from the ground up, treating AI as an operating model for the organization rather than a bolt-on feature.
* **Scope Discipline:**
  Maintain control over delivery timelines under pressure. Cut scope deliberately rather than sacrifice quality, keeping focus on the minimal licensable product.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Architecture:**
  Treat regulatory, compliance, and audit obligations as first-class product inputs, turning friction into intuitive product features.
* **Cross-Functional Feasibility:**
  Partner with the CTO to co-own technical feasibility and organizational commitments, separating what the product does from how it's engineered.
* **Context & Alignment:**
  Act as the primary bridge for shared understanding across the company — communicating product vision, customer needs, and strategic rationale through multiple channels.

**About You**

* **Regulated Startup Background:**
  You've built and shipped regulated financial products from zero to one within a fintech, crypto exchange, custodian, or digital banking environment, with proven exposure to compliance frameworks such as VARA, MiCA, EMI, or PI, and to strict licensing processes.
* **Comfort with Shifting Landscapes:**
  You thrive in continuous-delivery setups with agile teams, staying resilient and decisive under regulatory, investor, and shifting deadline pressures.
* **Agentic Framework Literacy:**
  You have practical understanding of agentic capabilities, architectural pitfalls, and the agentic-deterministic bridge, so deterministic safety holds on the money path.
* **Cross-Domain Fluency:**
  You're comfortable across crypto systems, traditional banking, and modern neobank infrastructure, rather than specialized in a single domain.
* **Outcome Ownership:**
  You own outcomes end-to-end rather than running a feature factory. You commit to measurable results and core OKRs, and you value autonomy while building a collaborative, non-siloed organization.
* **Clarity & Conviction:**
  You reduce ambiguity across teams and argue from data with conviction, but disagree and commit when it's time to align the organization.
* **Language Skills:**
  You speak and write English at a professional level, to support clean communication across global offices.

**This Is Not For You If**

* You're looking for a mature product to optimize. We're building from zero — there's no existing user base to A/B-test against.
* You're a product manager from a large bank who needs six committees to change a button. We move fast, fail fast on wrong calls, and decide from data.
* You know crypto well but see banking regulation as an outdated formality. For us, regulation is part of the product architecture, not an obstacle.
* You want to run a feature factory and just execute roadmaps. We need someone who will fight for the right scope, even if that means shipping less.
* You need the founders to make every product call. You'll have real autonomy here — and the responsibility that comes with it, including owning your own mistakes.

**Can Get You a Few Bonus Points**

* **Founder Roots:**
  Prior experience as a founder or early product leader of a regulated fintech startup, building the organization from the ground up.
* **Agentic Shipping History:**
  Direct experience bringing a live, agentic-first product to market.
* **Augmented Operations:**
  Active daily use of AI agents, personal documentation systems, or a "second brain" to streamline your own operational delivery.

**The UMO Standard**

* **Mandate & Ownership:**
  Full ownership of the product organization and roadmap, reporting directly to the founders.
* **Equity:**
  A meaningful equity stake in a venture built from zero to one.
* **Location & Flexibility:**
  Base yourself in Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, or Lviv, with openness to remote for the right fit.
* **Impact & Ownership:**
  Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior product leader to lead our Internal Platform Product organization and build the systems that enable our financial and digital-asset businesses to operate efficiently, reliably, and at scale.

You will own the product strategy, architecture, roadmap, and team development for internal platform products spanning payments and assets, user and security systems, CRM, customer engagement, and multi-jurisdiction compliance infrastructure. Your mandate is to turn fragmented business requirements into coherent, reusable capabilities and move the organization from requirement-taking and feature delivery to end-to-end ownership of business outcomes.

What You Will Own

* **Internal platform product strategy.**
  Define the capability map, product boundaries, and roadmap across internal systems. Identify common needs and justified business differences, reduce duplicate investment, and balance near-term delivery with long-term platform quality.
* **End-to-end workflows and product architecture.**
  Define business models, module responsibilities, data definitions, and API contracts across user, account, payment, asset, permission, risk, and operational workflows. Partner with engineering, architecture, security, and compliance teams to translate these into practical solutions.
* **Business and operational efficiency.**
  Understand how internal users work and improve automation, self-service configuration, and cross-system workflows. Measure improvements through operational efficiency, error reduction, and effective adoption rather than launch checklists alone.
* **Multi-jurisdiction compliance enablement.**
  Translate business and regulatory requirements into configurable, auditable system capabilities, including jurisdiction-specific site setup, KYC/KYB workflows, access controls, and regulatory data reporting.
* **Portfolio governance and prioritization.**
  Manage requirements across multiple product teams, identify the highest-value problems, and make explicit decisions about scope, sequencing, dependencies, and resources. Establish outcome-based OKRs, delivery reviews, and product lifecycle discipline.
* **Product organization leadership.**
  Recruit, develop, and retain strong product talent. Establish clear ownership across product lines, develop product leaders, and strengthen systems thinking, independent judgment, and execution quality.
* **AI-enabled internal productivity.**
  Apply AI to requirement analysis, documentation, knowledge access, and suitable operational workflows. Demonstrate measurable efficiency and quality improvements while maintaining appropriate access controls, data protection, and human review.
* **Collaboration with Financial Cloud.**
  Define the reuse boundaries and change impacts of shared capabilities. Align with the Financial Cloud product leader and technology leadership on dependencies and priorities, avoiding duplicate builds and unmanaged disruption to critical internal work.

What We Are Looking For

* 10+ years of product management experience, including at least 5 years in senior product leadership, with direct responsibility for multi-team product organizations and the development of product leaders.
* A proven track record building and shipping complex internal platforms, financial systems, or infrastructure products. You can explain how you converted fragmented requirements into stable, reusable capabilities.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to reason about business models, product architecture, module catalogs, data governance, and API contracts beyond screens and user stories.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, digital assets, or another regulated environment, with an understanding of how security, audit, and regulatory requirements shape system design and workflows.
* Demonstrated experience in portfolio prioritization, cross-team decision-making, and outcome-based OKRs, supported by concrete business results.
* The ability to work effectively across business, operations, engineering, architecture, security, and compliance, making clear decisions when information is incomplete or stakeholders disagree.
* Fluency in Mandarin Chinese for in-depth communication with engineering teams and business stakeholders.

Strongly Preferred

* Experience with exchange platforms, payment and asset systems, account infrastructure, CRM, KYC/KYB, AML, or multi-jurisdiction compliance products.
* Experience leading product organizations through restructuring, rapid scaling, or legacy-system consolidation.
* Measurable results from self-service platforms, configurable systems, workflow automation, or AI-enabled productivity initiatives.
* Experience working with global teams and professional working proficiency in English.

Leadership Profile

You take ownership of problems and outcomes, not just coordination and delivery. You can narrow a broad portfolio to the most important priorities, explain trade-offs clearly, and acknowledge what remains unknown. You enable business growth while protecting platform consistency, compliance, and long-term maintainability, and you develop teams that can make sound decisions independently.

What Success Looks Like

* Core internal workflows become more efficient and accurate, with less manual work, duplicate entry, and rework.
* Shared capabilities are adopted and reused effectively, self-service improves, and duplicate system development declines.
* Business and compliance requirements are supported predictably and auditably, with the impact of major system changes actively managed.
* The product organization operates with clear accountability, credible priorities, and measurable outcome-based goals.

**Why Join Us**

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:

* Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
* Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
* Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
* Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
* Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. The role acts as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director and leadership team, providing financial insights to support commercial decisions, profitability, operational efficiency, and business growth. The position has overall responsibility for financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow and working capital management, tax compliance, financial controls, risk management, audit coordination, and the development of robust finance processes across the region. The role requires a combination of strategic financial leadership, strong technical accounting expertise, commercial acumen, and an in-depth understanding of UAE financial and tax regulations. It also requires close collaboration with global finance teams, business unit leaders, sales, service, operations, procurement, and other relevant stakeholders.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Main Tasks (key accountabilities, deliveries, what is the role expected to do).**

* Lead the finance function and act as a strategic business partner to management.
* Align financial plans, budgets, and targets with regional business objectives.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting.
* Ensure accurate financial statements, management accounts, and financial reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, group accounting policies, and local statutory requirements.
* Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning.
* Analyse financial performance, variances, risks, and opportunities to support decision-making.
* Monitor revenue, gross margins, project profitability, and overall business performance.
* Review pricing proposals, tenders, customer contracts, and commercial business cases.
* Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and working capital optimization.
* Monitor receivables, overdue payments, credit risks, and debt collection performance.
* Ensure compliance with UAE VAT, Corporate Tax, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
* Establish and monitor financial controls, approval processes, and risk mitigation measures.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and fixed asset accounting.

* Strong knowledge of IFRS and practical experience applying accounting standards in a multinational or international business environment.
* Practical knowledge of UAE VAT, UAE Corporate Tax, statutory reporting, and applicable local compliance requirements.

* Ability to lead a regional finance function and influence senior stakeholders.
* Commercially minded, with the ability to challenge assumptions and support profitable business decisions.

* High ethical standards, professional integrity, and discretion when handling confidential financial information.

* Ability to identify control weaknesses, investigate discrepancies, and drive corrective actions. Systems and Communication

**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Lead the end-to-end product management of the ServiceNow platform at Northern Trust
* Define and execute a strategic vision and roadmap through a federated operating model across business, technology, and risk stakeholders
* Drive the implementation, governance, optimization, and expansion of ServiceNow modules, including ITSM, ITOM, IRM/GRC, SecOps, HRSD, CSM, and AI-enabled capabilities
* Ensure the platform delivers business value, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and cost optimization

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy & Vision**

* Define and own the ServiceNow platform vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap
* Translate enterprise priorities into a cohesive product strategy across modules and domains
* Lead a federated roadmap planning process across business units, ensuring alignment and prioritization
* Drive adoption of platform-first and automation-first principles

**Platform Governance & Delivery**

* Establish and enforce platform governance models (design authority, standards, data models, and architecture guardrails)
* Ensure consistent implementation of best practices, reusable components, and scalable design
* Oversee delivery of strategic programs across ServiceNow Modules in a federated partnership with assigned Capability Level Product Owners
* Partner with engineering and operations teams to ensure resiliency, scalability, and performance

**AI & Intelligent Automation Strategy**

* Define and execute roadmap for AI/GenAI capabilities within ServiceNow (e.g., virtual agents, predictive intelligence, Now Assist)
* Identify high-impact use cases for:

+ Automation of service operations
+ Predictive incident/problem management
+ Intelligent workflows and self-healing systems

* Establish governance for AI adoption, model transparency, and responsible AI usage
* Measure and track AI-driven outcomes (deflection rates, automation % , MTTR reduction)

**Vendor & Ecosystem Management**

* Own strategic relationship with ServiceNow and implementation partners
* Drive vendor performance through:

+ Quarterly business reviews (QBRs)
+ Value realization and KPI tracking
+ Innovation alignment and roadmap influence

* Evaluate and onboard ecosystem tools and integrations to extend platform capabilities

**Financial & Cost Management**

* Manage platform TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) including licensing, infrastructure, and operational costs
* Develop and execute cost optimization strategies
* Drive transparency through chargeback/showback models
* Ensure optimal utilization of ServiceNow licenses and features

**Data Management & Insights**

* Define and govern ServiceNow data strategy, including:

+ CMDB maturity and accuracy
+ Data quality frameworks
+ Data ownership and stewardship

* Enable data-driven decision making through dashboards, reporting, and analytics
* Integrate ServiceNow data with enterprise data platforms (e.g., data lake, analytics tools)

**Stakeholder & Federated Engagement**

* Act as the single point of accountability for platform outcomes
* Partner with:

+ Business stakeholders
+ IT operations and engineering
+ Risk, compliance, and audit teams

* Facilitate alignment across a federated model with distributed ownership
* Drive change management, adoption, and user experience improvement

**Key Deliverables**

* Enterprise ServiceNow strategy and roadmap
* AI adoption roadmap and value realization metrics
* Platform governance framework and standards
* Cost optimization plan and financial model
* Data governance maturity roadmap
* Vendor performance and innovation roadmap

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in product management, ITSM/platform engineering, or enterprise platforms
* 5+ years of deep ServiceNow platform experience across multiple modules
* Proven experience in large-scale ServiceNow implementations in financial services or regulated environments
* Strong understanding of:

+ ITIL / ITSM frameworks
+ Enterprise architecture principles
+ Risk and compliance requirements (SOX, audit, etc.)

* Experience managing federated product models and cross-functional stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CSA, CIS – ITSM/ITOM/IRM, Certified Product Owner)
* Experience with AI/ML or GenAI capabilities within ServiceNow or similar platforms
* Exposure to cloud platforms, data platforms, and automation frameworks
* Experience driving platform standardization and consolidation initiatives

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking with strong execution focus
* Stakeholder influence and executive communication
* Data-driven decision making
* Vendor negotiation and partnership management
* Strong governance and risk mindset
* Continuous improvement and innovation orientation

**Success Metrics**

* Platform adoption and user satisfaction
* Reduction in incident volumes and MTTR
* Automation and AI-driven efficiency gains
* Cost optimization and license utilization
* CMDB accuracy and data quality improvements
* Delivery of roadmap milestones and business value realization

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Bangalore Office**
The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

jobs.title: Vice President, Treasury Product Control GBS
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
The Product Control GBS is accountable for delivery of the end-to-end product & valuation control functions in GBS and lead different strategic initiatives for Treasury Product Control (PC) and Valuation Control (VC) including Balance Sheet Substantiation controllership. The successful candidate will act as lead running the Treasury Product and Valuation Control, working closely with Technical Accounting, Treasury, Markets, IRRBB, Liquidity, Capital, and other key stakeholders to deliver best-in-class accounting solutions across the Group.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Processes**

* Manage a team covering treasury product categories and regions. (Asset classes: Securities and MM products, Funding, Funds Transfer Pricing, Capital, Hedge Accounting etc.)
* Monitor and implement business model assessments and hedge accounting processes based on IAS 39 and IFRS 9 for new and existing strategies
* Ensure appropriate controls and reviews are maintained for Daily P&L production, core reconciliations, month end close and balance sheet substantiation.
* Ensure the teams are performing timely lockdown of daily and monthly P&L.
* Should be able to substantiate daily and monthly adjustments held in P&L and control accounts.
* Review monthly balance sheet, with substantiation and potential financial exposure.
* Review various reconciliation reports, management packs and adhoc reports.
* Review of month end journals for accrual, provision and true up.
* Take responsibility for the quality of work submitted and ensure that the highest standards are maintained.
* Ensure adherence to SLA's, KPI's , Internal metrics & Finance wide policies.
* Identify/ manage risk and control breakdowns.
* Develop & maintain effective and standard processes. Maintain KOP's/DI's.
* Support change project initiatives and conduct User Acceptance Testing for enhancements to current systems or migration to new system.

**Risk Management**

* Support effective compliance by embedding an effective Operational Risk Framework (ORF) within the PC-VC process universe to ensure all areas manage operational risks in a proactive, risk based and disciplined manner.
* Support functioning of day-to-day controls, by performing periodic assessment and monitoring activities (CST & KCI) as well as timely identification, escalation, and resolution of risk issues
* Support and monitor compliance with Operational Risk policies, procedures, and applicable regulations within PCVC and advice wherever changes are required.
* To actively support exercising of direct Risk Control Ownership / Process ownership for Operational Risk to ensure risks of processing failure are being actively owned and resolved on an end-to-end basis

**Governance and Stakeholder management**

* Regular face off with Traders, Product Control Management, Regional finance team and various internal stakeholders within GFS.
* Act as a point of reference for team members and internal clients.
* Manage relationship with internal stakeholders, take regular feedback, anticipate and understand issues and escalate appropriately for timely resolution
* Manage strong relationship with support teams (IT, Operations and Risk) and bring synergies by interacting and integrating with cross functional teams.

**Qualifications**

* MBA, CA, CFA, ACCA with a minimum of 10+ years experience (post qualification) in a financial service industry with at least 2+ years of People Management experience.
* Strong leadership skills and ability to manage teams
* Control mindset and ability to identify and mitigate and control gaps
* Good understanding of financial market products
* Ability to develop, implement and maintain effective and standard operational processes.
* Excellent people and resource management skills.
* Excellent Interpersonal skills. Should be able to communicate at all levels.
* Strong planning, negotiation and analytical skills.
* Excellent business writing and verbal English communication skills
* Ready to travel & work in shifts.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.

jobs.title: Vice President- Retail Credit Policy
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
• Manage portfolio risk strategy and performance management for unsecured retail assets, including credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and other digital lending products.
  
• Own the end-to-end risk decision framework across acquisition, account management, line assignment, pricing, collections and customer lifecycle management.
  
• Use advanced analytics, segmentation and AI/ML models to optimize growth, credit quality, customer outcomes and risk-adjusted profitability.
  
• Provide the senior leadership team with forward-looking portfolio insights, clear risk appetite recommendations and timely actions to maintain losses, returns and capital consumption within plan.
  
  
Key Result Areas
  
• Set and execute portfolio strategies for credit cards, personal loans, BNPL and emerging digital credit propositions, aligned with approved risk appetite, growth plans and regulatory requirements.
  
• Own portfolio performance across approval rates, activation, utilization, balances, yield, delinquencies, roll rates, loss rates, risk charge, vintage performance, expected credit loss, capital and risk-adjusted returns.
  
• Develop granular customer, product, channel, employer, income and behavioral segmentation to identify growth pockets, emerging risks and differentiated treatment strategies.
  
• Design and govern risk decision frameworks covering eligibility, score cut-offs, affordability, limits, tenor, pricing, line management, cross-sell, collections and exit strategies.
  
• Lead champion–challenger tests and controlled experiments; define success metrics, guardrails and post-implementation monitoring to scale profitable strategies safely.
  
• Partner with data science teams to develop, validate and deploy application, behavioral, propensity, fraud and early-warning models using traditional and alternative data.
  
• Establish responsible AI and model governance, including explainability, fairness, drift, stability, override, monitoring and human-oversight standards.
  
• Build executive dashboards, forecasts and scenario analyses linking risk drivers to revenue, margin, credit cost, operating expense, capital and lifetime customer profitability.
  
• Define early-warning indicators, portfolio triggers and remediation playbooks for adverse trends, concentration risks and macroeconomic or market shocks.
  
• Provide independent retail credit risk challenge for new products, partnerships, fintech propositions and material changes to customer journeys or decision engines.
  
• Ensure compliance with Central Bank requirements, internal policies, model risk standards, consumer protection expectations and audit requirements.
  
• Lead, coach and develop a high-performing portfolio analytics team and strengthen data-driven decision making across Retail Banking.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science or a related quantitative discipline; postgraduate qualification is preferred.
  
• Experience: Typically 12–15 years in retail credit risk, portfolio management or risk analytics, including substantial leadership responsibility and direct exposure to credit cards, personal loans and digital lending/BNPL.
  
• Portfolio expertise: Proven ownership of acquisition and account-management strategies, vintages, roll rates, delinquency, loss forecasting, provisions, risk-adjusted profitability, limit management, collections strategies and portfolio optimization.
  
• Analytics and modeling: Strong command of statistical analysis, experimentation, segmentation, forecasting, scorecards and AI/ML applications across underwriting, behavioral risk, propensity, fraud and early warning.
  
• Technical capability: Hands-on proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical language such as Python, R or SAS; strong working knowledge of Power BI/Tableau, large datasets, data pipelines and cloud analytics environments.
  
• Decision frameworks: Demonstrated ability to translate analytics into executable cut-offs, pricing, limits, treatments and growth strategies with clear economics, controls and performance measurement.
  
• Governance: Sound understanding of model risk, responsible AI, explainability, fairness, data privacy, consumer protection, IFRS 9/provisioning concepts and Central Bank requirements relevant to retail lending.
  
• Leadership: Strong executive communication, stakeholder influence and people leadership, with the ability to challenge constructively and present complex risk-return choices to senior committees.

jobs.description:

*Recognized as a*

*Securonix is proud to be a*
***cybersecurity unicorn***
*and featured in CRN's 2024*

*, one of the largest private equity firms with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than*
***1,000 customers worldwide***
*, including*
***10% of the Fortune 100***
*. Our network of*
***150+ partners***
*and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.*

*At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:*

* ***Winning as One Team***
  *: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes*
* ***Customer Driven Innovation***
  *: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers*
* ***Agility in Action***
  *: We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change*

*Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team!*

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Cyber threats are evolving faster than ever — and so are we. At Securonix, we deliver world-class SIEM, UEBA, SOAR, and Threat Intelligence solutions that help enterprises detect, investigate, and respond to threats with unmatched speed and accuracy. We’re seeking a Vice President of Product who can lead a talented team of product managers to drive innovation, execution, and market impact across our entire product portfolio.

We are seeking an experienced, execution-focused Vice President of Product to own the delivery of our product roadmap across all core offerings — SIEM, UEBA, SOAR, and Threat Intelligence. You will lead a team of product managers, ensuring we deliver exceptional value to customers while maintaining our position as a cybersecurity market leader.

This role is customer-facing yet execution-driven — you will engage with top clients and analysts while focusing on delivering high-quality, stable, and innovative products on time. You'll also work cross-functionally with Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure alignment and maximize market success.

If you thrive on turning strategy into results, leading high-performing teams, and shaping products that protect some of the world's largest organizations, this is your opportunity to make a global impact.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead, coach, and inspire a team of product managers, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Own execution of the Securonix product roadmap across SIEM, UEBA, SOAR, and Threat Intelligence offerings.
* Contribute to product vision and long-term strategy in partnership with the executive leadership team.
* Act as a primary product voice with customers, prospects, and analysts to validate direction and maintain market relevance.
* Partner with Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to drive successful launches and ongoing adoption.
* Implement and refine product delivery processes to improve speed, quality, and cross team coordination.
* Ensure competitive differentiation by evolving and scaling our mature product suite while introducing market-leading capabilities

**REQUIRED SKILLS:**

* 12+ years in product management, with at least 5 years in senior leadership.
* Required: Experience with SIEM, UEBA, and/or SOAR; Threat Intelligence experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success in scaling mature enterprise cybersecurity products.
* Proven ability to deliver complex roadmaps on time while ensuring product stability and customer satisfaction.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security operations, threat detection, and threat
* Exceptional leadership skills with a player-coach mindset.
* Excellent communicator, comfortable influencing across all levels of an organization.

**Success Metrics:**

* On-time roadmap delivery
* Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) growth
* Competitive product wins
* Product stability and operational excellence

**Benefits:**

As a full-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:

* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents-in-law
* Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10,00,000
* Term Life Insurance with a sum assured for employees is 5 times fixed base pay is covered.

*Securonix is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an innovative, inclusive, diverse and discrimination-free work environment. Employment with Securonix is based on merit, competence, and qualifications. It is our policy to administer all personnel actions, including recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting employees, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected classification in accordance with applicable federal and state laws. jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Manger - Technical
  
  
Mastercard is seeking a highly motivated Product Manager – Technical (PM-T) to join our Authentication and Digital Identity team. This role is responsible for translating customer, business, and market requirements into scalable technical product capabilities. The successful candidate will partner closely with engineering, architects, UX, security, and program management teams to define, prioritize, and deliver secure, reliable, and high-performing authentication solutions that power digital commerce experiences globally.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with technical acumen, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Requirements & Backlog Management
  
  
Gather, analyze, and document business, customer, and technical requirements.
  
  
Translate requirements into epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  
  
Maintain and prioritize the product backlog to support delivery objectives.
  
  
Technical Product Ownership
  
  
Serve as Product Owner for one or more agile scrum teams.
  
  
Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define APIs, integrations, workflows, and data requirements.
  
  
Ensure delivered solutions meet functional and non-functional requirements, including security, scalability, and reliability.
  
  
Agile Delivery & Execution
  
  
Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, reviews, and release activities.
  
  
Drive clarity on requirements, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Support successful deployment and adoption of product capabilities.
  
  
Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  
Work closely with product managers, engineering teams, architects, operations, security, and customer-facing teams.
  
  
Facilitate alignment across teams and communicate progress, risks, and key decisions.
  
  
Act as the bridge between business needs and technical implementation.
  
  
Product Operations & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Monitor product performance, customer feedback, and operational metrics.
  
  
Support issue triage, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
Contribute to process improvements that enhance product quality and delivery efficiency.
  
  
**Preferred Domain Experience**
Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:
  
  
Card payments and payment processing ecosystems
  
  
Authentication and digital identity solutions
  
  
EMV 3DS, Passkeys, FIDO/WebAuthn
  
  
Tokenization and digital wallets
  
  
APIs, integrations, and cloud-based platforms
  
  
Fraud prevention and risk-based authentication
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

IT Business Lead Analyst - Vice President
jobs.description:
Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.
  
  
The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.
* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.
* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.
* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.
* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.
* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.
* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.
* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.
* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.

**Knowledge/Experience:**

* 10-15 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.
* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.
* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.
* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk
* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.
* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.
* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).
* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.
* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.
* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.
* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.
* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*
**Competencies:**

* Excellent verbal and written English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.
* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.
* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.
* Strong organization skills.

* Identify data and technology issues and drive sustainable solutions through implementation.
* Ensure changes are tested, documented and implemented with appropriate controls.

* Support audit, regulatory and control requirements for market data used in risk measures.
* Build capability in Pune and promote knowledge sharing across the global HMD function.

Requirements:

* Master’s degree in Statistics, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in financial services, market data, risk data or data analysis.
* Proven experience leading teams and delivering through others.

**Talents Needed For Success**

jobs.title: Vice President, DataDesk – Vendor Onboarding & Automation
jobs.description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

MSCI's DataDesk team owns the onboarding of new vendor datasets into MSCI's data ecosystem — ensuring new sources are integrated quickly, validated rigorously, and governed well from day one. We're looking for a Vice President to lead and scale this function by embedding AI and automation into the onboarding lifecycle, while bringing genuine technical fluency with data to work credibly alongside Research content, Products, engineering and AI teams.

Your Key Responsibilities:

**Vendor Onboarding & Due Diligence**

* Own end-to-end onboarding of new vendor datasets — from initial due diligence and scope assessment through integration and go-live
* Define and enforce onboarding standards: identifier mapping at ingestion, full scope pre-onboarding assessment, QA assessment and fit for purpose qualification, formal SLAs definition with clear escalation ownership
* Conduct vendor due diligence and maintain trusted relationships with data providers
* Assess onboarded datasets to identify coverage gaps and quality issues, and partner with the vendor to remediate them
* Lead root-cause analysis on onboarding delays or quality gaps, and drive process fixes (as opposed to one-off fire-fighting)

**AI & Automation-Led Scaling**

* Identify and implement AI/automation opportunities across the onboarding pipeline — e.g., automated identifier/field mapping, validation rule generation, matching and reconciliation logic
* Partner with engineering/AI teams to build or adopt tooling that automates QA diagnostic and certification, reduce manual onboarding effort and turnaround time, acting as the functional expert who validates outputs against real onboarding scenarios
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI techniques and apply them to reduce onboarding cycle time and error rates
* Track and report onboarding efficiency metrics (cycle time, automation coverage, error/rework rates) to leadership
* Incorporate AI-based data usage/rights validation into the data collection process, ensuring new vendor sources are governance-compliant before integration
* Enrich and expose AI powered catalogue of data, QA / Diagnostic and other DataDesk Services

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Define validation rules and quality benchmarks for newly onboarded vendor data
* Ensure onboarded datasets meet MSCI's data standards for accuracy, consistency, and compliance before integration
* Collaborate with product and downstream teams to assess data fit and flag risks early in the onboarding process
* Conduct a quarterly assessment of MSCI's vendor data risk across product lines and single points of failure, identify possible remediations or alternatives, and present findings to senior leadership to inform operational planning and investment decisions

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of analysts/associates involved in onboarding and vendor evaluation
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to align on onboarding priorities, resolve escalations, and ensure timely, transparent communication throughout the onboarding lifecycle
* Partner with global stakeholders across product, research, technology, and operations to align onboarding priorities and standards
* Present onboarding pipeline status, risks, and automation roadmap to senior leadership

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

**Experience:** 10+ years in data operations, vendor management, or data onboarding, ideally in financial data/index/analytics

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of data structures, formats, and identifiers (LEI, DUNS, CUSIP/ISIN) sufficient to assess vendor data fit and define validation logic
* Working proficiency in SQL and Python — able to review/write validation and matching logic, not just specify requirements
* Experience applying AI/ML or automation tools to data matching, validation, or process acceleration
* Comfort working directly with engineering/AI teams as a technical counterpart, not just a requirements source

**Domain Knowledge:**

* Familiarity with vendor data landscape (e.g., FactSet, LSEG/EJV, ICE, EDI) and cross-vendor field mapping challenges
* Understanding of financial reference data concepts (entities, securities, classifications) as they relate to onboarding validation

**Soft Skills:** Strong stakeholder and vendor relationship management, project management, and the ability to translate operational pain points into automation opportunities

  
About MSCI:

**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Product Control GBS is accountable for delivery of the end-to-end product & valuation control functions in GBS and lead different strategic initiatives for Treasury Product Control (PC) and Valuation Control (VC) including Balance Sheet Substantiation controllership. The successful candidate will act as lead running the Treasury Product and Valuation Control, working closely with Technical Accounting, Treasury, Markets, IRRBB, Liquidity, Capital, and other key stakeholders to deliver best-in-class accounting solutions across the Group.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Processes**

* Manage a team covering treasury product categories and regions. (Asset classes: Securities and MM products, Funding, Funds Transfer Pricing, Capital, Hedge Accounting etc.)
* Monitor and implement business model assessments and hedge accounting processes based on IAS 39 and IFRS 9 for new and existing strategies
* Ensure appropriate controls and reviews are maintained for Daily P&L production, core reconciliations, month end close and balance sheet substantiation.
* Ensure the teams are performing timely lockdown of daily and monthly P&L.
* Should be able to substantiate daily and monthly adjustments held in P&L and control accounts.
* Review monthly balance sheet, with substantiation and potential financial exposure.
* Review various reconciliation reports, management packs and adhoc reports.
* Review of month end journals for accrual, provision and true up.
* Take responsibility for the quality of work submitted and ensure that the highest standards are maintained.
* Ensure adherence to SLA's, KPI's , Internal metrics & Finance wide policies.
* Identify/ manage risk and control breakdowns.
* Develop & maintain effective and standard processes. Maintain KOP's/DI's.
* Support change project initiatives and conduct User Acceptance Testing for enhancements to current systems or migration to new system.

* **Support effective compliance by embedding an effective Operational Risk Framework (ORF) within the PC-VC process universe to ensure all areas manage operational risks in a proactive, risk based and disciplined manner.**
* **Support functioning of day-to-day controls, by performing periodic assessment and monitoring activities (CST & KCI) as well as timely identification, escalation, and resolution of risk issues**

jobs.title: Business Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

  
  

The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.

* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.

* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.

* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.

* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.

* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.

* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.

* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.

* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.
  

  

**Knowledge/Experience:**

  
  

* 8-12 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.

* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.

* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk

* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.

* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.

* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).

* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.

* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.

* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.

* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.

* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*

  
  

**Competencies:**

  
  

* Excellent verbal and written English.

* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.

* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.

* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.

* Strong organization skills.
