jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The **Assistant Vice President (IC) - Specialized Analytics** is a developing professional role within the QATV team. This role applies specialized expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, data science, and advanced AI technologies (including Generative AI and Agentic AI) to revolutionize how regulatory testing is executed, analyzed, and governed.

The Data Science Analyst will partner with QATV testing and reporting teams to identify high-impact opportunities for automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent reporting. Key responsibilities include applying AI/ML techniques to detect complex data anomalies, automating test narrative generation, predicting testing cycle risks, and optimizing testing sprint capacity and resource allocation.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* **Predictive Defect & Risk Modeling:** Build predictive analytics and forecasting models to project test execution cycle times, identify recurring defect patterns, and anticipate regulatory reporting risks before filing deadlines.
* **Testing Intelligence & Metrics:** Analyze historical test execution data to uncover systemic data quality trends, derive actionable quality scores, and provide data-driven recommendations to strengthen internal control frameworks.

* **Automated Narrative Generation:** Design, build, and deploy Generative AI solutions (using LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG architectures) to automate the drafting of complex, audit-ready narrative test summaries and executive readouts.
* **Agentic AI & Workflow Automation:** Experiment with and develop Agentic AI workflows (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph) to automate multi-step validation checks, intelligent test result consolidation, and autonomous exception routing.
* **AI Evaluation & Guardrails:** Establish robust benchmarking tools, validation frameworks, and guardrails to evaluate the accuracy, hallucination risks, consistency, and performance of deployed AI/GenAI models.

* **Resource & Capacity Modeling:** Develop quantitative models and optimization algorithms to enhance sprint capacity planning, workload balancing, and skill-to-task allocation across multi-phase testing cycles.
* **Sprint Analytics & Tracking:** Build automated intelligence pipelines and interactive dashboards (Power BI / Tableau) to track sprint velocity, defect burn-down rates, and milestone adherence in real time.
* **Automated Test Script Generation:** Leverage Generative AI and LLM-powered pipelines to automate the creation, synthesis, and maintenance of standardized regulatory test scripts, validation rules.

* **Control, Risk & Governance:** Ensure all data science and AI applications comply with Citi Model Risk Management (MRM), Responsible AI guidelines, and data governance policies. Appropriately assess risk when developing solutions, ensuring transparent escalation and adherence to all supervisory standards.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in QATV by managing expectations and ensuring alignment on project goals and deliverables. Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders timely manner
* **Team Player & Mentor:** Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior team members. Mentor and coach team members on best practices in data analysis, reporting, and data infrastructure management

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Programming & ML Frameworks: Strong programming skills in Python with proficiency in data science and ML libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers).

* Generative AI & LLMs: Hands-on experience developing GenAI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus), and API integration.

* Agentic Frameworks & MLOps: Practical exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen, along with foundational knowledge of MLOps and model deployment pipelines.

* Data Engineering & SQL: Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, manipulating, and transforming large datasets from relational databases and testing data marts (e.g., Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL).

* Data Visualization & BI: Experience building interactive analytics dashboards using Tableau or Power BI.

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Excellent interpersonal skills and a positive, proactive attitude. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

jobs.title: Corporate Credit Underwriter - Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise.

Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums

* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources

* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages

* Partner with Front Office on structuring and production of term sheet for new transactions

* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and with key Regulators, Internal Audit, and control functions

* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required

**Risk Management Experience:**

* Senior credit approval authority covering large and complex underwritings, capital commitments, derivatives with multi-industry experience
* Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards
* Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures
* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations

* Proven ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors

* 12+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
  
  
Are you ready to make a significant impact in the world of trading services? At JPMorganChase, we offer an exciting opportunity for career growth and development as a Trading Services Manager. Join us to leverage your skills in automation and data analysis and be part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.  
  
As a Trading Services Manager within JPMorganChase, you will be a key player in our team, leveraging your deep knowledge of trade activities and market products to ensure seamless order execution and settlement. Your role will involve managing a diverse team, interpreting customer needs, and identifying trends to generate innovative solutions. You will be responsible for end-to-end trade processing control, monitoring asset and cash levels, and driving continuous improvement in our operating platform. Your advanced understanding of automation technologies and data literacy will be crucial in optimizing our systems and making data-driven decisions. As a recognized expert in your field, you will use your strong presentation skills and influence to communicate insights, manage internal stakeholders, and lead your team through change. Your work will have a wide-ranging impact on our operations, financial management, and service delivery, contributing to the overall success of our firm.

* Oversee the end-to-end trade processing control, ensuring accurate order entry, trade execution, and settlement in line with operational policies and precedents.
* Utilize advanced knowledge of market products to monitor and manage asset and cash levels, identifying trends and potential risks.
* Implement automation technologies and data analysis techniques to optimize trading systems, enhance efficiency, and inform strategic decisions.
* Lead and manage a diverse team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation in our trading services.
* Engage with internal stakeholders, leveraging strong presentation skills to communicate insights, drive change, and align operations with the firm's strategic objectives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 7+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in trading services, specifically in order execution, trade execution, and settlement.
* Demonstrated advanced skills in using automation technologies to optimize trading systems and processes.
* Advanced knowledge of market products, including their definitions, operating procedures, and relevant industry regulations.
* Proven ability to lead and manage a diverse team, with a focus on fostering continuous improvement and innovation.
* Expertise in data analysis techniques, with the ability to communicate data-driven insights effectively to inform strategic decisions.
* Expertise to create presentations across various levels. Ability to deliver in person & virtual presentations to senior management and stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Skilled in leveraging digital literacy to adopt and integrate innovative technologies, enhancing trade services and operational efficiency.
* Capable of utilizing AI and machine learning to enhance trade service processes and improve decision-making, driving data-driven insights and outcomes.

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the India Demat Team within India International Wealth and Premier Banking as Assistant Vice President – Demat Operations.

  

**Role Purpose**

  

The role holder will manage end-to-end depository participant operations within a regulated bank environment, encompassing demat account opening and servicing, settlement monitoring, reconciliations, income and DP charge controls, and regulatory reporting. The role will ensure accurate and timely execution in accordance with applicable SEBI requirements, NSDL/CDSL rules and bye-laws, PMLA, and HSBC policies and operating procedures.

  

The incumbent will drive operational efficiency and customer service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services, maintain robust risk and control standards, manage audit and regulatory review requirements, and implement regulatory and system changes within prescribed timelines.

  

**Principal Accountabilities**

* + Oversee demat account opening, modification, servicing and closure, including verification of client documentation and KYC/AML requirements, periodic account reviews, and corporate demat requests.
  + Ensure accurate and timely processing of dematerialisation and rematerialisation requests (DRF/RRF), Delivery Instruction Slips (DIS), pledge, un-pledge and invocation requests, and off-market and inter-depository transfers.
  + Monitor settlement cycles and ensure timely reconciliation with depositories and clearing corporations.
  + Oversee daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of client holdings, DP balances, suspense accounts and control accounts; investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.
  + Manage provisioning of income entries and reconciliation of DP charges in coordination with Finance/Accounts.
  + Prepare and submit regulatory and depository reports within prescribed timelines and maintain accurate MIS for management review and compliance oversight.

**Customers / Stakeholders**

  

* + Manage DP-related customer queries, grievances and escalations in coordination with branches, relationship and service teams, ensuring timely resolution.
  + Liaise with NSDL/CDSL, registrars and transfer agents (RTAs), Finance/Accounts, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to resolve servicing and operational matters.
  + Drive customer-centric improvements in turnaround time and service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services.
  + Act as the principal contact for Demat operational and regulatory matters across Operations, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Risk, Finance, Treasury, the business and relevant depositories.
  + Coordinate responses to regulatory queries, inspections, internal and external audits, and compliance reviews.
  + Drive cross-functional actions independently, secure clear ownership and deliver within agreed timelines.
  + Provide concise management reporting on key operational risks, regulatory actions, exceptions and outstanding deliverables.
  + Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability and strong collaboration across first- and second-line stakeholders.

* **Leadership and Teamwork**
  

* + Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned DP operations and coordinate with stakeholders to meet operational, regulatory and audit deadlines.
  + Work collaboratively with branches, service teams, Compliance, Finance and Technology on regulatory implementation, escalations and process changes.

* **Operational Effectiveness & Control**
  

* Conduct periodic process and control reviews to identify operational and regulatory risks.
* Own audit and inspection observations, agree remediation plans and ensure timely, evidenced closure.
* Monitor implementation of regulatory and product changes and confirm that required controls operate effectively.
* Proactively identify and escalate material operational, regulatory, conduct or control risks.
* Regulatory and business deliverables completed within prescribed timelines.
* Timely and sustainable closure of audit, inspection, compliance and control actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of regulatory trackers, governance records, evidence and management information.
* Reduction in repeat exceptions, overdue actions and material control gaps.
* Effective implementation of regulatory, product and process changes with appropriate documentation and stakeholder sign-off.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and effective escalation of material risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation and digitisation to reduce manual intervention and operational errors.
* Track new and revised regulatory and depository circulars and implement required process and control changes within defined timelines.
* Identify operational risks and ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, segregation of duties, standard operating procedures and HSBC operational risk frameworks.
* Monitor exceptions, failed transactions and reconciliation breaks, ensuring timely resolution and escalation of control issues.
* Strengthen controls over DIS usage, fraud prevention and unauthorised transactions, and maintain adherence to applicable KYC/AML, PMLA and depository requirements.
* Manage internal and concurrent audits, compliance inspections and regulatory reviews relating to DP operations; ensure closure of observations within stipulated timelines.

This specialist role requiring independent judgement, strong execution discipline and the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders. The role holder will operate within approved product programmes, HSBC policies, procedures and governance standards, escalating matters outside delegated authority or risk appetite.

The role holder will maintain HSBC internal control standards, comply with relevant Group and local policies and procedures, and ensure timely implementation and closure of internal and external audit points and issues raised by regulators, Compliance or Risk.

jobs.title: Presales Director
jobs.description:
The Impact You'll Drive
  
  
At Vegapay, a bank's idea for a new credit card or credit line on UPI shouldn't take months to reach customers. We build the configurable infrastructure behind next-generation credit and payment programs for banks, NBFCs and fintechs. We're looking for a Director, Presales to lead the function that turns a first conversation with a bank into a signed program: the person who can walk into a CXO room, understand the business problem and show how Vegapay solves it.
  
  
This isn't a pure sales role, and it isn't a pure solutioning role. You'll own the technical and commercial story of every strategic deal, from discovery and demos to RFP responses, proofs of concept and the handover to delivery.
  
  
As Director, Presales, you'll sit between our banking and fintech prospects, sales leadership, product and engineering. You'll shape how Vegapay is positioned across credit cards, credit line on UPI (CLOU), embedded lending, BRE, rewards, ledgering and reconciliation, and you'll build the team and playbooks that make every pursuit faster and sharper than the last.
  
  
You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at banks and NBFCs (heads of cards, lending, risk, technology and compliance) to understand how they operate, find the problems that matter most and define clear success criteria. Then you'll win them over with a solution they can see working. Success in this role takes deep fintech domain knowledge, credibility with technical and business leaders, and the ability to turn an ambiguous requirement into a clear, winning proposal.
  
  
The Hats You Will Wear
  
  

* Own the presales strategy and function end to end: set the operating model, targets and quality bar across discovery, solutioning, demos, RFPs and proofs of concept.
* Lead discovery with bank, NBFC and fintech prospects to map their current stack, workflows and regulatory constraints, identify the real bottleneck and define measurable success criteria.
* Partner with the CEO and sales leadership on strategic pursuits: qualify opportunities, build the win strategy and join CXO-level meetings as the solution and domain voice for Vegapay.
* Design tailored solutions across credit cards, credit line on UPI, embedded lending, BRE, rewards, forex, ledgering and reconciliation, with clear architecture, integration approach and timelines.
* Own RFP/RFI responses and commercial proposals, working with product, engineering, legal and finance on scope, pricing, SLAs and risk.
* Run high-impact demos and proofs of concept that show the configurable platform working on the prospect's own use cases, including sandbox and demo environments that stay current.
* Build, mentor and scale a team of solution architects, presales consultants and solution engineers, with clear career paths and performance standards.
* Create the presales playbook: reusable solution blueprints, battlecards, competitive positioning, objection handling, ROI and business-case models, and a library of RFP answers.
* Act as the voice of the market inside Vegapay: feed prospect needs, competitive gaps and regulatory shifts (RBI, NPCI) back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.
* Hand over won deals cleanly to implementation and customer delivery, so what was promised in the pursuit is what gets built.
* Track and report presales metrics: pipeline coverage, win rate, sales-cycle length, POC conversion and RFP turnaround time.

The Perfect Fit
  
  

* 10 - 12 years of experience in presales, solution consulting or solution architecture at a fintech, payments or core-banking/card-processing vendor, with at least 5 years leading a presales or solutions team.
* Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder deals with banks, NBFCs or large fintechs, from first discovery to signed contract.
* Deep domain knowledge of at least one of credit cards, lending (BNPL, credit lines, personal loans), UPI or payments processing, including how card programs and lending products work end to end.
* Strong technical grounding: APIs, microservices, integrations, cloud deployment, security and data-privacy norms, enough to lead architecture conversations with a bank's CTO and CISO.
* Working knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape: RBI guidelines on digital lending and credit cards, NPCI's UPI ecosystem, PCI-DSS and data localisation.
* Strong executive presence and storytelling: comfortable presenting to CXOs and boards, and equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with architects.
* Experience building and mentoring high-performing presales teams, with clear ownership and a culture of accountability.
* Skilled at RFP/RFI responses, commercial proposals, ROI and business-case modelling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across sales, product, engineering and legal in a fast-moving startup.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Engineering; an MBA is a plus.

Your Edge Over the Rest
  
  

* Hands-on experience with card management systems, credit line over UPI, loan management systems, ledger and reconciliation flows, or card network integrations (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay).
* An existing network among senior leaders at Indian banks, NBFCs and fintechs.
* AI-native: you use AI tools in your own work, and you can show prospects how AI-led workflows improve underwriting, servicing and operations.
* You've built a presales function from scratch, or scaled one through a sharp growth phase.
* Full ownership: a deal is yours until the program is live, not just until the contract is signed.
* Highest standards: you won't promise a bank what the platform can't deliver, and you care about getting the solution right the first time.

The Problem We're Solving
  
  
Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
  
  
At the same time, customer expectations have changed - speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
  
  
This is where we come in. At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control - helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.
  
  
The Opportunity Ahead
  
  

* Shape and lead the presales function of a fast-growing B2B fintech from an early stage, with a direct line to the founders.
* Work with top banks and cutting-edge credit infrastructure on high-visibility, high-value deals.
* Own the story behind products that run for millions of end users.
* Fast-paced, high-learning environment with strong growth opportunities.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President Marketing
jobs.description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.

**About the Role:**

At CoinDCX, brand and growth are one system. Brand earns trust, and trust brings in users who stay, trade and recommend us. As
**SVP – Growth & Marketing**
, you will own both sides and make them work as one.

Your mandate is not to promote crypto, but to normalise it and make it trusted. You will shape how millions of Indians understand, assess and use this new asset class. You will own the full path from first awareness to a loyal customer: brand trust, recall, acquisition, activation, retention, win-back, product-led growth and consumer understanding.

You will work at the meeting point of cultural narrative, regulatory nuance, reputation and capital discipline. We need a leader who plans in multi-year horizons, stays steady under public scrutiny and builds systems that hold up through market cycles.

You will lead the full marketing organisation (Brand, Creative, Content, Social and Community, PR), the Growth teams (Retention, Resurrection, PLG, Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing) and Consumer Insights. You will partner closely with the Business unit, which owns CLM, and with Product, Policy, Analytics and Leadership, so that what we build, say and stand for stays aligned.

If building one of India’s most consequential financial brands, and the growth engine behind it, excites you, this role will both challenge and reward you.

**What You'll Do:**

* You are the
  **DRI (Directly Responsible Individual)**
  for the full Growth & Marketing budget across ATL, BTL, digital media, performance, social, content and PR. You are accountable not just for outcomes, but for the reasoning behind every spend decision.
* **Metric & Budget Ownership:**
  Own the brand KPIs (brand health, social media metrics, organic acquisition) and the growth KPIs (new users, activation, retention, blended CAC, LTV). You are accountable for full funnel marketing and building brand trust.
* **Brand Strategy:**
  Own the multi-year brand roadmap. Turn complex VDA (Virtual Digital Asset) topics into simple, education-led stories that enhance trust while keeping technical accuracy.
* **Growth Strategy:**
  Own the plan from first install to long-term customer, with one shared view of the funnel across marketing and growth.
* **Retention & Resurrection:**
  Keep active users coming back, and bring lapsed users back, through product-led and marketing-led programmes.
* **PLG & Product Marketing:**
  Build referrals, in-product loops and organic acquisition with Product. Own positioning, launches and go-to-market for each product line.
* **SEO & Digital Marketing:**
  Own organic search and paid digital channels. Manage CAC, ROAS and cost per activated user, and direct media buying and budget allocation.
* **Consumer Insights:**
  Lead the insights team. Use research, user behaviour data and brand tracking to guide decisions across marketing, growth, product and business.
* **Org Design:**
  Lead and grow the full team, from creatives to analysts to performance specialists. Build a strong layer of second-level leaders so day-to-day execution does not depend on you.
* **Reputation Systems:**
  Design and own proactive PR and “Issue Readiness” playbooks to protect institutional credibility during market volatility.
* **Product & Policy Partnership:**
  Work with Product and Policy so the brand promise of “Responsible Education” shows up in the app experience and in all advertising, and stays compliant.
* **Experimentation & Measurement:**
  Run a steady pipeline of growth and brand experiments with Product and Analytics, and set one trusted set of numbers for the whole function.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You Have:**

* **Think in First Principles:**
  You look for the real reason users do not trust us or do not stay, rather than applying standard marketing frameworks.
* **Act as an Owner:**
  You treat company capital and reputation as your own, and make hard trade-offs to protect long-term brand value over short-term “hacks.”
* **Are Equally at Ease with Story and Numbers:**
  You can judge a brand film and read a funnel or cohort chart with the same confidence.
* **Translate Strategy:**
  You turn disruptive technology into simple, trusted, mass-market stories without losing technical accuracy.
* **Build Systems:**

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
jobs.description:
**About Tide**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

**About The Role**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

As Director of Engineering you will

* Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.
* Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design.
* Partner with Product and Design leadership on one shared plan, jointly owning delivery and outcomes, including members activated through real sales and purchases, engagement and recurring revenue.
* Scale the Tide Business Pages and Tide Online Network into a trusted, high-traffic marketplace, including search, listings, member-to-member leads, chat and buyer requests.
* Build the partner integration platform behind our website, gift card, business supply and logistics partners, enabling new partners and offers to be onboarded quickly and safely.
* Work with Payments, Acquiring, Credit, Insurance and Wealth to embed payments, credit, insurance and rewards into commerce journeys at the point of need.
* Build trust into the marketplace in partnership with Ongoing Monitoring and Risk, from verified seller status to initial and ongoing monitoring of listings and member-to-member communication.
* Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security.
* Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it.
* Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

**Our Tech Stack**

* Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
* Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

**What You’ll Get In Return**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a
**flexible workplace**
model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.
* Systems depth: Deep hands-on background in distributed, high-throughput, data-heavy systems; still able to go deep in a design review and hold a credible technical argument.
* Architecture & platform: Proven ownership of architecture, platformisation, and developer tooling, with evidence of the delivery gains those investments produced.
* ML & AI in production: Experience productionising ML or Gen AI systems in partnership with data science teams.
* Commercial ownership: Experience owning engineering budgets, cloud cost and TCO, vendor decisions, and resource planning.
* Hiring record: A strong track record of hiring and developing senior engineers and engineering managers.
* Domain: Experience in fintech, payments, lending, or another regulated, high-reliability consumer business is a strong plus.
* Location: Based in Bengaluru, or willing to relocate.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Ownership: Takes accountability for outcomes beyond their own remit, not only for their teams’ deliverables.
* Technical credibility: Earns the respect of senior engineers through judgment and depth, not position.
* Strategic thinking: Connects technical choices to business outcomes and can defend the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.
* Builder of leaders: Measures success by the strength of the managers and engineers they develop.
* Pace: Thrives in a high-growth environment where structure is still being built, and brings clarity rather than waiting for it.

**Non-Fit Profiles**

* Individual contributors or architects without sustained people-leadership experience.
* Managers who have led a single team, without experience managing managers or leading a group through scale.
* Leaders who have moved fully away from technical depth and cannot hold their own in architecture and design discussions.
* Candidates from large, process-heavy environments who need established structure, and are uncomfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous setting.
* Delivery or programme managers without hands-on engineering ownership.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale - liquidity potential at $1-3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You own delivery and technical direction for a core part of the platform, with a direct line to the CTO.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Benefits: Excellent benefits package in line with sector best practice.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering, WhatsApp
jobs.description:

In India, it is also where a great deal of everyday life gets done — people message businesses, coordinate their families, and increasingly send money as easily as they send a message.We are building a new team to take WhatsApp further in that direction. The newly established WhatsApp Services team is focused on making WhatsApp more useful for more of what people already use it for, and on building what comes next.This engineering leader for India will oversee the newly established WhatsApp Services team, treated as a zero-to-one effort so we can move fast, take risks, and build as we go. Staffed and prioritized, like every other WhatsApp team, from day one. Payments on WhatsApp aren’t a bet on paper: live and growing in India; the existing WhatsApp payments engineering team moves across as the foundation.As an engineering leader at WhatsApp, you will use your start-up mindset and your full range of engineering leadership skills to produce elegantly simple products. You’ll be expected to push the boundaries of what’s possible in a mobile app, while sharing in our commitment to quality and attention to detail. * Cultivate a culture of executional excellence and analytical rigor, driving process improvements across teams and functions that reduce operational overhead and accelerate delivery.
* Champion engineering craft and quality standards across teams, fostering a self-reinforcing culture of continuous improvement.
* Monitor and act on organizational health signals to maintain high engagement, low attrition and effective team dynamics across reporting lines.
* Develop a leadership bench through both external hiring and internal growth, and contribute to company-wide engineering initiatives including recruiting, mentorship and technical standards.

Minimum Qualifications:
  
  

* 10+ years of technical industry experience in software engineering
* 7+ years of engineering management experience, including managing other engineering managers
* Track record of building and scaling engineering organizations, including recruiting, developing and retaining engineers and engineering managers
* Proven track record of delivering and operating large-scale production systems
* Experience establishing technical strategy and organizational roadmaps across multiple teams, with demonstrated ability to drive execution against them
* Experience forming cross-functional partnerships across product, design and data science to deliver large-scale engineering outcomes

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Experience building and operating payment systems at scale, including the reliability, correctness and regulatory requirements they carry
* Background in monetization, payments, commerce, or AI/ML products
* Experience building 0-to-1 organizations or standing up new product areas
* Experience with global, multi-market products (particularly emerging markets)
* Experience managing distributed teams across multiple sites
* Familiarity with messaging platforms or mobile-first consumer products

About Meta:
  
  
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
  
  
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.description:
Leading fintech lending company is looking for a Head of Operations to establish, manage and scale end-to-end operations for its short-term, small-ticket unsecured digital lending business. You will work closely with the founders and NBFC partners to build efficient processes across onboarding, underwriting coordination, disbursement, repayment, collections, compliance and customer support.

  

Job Location: Bangalore

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

- Manage end-to-end lending operations for short-term, small-ticket unsecured loans, including customer onboarding, KYC verification, loan processing, disbursement and repayment management

- Oversee collections and recovery, including early-bucket collections, roll-rate tracking, delinquency management and fair recovery practices

- Manage underwriting operations in coordination with the NBFC partner and ensure adherence to credit policies

- Ensure compliance with RBI Digital Lending Directions, including Key Fact Statement (KFS), APR disclosure, cooling-off period and grievance redressal mechanisms

- Monitor operational performance, portfolio quality, collection efficiency and key lending metrics

- Build, streamline and implement operational processes, policies and workflows in a high-growth, early-stage environment

- Recruit, lead and develop operations, collections and customer support teams

- Work closely with founders, technology, credit, collections and external partners to ensure smooth execution and business scalability

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

- 8+ years of experience in NBFC, fintech or digital lending operations

- Mandatory: hands-on experience in payday loans / short-term app-based personal loans (salary advance, instant loans, small-ticket unsecured lending)

- Good understanding of APR structures, loan pricing and fee disclosure

- Hands-on experience managing onboarding, KYC, disbursement, repayment and collections

- Proven experience in collections and recovery, including delinquency buckets, roll rates and NPA management

- Working knowledge of RBI Digital Lending Directions and LSP-NBFC operating models

- Experience working with LOS/LMS platforms and lending technology partners

- Demonstrated ability to build processes, manage teams and scale operations in a startup or high-growth environment

- Strong leadership, analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills

- Graduate in any discipline (MBA/PGDM preferred)

Bajaj Housing Finance Limited (BHFL) is an Upper-Layer NBFC classified by the Reserve Bank of India and a subsidiary of Bajaj Finance Limited, one of India’s most diversified non-banking financial companies. Headquartered in Pune, BHFL serves individuals and corporate clients with financing solutions for purchasing and renovating homes and commercial spaces. BHFL supports real estate developers with funding for residential and commercial projects and offers lease rental discounting to developers and high-net-worth individuals. The Sales Manager role at Bajaj Housing Finance Limited is a full-time, on-site position based in Pune. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying and nurturing new business opportunities, building and maintaining relationships with customers, developers, and channel partners, and overseeing the end-to-end sales process from lead generation to conversion. The role involves reviewing market trends, monitoring competitor activity, and collaborating with product, credit, and operations teams to optimize offerings and customer experience. The Sales Manager will also be responsible for performance tracking, reporting sales metrics, coaching team members, and upholding regulatory and company compliance standards.

* Comfort with using CRM tools, MS Office, and digital platforms for sales tracking and reporting.
* Demonstrated integrity, customer-centric mindset, and capacity to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

jobs.title: Director, Payment Acceptance
jobs.description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
  
  
**Job Title**
Director, Payment Acceptance
  
  
**Job Location: Pune**
**5 Days Work from Office**
**Shift Timing : 6:30PM to 3:30AM**
**What does a great Director of Business Analysis I do?**
The
**Director, Payment Acceptance**
provides strategic and operational leadership for Payment Acceptance operations functions within Merchant Solutions. This leader is accountable for delivering consistent, controlled, and efficient operations across least cost routing, interchange reconciliation, network reporting and fee oversight, merchant data integrity and PCI compliance support, and Payment Acceptance inquiries while ensuring the organization meets client commitments, network requirements, financial controls, service levels, quality standards, and productivity expectations.
  
  
The Director leads through other leaders and is responsible for translating business strategy into operational execution across a complex Payment Acceptance environment. The role provides oversight across credit deibt and dispute operation routing and configuration, interchange and settlement reconciliation, network fees and reporting, merchant compliance requirements, inquiry management and escalation, production workflow, reporting and analytics, and continuous improvement.
  
  
This leader is expected to think beyond daily operations. They anticipate operational, financial, network, and compliance risk; identify opportunities to simplify and modernize processes; develop scalable operating models; and establish the controls, metrics, talent, and governance necessary to support Payment Acceptance.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Provide strategic leadership for Payment Acceptance operations, establishing priorities, operating standards, performance expectations, and long-term direction across supported functions.
* Lead through managers, supervisors, and professional staff, creating clear accountability for operational execution, service delivery, quality, productivity, associate development, and results.
* Oversee Least Cost Routing support, ensuring debit network routing requirements, eligibility indicators, configuration values, and related data are accurate and support appropriate transaction routing.
* Provide leadership for interchange reconciliation activities across payment, interchange, settlement, and billing processes, ensuring variances, exceptions, and out-of-balance conditions are identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Oversee network reporting and fee governance activities, ensuring reporting accuracy, data integrity, merchant compliance support, fee validation, and timely resolution of discrepancies.
* Provide leadership for Payment Acceptance inquiry support, ensuring Account Management and lines of business receive timely research, clear answers, appropriate issue tracking, and escalation to Technology when technical investigation or system changes are required.
* Provide oversight of payment and debit network requirements that affect routing, interchange, reporting, fees, merchant compliance, and Payment Acceptance operations.
* Lead production workflow and capacity management, ensuring inventory, staffing, skills, and resources are aligned to volumes, service-level requirements, and business priorities.
* Maintain strong financial and operational controls across interchange reconciliation, network fees, routing, reporting, exceptions, adjustments, and other activities affecting merchant or corporate financial positions.
* Establish and monitor performance metrics across productivity, quality, SLA attainment, inventory, aging, financial accuracy, data quality, operational risk, and client experience. Use data to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities requiring leadership intervention.
* Establish consistent processes for issue intake, research, ownership, escalation, aging, resolution, and communication across Payment Acceptance support functions.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by simplifying processes, eliminating manual activity, improving controls, expanding automation, and partnering with Technology on system and reporting enhancements.
* Lead Payment Acceptance technology and modernization initiatives, representing Operations in the design and enhancement of routing, reconciliation, inquiry, reporting, workflow, automation, and control capabilities.
* Drive a scalable operating model that provides resiliency, knowledge transfer, cross-training, and appropriate site redundancy while maintaining consistent operational standards across locations.
* Manage operational risk by proactively identifying process breaks, control gaps, financial exposure, network or compliance concerns, data-quality issues, and emerging trends and ensuring appropriate remediation and escalation.
* Support audit and control activities, maintaining strong documentation, process adherence, evidence management, and sustainable controls.
* Partner across the organization with Product, Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Network Relations, Account Management, and other business partners to resolve complex issues and deliver strategic objectives.
* Provide leadership for client, merchant, and business escalations, ensuring complex Payment Acceptance issues are researched thoroughly, root causes are understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Develop organizational talent and succession, strengthening leadership capability and Payment Acceptance subject-matter expertise while building clear development paths for associates, analysts, supervisors, and managers.
* Create an accountability-driven culture where leaders and associates demonstrate ownership, sound judgment, follow-through, continuous learning, and commitment to client and business outcomes.
* Communicate operational performance and risk to senior leadership, translating complex operational data and issues into clear business impacts, recommendations, decisions, and action plans.

**What You Need To Have**

* Demonstrated experience in business analysis, Payment Acceptance, payment operations, network reporting, fee oversight, merchant compliance, or a related field, ideally within financial services.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets, identify trends, validate data integrity, and resolve discrepancies.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex network requirements into clear business requirements and operational direction.
* Proven ability to lead multiple projects and priorities simultaneously with strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Strong knowledge of payment networks, merchant compliance requirements, network fees, reporting processes, and industry regulations.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, and Excel macros.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex issues, assess business impact and risk, and coordinate solutions with payment networks and internal teams.
* Ability to work effectively across payment networks, lines of business, and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail, adaptability, and commitment to data quality, compliance, accuracy, and strong operational controls.

**What Would Be Great To Have**

* Experience leading Paymen

jobs.title: Revenue Accounting Engineering and Delivery Tech Lead - India

**Role Purpose**
The Head of Engineering for Revenue Accounting India will provide senior technology and engineering leadership for the Revenue Accounting organization in India, building a world-class engineering capability and driving modernization, engineering excellence and predictable delivery across the Revenue Accounting technology estate.
  
  
The role will establish India as a
**strategic engineering centre supporting end-to-end delivery**
, partnering with global Technology and Finance leadership to deliver critical Revenue Accounting capabilities and strategic transformation.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong engineering and technology leadership with the ability to lead a large, complex organization, develop exceptional talent, modernize the technology estate and deliver consistently in a highly regulated environment.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Engineering Leadership & Strategy**

* Lead the Revenue Accounting engineering organization in India, with accountability for engineering excellence, talent, technology and delivery outcomes.
* Define and execute the India engineering strategy, aligned to the global Revenue Accounting technology strategy and broader Finance transformation agenda.
* Provide strong technical leadership across the engineering organization, ensuring strategic technology decisions balance business outcomes, architecture, resilience, risk and long-term sustainability.
* Establish clear engineering standards across software design, architecture, development, testing, DevSecOps, observability, resilience and production engineering.
* Champion a culture of engineering ownership where teams are accountable for solutions throughout the technology lifecycle, from design and build through deployment and production.

**Technology Modernization**

* Drive modernization of the Revenue Accounting technology estate, including MOTIF and the broader subledger ecosystem, simplifying legacy architecture and moving toward strategic target-state capabilities.
* Actively manage technical debt and drive simplification of applications, infrastructure, data flows and engineering processes.
* Promote modern architecture and engineering patterns including cloud, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, automation and modern data capabilities where appropriate.
* Ensure technology investment balances immediate business and regulatory requirements with the long-term strategic health of the platform.

**Delivery & Transformation**

* Drive predictable execution of the Revenue Accounting engineering roadmap, aligning engineering capacity to the highest-value business, regulatory and strategic outcomes.
* Provide senior engineering leadership to major Finance transformation initiatives, ensuring Revenue Accounting capabilities integrate effectively with the target front-to-back accounting architecture.
* Establish transparent measures of engineering health, delivery effectiveness, quality, risk and productivity.
* Identify and proactively manage material technology dependencies, delivery risks and capacity constraints.

**Talent & Organizational Leadership**

* Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization across India, strengthening both engineering leadership and deep technical capability.
* Attract, retain and develop outstanding engineering talent while creating clear career paths for technical specialists and engineering leaders.
* Build a strong succession pipeline across Director, VP, technical leadership and senior engineering roles.
* Strengthen institutional knowledge and reduce key-person or third-party dependencies through targeted insourcing, mobility, cross-training and capability development.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance engineering culture where teams are empowered to challenge, innovate and continuously improve.

**Innovation & AI**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation and modern developer tooling across the engineering lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, test automation, software quality and speed to market through AI and automation.
* Create an environment that encourages experimentation while ensuring innovation is governed appropriately for a regulated technology environment.

**Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as a senior member of the global Revenue Accounting technology leadership team, ensuring India is fully integrated into global strategy and decision-making.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Controls and Technology.
* Influence enterprise technology and engineering decisions beyond the immediate Revenue Accounting organization.
* Represent Revenue Accounting within the broader India technology leadership community and strengthen India's position as a strategic engineering hub.

* Experience within financial accounting technology, including subledger, general ledger, financial control or regulatory reporting platforms.

* Experience delivering large-scale Finance or enterprise transformation within a global financial institution.
* Experience with large-scale platform or cloud modernization.
* Knowledge of modern technologies and patterns including Java, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, AWS/cloud technologies, DevSecOps and modern data platforms.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering, developer productivity tooling or intelligent test automation at enterprise scale.
* Experience developing product-oriented and Agile engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing insourcing strategies and transferring critical technology or domain capability from third-party providers into permanent engineering teams.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations, particularly across India, the UK and US.
* Understanding of technology economics and experience optimizing engineering investment, infrastructure costs and third-party expenditure.

****Accountabilities****
The Head of Engineering will have clear accountability across the following areas:
  
  
**Technology & Architecture**

* Technical health and strategic evolution of the Revenue Accounting technology estate within the role's remit.
* Alignment to enterprise architecture, engineering and technology standards.
* Reduction of legacy complexity and technical debt.
* Creation of sustainable, resilient and scalable technology solutions.

**Engineering & Delivery**

* Quality, predictability and effectiveness of engineering delivery.
* Engineering standards and controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Effective management of engineering capacity, dependencies and technology risks.
* Continuous improvement of engineering productivity, quality and time to market.

**Service, Resilience & Controls**

* Stability, resilience, security and maintainability of technology platforms.
* Effective management of production risk, recurring incidents and systemic technology issues.
* Compliance with applicable technology, cyber, data, resilience and regulatory requirements.
* Timely identification, escalation and remediation of material technology risks and control weaknesses.

**People & Organization**

* Organizational health and effectiveness of the India Revenue Accounting engineering function.
* Workforce strategy, organizational design and location strategy.
* Attraction, retention, development and succession of engineering talent.
* Development of strong engineering and technology leadership capability.
* Reduction of key-person risk and inappropriate dependency on external providers.

jobs.title: Manager - Technology & Engineering
jobs.description:
We are looking for experienced professionals who have spent years proving themselves but haven't always received the recognition they deserve. We don't necessarily want people with impressive designations, big corporate titles, or fancy resumes. We want people with real skills, strong execution capabilities, fresh ideas, and an ownership mindset.

**Your skills deserve more than just a designation**

* Have you ever been the person who solves the toughest technical problems, builds systems from scratch, keeps things running, and makes technology work, yet rarely gets the recognition you deserve?
* We believe great technology professionals aren't defined by their job titles. They are defined by what they build, what they solve, and the impact they create.
* We are looking for an experienced, ambitious, and technically strong professional who wants to take ownership of technology and engineering initiatives and help build something meaningful.

**What will you be responsible for?**

* Develop and drive the organization's technology and engineering roadmap.
* Oversee software development, technical infrastructure, and technology implementation.
* Lead and coordinate engineering teams and technology initiatives.
* Build scalable, secure, and efficient systems and processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation, AI integration, and digital transformation.
* Establish engineering standards, development processes, and quality benchmarks.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and implement relevant solutions.
* Collaborate with business teams to translate business requirements into technology solutions.
* Manage technology projects, timelines, resources, and implementation.
* Take ownership of technology performance, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**What are we looking for?**

* 7-10 years of experience in technology, software engineering, technical operations, or technical program management.
* Strong understanding of software development and modern technology infrastructure.
* Experience managing technology initiatives and engineering teams.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs, databases, cybersecurity, and system architecture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to independently make decisions and execute ideas.
* An ownership mindset and a passion for building rather than merely maintaining.

**What does success look like?**

* Reliable, scalable, and efficient technology infrastructure.
* Successful execution of engineering initiatives.
* Improved engineering productivity.
* Effective automation and technology integration.
* Reduced operational inefficiencies.
* Technology that contributes directly to business growth.

**This is not a conventional salary-based opportunity. We believe those who help build value should have the opportunity to participate in that value.**

Our compensation structure is designed around:

* Revenue Sharing: Participation through mutually agreed revenue-sharing arrangements, subject to defined terms and performance parameters.
* ESOPs: Employee Stock Option opportunities, subject to eligibility, company policy, vesting, and applicable terms.
* Ownership: The opportunity to influence technology decisions, build systems, and take meaningful functional responsibility.

**Who should apply?**

Someone who has spent years building technology for others and is now ready to help build something they can genuinely take ownership of. If you have the experience, the capability, and the hunger to prove what you can do, we want to hear from you.

**2. Process Optimization & Operational Excellence**

* Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and other operational excellence practices.

* Work closely with Quality and Engineering teams to resolve process-related quality issues.
* Ensure proper process control, traceability, and documentation throughout production.

**4. Maintenance & Equipment Management**

* Coordinate with the Maintenance team to ensure equipment reliability and minimum downtime.
* Drive preventive and predictive maintenance practices for forging equipment and furnaces.
* Support equipment upgrades, capacity expansion, tooling improvements, and new process implementation.

**5. Safety & Compliance**

* Identify training needs and improve technical competencies and workforce productivity.
* Foster collaboration across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain functions.

* Minimum **15+ years of experience** in manufacturing, preferably in the steel, forging, automotive components, heavy engineering, or allied industries.
