jobs.title: Senior Vice President- Regional Head- South India-MSF IWPB
jobs.description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute the regional sales strategy for the Mobile Sales Force, delivering sustainable growth across customer acquisition, retail assets, liabilities, cards, personal loans, investments, insurance, foreign exchange and other relevant products.
* Acquire and deepen relationships with Premier and Advance customers, including New to Bank customers, through coordinated sales across liabilities, wealth and lending products.
* Deliver revenue, volume, productivity and profitability targets while maintaining disciplined control of acquisition costs, overheads and resource allocation.
* Build a customer-centric, high-performing regional sales organisation by integrating product teams, strengthening sales management practices and driving consistent service standards.
* Identify market opportunities, customer needs and competitor activity, using insights to refine regional plans, improve distribution reach and develop new revenue opportunities.
* Partner with branches, Direct, Wealth and other Group businesses to maximise referrals, customer migration and relationship opportunities, including corporate employee programmes and third-party distribution partnerships.
* Lead, coach and develop the regional sales team, fostering an inclusive, collaborative and performance-driven culture with clear accountability for results and customer outcomes.
* Own the end-to-end sales and customer onboarding process, ensuring a consistent customer experience and timely resolution of service issues.
* Maintain effective governance and controls across sales operations, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, Group standards, Financial Crime Compliance requirements and internal procedures.
* Identify, assess and mitigate operational, fraud, credit, conduct and reputational risks; ensure control weaknesses, audit findings and regulatory issues are addressed promptly.
* Work closely with Credit, Collections, Fraud, Compliance and other stakeholders to maintain portfolio quality, minimise delinquencies and support responsible growth.
* Ensure mandatory training, accreditation and compliance objectives are completed by the team within required timelines.

**Qualifications / Skills**

* Postgraduate qualification in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing or a related discipline.
* Typically 5–10 years’ experience in retail banking, wealth management, financial services sales or a related commercial environment.
* Proven experience leading a geographically dispersed sales force and managing managers or large, multi-product sales teams.
* Strong track record in customer acquisition, relationship deepening, revenue growth and delivery of business targets.
* Experience across retail banking products such as deposits, lending, cards, investments, insurance and foreign exchange.
* Strong commercial and financial management skills, including productivity, profitability, acquisition-cost and expense management.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute regional sales strategies using market, customer and competitor insights.
* Strong customer focus, with the ability to improve onboarding, service quality, loyalty and retention.
* Effective coaching, people leadership and change-management skills, with the ability to build a collaborative and performance-led culture.
* Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills across branches, product teams, wealth, corporate banking, operations, risk and control functions.
* Sound understanding of operational risk, conduct, fraud prevention, credit quality, Anti-Money Laundering, customer due diligence and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to establish robust governance, monitor controls and ensure timely remediation of issues.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and decision-making skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability and commitment to responsible customer and business outcomes.
* Proficiency in using management information, sales-performance metrics and data to drive decisions and improve productivity.

**Pro-Tip:**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Director - Risk Management & Legal
jobs.description:
At Capital One, we’re building a leading information-based technology company. Still founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking.

At Capital One India, we are at the cutting edge of solving fundamental business problems using advanced data methodologies, statistics, and machine learning algorithms. We analyze data to derive valuable business insights, make decisions, and develop innovative and patentable products.

Directors in Risk Management at Capital One are highly motivated Risk Management professionals with excellent organizational, leadership and communication skills. They have a high level of exposure across lines of business and the opportunity to work with Executives to create and implement innovative solutions to identify and mitigate potential risks to the Company. You will lead a team of Risk Specialists and Legal professionals and act as a thought leader working across the enterprise to develop and implement cutting edge Risk and Legal solutions to ensure Capital One’s continued stability and success. You will partner with Executives and lines of business to drive organizational change in order to better manage the Company’s Risk in an open, collaborative environment where new ideas and solutions are both welcomed and rewarded.

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify opportunities to improve our Risk Management and Legal processes and execute well-managed change to strategies, methodologies, governance, and reporting elements
* Lead and oversee risk and legal functions and deliverables from Risk and Legal team
* Synthesize and elevate information to executive levels to drive action
* Leverage data, metrics, and analysis to create a comprehensive approach to monitoring our process improvement strategies as they move through the organization
* Work with business partners to validate risk processes impacting the company’s bottom line
* Define and implement operating models / interaction models with multiple stakeholder teams ensuring consistency in risk and legal operations between teams
* Consult on analysis and reporting outcomes to observe trends and provide insights on changes to the Company’s risk environments
* Perform and support detailed validation data analysis to include trending, problem identification, and development/completion of remediation plans
* Collaborate effectively with stakeholders and leaders across multiple organizations to achieve objectives
* Play a key role in contributing to the effective design and delivery of our risk management and legal framework
* Demonstrate problem-solving and analysis skills with attention to detail
* Demonstrate strong communication, collaboration, problem solving and influencing skills across various levels of the organization
* Actively support internal and external audits and exams
* Balance multiple priorities to help drive business value and support team objectives, while managing tasks and activities related to risk management initiatives in a well-managed capacity
* Lead a team of professionals to advise and consult key stakeholders to drive effective risk identification, assessment, and disposition.
* Set direction, manage expectations, and lead cross-functional teams
* Foster an environment of trust, collaboration & belonging while leading a team

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s/Master's Degree
* At least 18 years of experience in risk management
* At least 8 years of experience in people management
* At least 10 years of experience in financial services

This role owns and administers Empower's Travel & Expense (T&E) program, corporate card program, and Vendor Master processes. Responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant expense reimbursement processing, corporate card administration, system governance, and vendor master data creation & maintenance. Serves as a key point of contact for associates, business stakeholders, and external service providers, driving policy compliance, operational excellence, reporting accuracy, process effectiveness, and continuous improvement across Travel & Expense, corporate card, and Vendor Master operations.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

List in order of impact to the company which may or may not be the same as the amount of time required to complete the listed responsibility.**

* Administer the corporate card program, to include ordering and deactivating corporate cards, monitoring past due balances, etc.
* Audit travel expense reports in Concur and validate adherence to travel guidelines and company policies.
* Support the execution of internal controls related to travel and expense processing, corporate card administration, and vendor master maintenance.
* Investigate and resolve complex travel and expense inquiries, partnering with associates and business stakeholders as needed

**Senior Manager/Manager - Underwriting Operations Job Description**

**About the Role**

Consolidated Analytics Inc is a key player in the US Real Estate space offering full suite of Mortgage support services to its clients. These comprise of Valuation services, Post Close Audit support, Fulfilment support, Default support, Investor Claims and consulting advisory services. Most importantly, the Due Diligence Division of CA Inc offers third party rating services (FITCH, SsP GLOBAL, KROLL, MORNINGSTAR, AND DRBS) through its unique underwriting solutions to customers in the Capital Markets space. The underwriting solution is also extended to both originations and default operations to some of the clients.

This is a competitive space that CA has positioned itself as a formidable player in. To stay competitive and ahead of the game, CA constantly endeavors to reengineer its UW processes and the supporting tech to stay agile, relevant and most sought after by its clients.

The Due diligence businesses won by nimble players who can turn around files faster and in an accurate fashion. Bids are won on who has the largest capacity, quicker throughputs and scalable options.CA is seeking Senior Manager - Underwriting Operations, who can develop strategies, re-engineer process workflows, adopt cutting-edge technologies faster, build capacity and churn deliverables in a timely manner.

**Current Operation Model**

The current model of operations follows a seamless integrated model comprising of onshore and offshore team members. The offshore unit predominantly assists in performing bookmarking and data extraction activities on a loan file. The Data extraction is performed across Credit, Income and Compliance sections of the loan file. Bookmarking ensures bookmarking consistency across the labelling of each document, chronologically arranging similar documents, removal of duplicate documents, re-arranging misplaced documents and nesting bookmarks under a header bookmark. Currently both bookmarking and data extraction are performed using a third-party AI driven software. From the Offshore side, the Underwriters collect data and review on the following areas: Credit (Income Calculation) and Compliance.

**Description of the Role**

As part of the responsibility, the Senior Manager - Underwriting Operations, is required to conceive, design, develop and roll out strategies that can result in the following outcomes:

1. Process Transformation in the Offshore Underwriting Operations
2. Daily Throughput Management
3. Staffing Optimization s Productivity Enhancement
4. Knowledge Transfer s Process Stabilization
5. Client Services s Engagement

**Key Performance Indices**

As part of performance management, the SOC will be assessed on the following KPIs. The weightage of the KPI parameters can be discussed and agreed between the SOC and the President of the organization.

**Responsibilities**

1. Support in screening, interviewing and hiring new underwriters
2. To provide effective strategies for building and growing the DIS Underwriting Operations. The goal is to build a strong team of 100 offshore underwriters.
3. Oversee progress of classroom and on job training.
4. Oversee Production ramp up to meet the required level.
5. Monitor quality level and give directions to progress on quality level.
6. Work with Presales manager to pitch for new business.
7. Provide the necessary day-to-day business report (MIS, Executive Summary Report, Business Insights)
8. Manage the SLA and delivery obligations made with the client.
9. Other activities that are mutually agreed over email or as an amendment to this agreement, as the project progresses.

**Qualifications**

1. Should possess a minimum of 15 years of experience in US real estate underwriting operations
2. Should have managed US Clients in the Real Estate Underwriting space (Collateral, Capital, Capacity, Credit)
3. Should be open to supporting the US Time zone
4. Should be open to travel to US on a periodic basis and hence should have a B1/B2 business visa.

* **NMLS (Nationwide Multistate Licensing System) certification/license is Mandatory.**

team within Finance. This role is located in

In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
  
  

* Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.
* Plan & forecast: Own the end-to-end Balance Sheet and Net Interest Income (NII) plan and forecast process (plan rounds, rest-of-year and multi-year outlooks) for supported Lines of Business, ensuring a consistent methodology and timely submission into planning systems.
* Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.
* NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.
* Subject-matter expertise: Provide leadership on Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), liquidity metrics (LCR and liquidity stress testing), interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing balance dynamics, and assess the impact of central bank rate changes, client flows and product/currency mix on deposits and NII.
* Reporting & analytics: Oversee daily, weekly, month-end and quarterly reporting – including month-to-date NII estimates, earnings support, management memos and client-, LOB- and firm-level analytics such as deposit pricing cohorts, client movers and beta analysis.
* Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.
* Scope expansion: Identify and lead the transition of new LOBs, platforms and processes into the India hub, partnering with Finance Data Strategy, Technology and other Centers of Excellence on firm-wide initiatives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
  
  

* Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.
* Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.
* Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.
* Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.
* People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at:

jobs.description:
**About CIBC:**

CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.

**About CIBC India:**

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

The Director, EFTR & STR Operations is responsible for providing strategic leadership and oversight to the Hyderabad-based operations supporting Electronic Funds Transfer Report (EFTR) and Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) processing within Enterprise Anti-Money Laundering (EAML). The incumbent drives operational excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement across a high-volume regulatory reporting environment, ensuring the timely, accurate, and efficient execution of reporting activities in alignment with CIBC’s strategic objectives and regulatory obligations. The role partners closely with the Financial Intelligence Unit and key stakeholders across EAML to enable strong execution, effective governance, and sustained operational effectiveness.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

* Lead and direct the EFTR and STR Operations organization, setting strategic direction and ensuring alignment with enterprise goals and AML priorities
* Oversee end-to-end EFTR and STR processing operations, ensuring efficiency, quality, compliance, and adherence to service level expectations and regulatory timelines
* Lead and develop managers and operational teams responsible for EFTR and STR processing, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and excellence
* Maintain strong controls, governance, and oversight practices to support regulatory and internal compliance requirements across all activities within scope
* Identify operational risks, control gaps, and process improvement opportunities, and lead remediation efforts to strengthen reporting effectiveness and operational resilience
* Partner closely with the Financial Intelligence Unit and key stakeholders across EAML to support effective execution, issue resolution, and alignment on business priorities
* Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance indicators, quality outcomes, and operational trends to support continuous improvement and strategic decision-making
* Champion process improvement, reporting enhancements, and change initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, and overall operational effectiveness
* Ensure rigorous adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies, and control standards across the EFTR and STR operating environment
* Support business planning, resource allocation, and organizational effectiveness to meet current and future business needs
* Represent EFTR and STR Operations in enterprise-wide programs, governance forums, and strategic initiatives related to AML operations and regulatory reporting

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Build and maintain strong partnerships with senior leaders across EAML, the Financial Intelligence Unit, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and Operations to align strategic objectives and deliver integrated solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive operational improvements, strengthen governance, and support regulatory compliance. Represent the business area in leadership forums and enterprise discussions, advocating operational priorities, and influencing business outcomes.

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As a manager of people, this job must ensure all employees within the business unit comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls. The incumbent is accountable for maintaining a strong control environment and ensuring adherence to regulatory reporting requirements, data governance standards, privacy obligations, and information security protocols across all activities within scope.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a manager of people, this job has the authority to assign tasks to employees within their span of control, select individuals for hire, assess individual performance, make employee compensation decisions and take disciplinary measures up to and including termination. The role also has the authority to recommend and implement operational changes, process improvements, and control enhancements to strengthen efficiency, quality, and compliance outcomes.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Oversees the strategic delivery and continuous improvement of EFTR and STR operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant regulatory reporting outcomes in support of CIBC’s AML program. Drives alignment with CIBC’s objectives for operational excellence, risk mitigation, regulatory adherence, and stakeholder confidence. **Business Ecosystem**

The Senior Financial Controller will drive financial control and reporting discipline across the group's ecosystem, which includes multiple business verticals and associated entities involved in workspace development, operations, technology, and business services. The role operates in a multi-entity, high-growth environment and requires strong governance, process ownership, and financial discipline across:

* Managed Office Solutions
* Coworking Spaces
* Enterprise Workspace Solutions
* Commercial Real Estate
* Design & Build
* Infrastructure Development
* Facility & Workplace Operations
* Technology-enabled Workplace Solutions
* Business Support Services

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Financial Controller will own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, Compliance, Taxation, and MIS Reporting across the organization, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control at every stage of the financial close and reporting cycle. As a senior member of the Finance leadership team, the role will work closely with the CFO and business heads to translate financial strategy into disciplined execution, and will step in on select strategic finance, treasury, and fundraising-support responsibilities that a growing multi-entity business demands.

This is a controllership-first role with meaningful exposure to strategic finance, ideal for a finance leader who wants to build and run the core finance engine of a fast-scaling company while growing into broader CFO-level responsibilities over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Finance & Accounting Operations (Core Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, and Payroll Accounting.
* Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing across all entities.
* Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements for the group.
* Own MIS Reporting and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of management reports.
* Build and maintain scalable accounting processes and standard operating procedures across a multi-entity structure.

**Taxation & Regulatory Compliance (Core Ownership)**

* Ensure full compliance across GST, Income Tax, TDS, and Companies Act requirements.
* Oversee Secretarial Compliance and ROC filings in coordination with company secretarial support.
* Lead Statutory Audits and Internal Audits, and act as the primary point of contact for auditors.
* Strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and overall financial governance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day cash flow planning and working capital optimization.
* Maintain and strengthen banking relationships across the group.
* Support debt servicing, liquidity management, and treasury operations.

**FP&A and Business Finance**

* Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecasts.
* Track financial KPIs and business intelligence reporting for leadership review.
* Partner with business leaders to evaluate profitability, support pricing decisions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Recommend and drive cost optimization initiatives across business units.

**Strategic Finance Support (Partnering with CFO)**

* Support financial due diligence for M&A, investments, and joint ventures as needed.
* Assist in preparing financial models, investor presentations, and materials for lender / PE / VC interactions.
* Contribute financial insights to Board-level and leadership reporting.
* Support post-merger financial integration for acquired businesses.

**Risk Management & Governance**

* Strengthen internal controls and enterprise risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies across all entities.
* Identify and mitigate financial and compliance risks proactively.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the accounting, taxation, and compliance teams.
* Build a high-performing, process-driven finance function capable of supporting rapid national growth.
* Act as a key escalation point for finance operations, deputizing for the CFO on controllership matters when required.

**Requirements**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA Finance is mandatory.
* Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, with strong hands-on controllership exposure.
* Proven experience owning the complete accounting close, MIS, and compliance function.
* Strong exposure to Accounting, Taxation, Compliance, Audit, and Financial Governance; working exposure to FP&A and Treasury preferred.
* Experience managing finance teams in a multi-location / multi-entity organization.
* Exposure to fundraising, due diligence, or investor reporting is an added advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong process orientation with the ability to build scalable financial systems and controls.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: Up to ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. Zoho Books Management - Maintain complete and accurate accounting records in Zoho Books. - Record daily sales, purchases, receipts, payments and journal entries. - Maintain customer and supplier ledgers. - Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable. - Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries. - Maintain proper documentation of all financial transactions. B. GST & Statutory Compliance - Prepare and verify GST sales and purchase data. - Coordinate preparation and filing of GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. - Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records. - Verify GST input tax credit eligibility. - Coordinate with external auditors and tax consultants. - Maintain TDS records and assist with statutory compliance. C. Banking & Financial Transactions - Perform bank reconciliations regularly. - Monitor customer collections and supplier payments. - Maintain cash and bank books. - Prepare payment schedules. - Track outstanding receivables and payables. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. F. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare periodic reports for management, including: - Daily sales and purchase reports. - Customer outstanding and ageing reports. - Supplier outstanding reports. - Stock and inventory reports. - Monthly Profit & Loss statement. - Cash flow and fund position. - Expense analysis. - Product-wise and business-wise profitability reports, wherever data is available. 3. Required Qualifications & Experience - B.Com / M.Com or equivalent qualification. - 2–5 years of accounting experience. - Hands-on experience in Zoho Books is essential. - Good knowledge of GST and Indian accounting practices. - Experience with inventory accounting. - Knowledge of Excel and spreadsheets. - Experience in manufacturing, processing or trading businesses will be an advantage. 4. Skills & Competencies - Strong accounting fundamentals. - High accuracy and attention to detail. - Good analytical and reconciliation skills. - Ability to independently manage daily accounting operations. - Good communication and coordination skills. - Integrity, confidentiality and accountability. - Ability to meet deadlines. 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the accountant will be evaluated on: 1. Accuracy and completeness of accounting entries. 2. Timely completion of bank reconciliations. 3. Timely GST preparation and compliance. 4. Accuracy of customer and supplier balances. 5. Timely submission of monthly MIS reports. 6. Accuracy of inventory and stock reconciliation. 7. Timely identification and reporting of accounting discrepancies. 6. What We Expect We expect the accountant to take ownership of the company's accounting system, ensure that all transactions are properly recorded and reconciled, and provide reliable financial information to management for decision-making. The objective is to maintain a transparent, accurate and well-organised accounting system through Zoho Books.

The Branch CEO / Senior Executive Officer is the accountable executive for MultiPass's DIFC branch and the leader of its next stage of UAE growth. The role combines regulated executive leadership, delivery of a mainland licensing programme, and direct commercial ownership. The successful candidate will protect the branch's regulatory standing, build trusted relationships with regulators and local banking partners, originate revenue personally, and create a high-performing Sales and Business Development organisation.

**The Three Core Mandates**

1.
**Lead the DIFC branch.**
Act as Branch CEO and, subject to regulatory approval, Senior Executive

Officer; own governance, regulatory engagement, compliance, local banking relationships,

operational performance, and the branch's reputation.

2.
**Deliver mainland authorisation.**
Lead the end-to-end programme to identify and obtain the

appropriate UAE mainland electronic-money and/or payment-services licence or authorisation,

working with the relevant federal and mainland authorities and external advisers.

3.
**Grow the revenue base.**
Win strategic clients through personal origination, develop partnerships and distribution channels, and recruit, coach, and scale a UAE Sales and Business Development team with disciplined targets, processes, and economics.

**Key Accountabilities**

**1. Branch Leadership, Regulation and Banking Relationships**

* Serve as the senior accountable executive for the DIFC branch and provide coordination for
* strategy, governance, culture, risk, compliance, operations, and financial performance.
* Maintain a proactive, transparent, and credible relationship with the Dubai Financial Services
* Authority (DFSA), including timely regulatory engagement, notifications, returns, remediation, and responses to supervisory requests.
* Ensure the branch operates within its permissions, policies, risk appetite, and applicable DIFC/DFSA requirements, with particular attention to AML/CFT, sanctions, conduct, safeguarding, prudential oversight, outsourcing, and financial-crime controls.
* Chair or participate in branch governance forums; ensure decisions, delegated authorities, management information, incident escalation, and board or group reporting are clear and effective.
* Own senior relationships with local banks, safeguarding or settlement partners, payment providers, professional advisers, and other critical counterparties; negotiate resilient and commercially sound arrangements.

**2. UAE Mainland Licensing Programme**

* Define the target regulated business model and licensing strategy for mainland UAE, aligned with MultiPass's products, client segments, risk appetite, capital plan, and growth ambitions.
* Lead the feasibility study and business case for the mainland licence.
* Coordinate internal Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Treasury, and People teams, together with external legal and regulatory advisers.
* Oversee preparation of the business plan, governance and ownership materials, financial projections, capital and liquidity plans, policies, control frameworks, technology and outsourcing documentation, and evidence of operational readiness.
* Build constructive relationships with the relevant UAE authorities, including the Central Bank of the UAE where applicable, and ensure all submissions are accurate, consistent, and delivered to the agreed standard and timetable.
* Translate licensing conditions into an executable mobilisation plan and ensure the mainland entity or operation is ready to launch without weakening the DIFC branch's controls or service quality.

**3. Revenue Growth and Commercial Team Build**

* Own the UAE branch revenue plan, client-acquisition strategy, commercial pipeline, and contribution to profitability, with clear monthly and quarterly targets.
* Personally originate, negotiate, and close high-value clients and strategic partnerships, particularly among internationally active businesses requiring multi-currency accounts, cross-border payments, and FX services.
* Develop a strong network across the UAE business, banking, professional-services, investment, and fintech communities and represent MultiPass at relevant market and industry forums.
* Recruit and lead the Sales and Business Development team; define coverage, roles, incentives, targets, account ownership, onboarding standards, and performance-management routines.
* Implement a disciplined commercial operating system covering CRM hygiene, lead qualification, pipeline reviews, conversion, pricing governance, revenue attribution, forecasting, client retention, and cross-sell.
* Work closely with Compliance, Product, Operations, Treasury, and Group leadership to ensure commercial growth remains within risk appetite and that client feedback informs product and service development.

**4. People, Operations and Profitability**

* Build a high-accountability, client-focused branch culture in line with DYNINNO Corporate Values.
* Own the branch operating plan and budget; manage cost, headcount, vendor performance, revenue quality, and progress toward sustainable profitability.
* Ensure the branch has appropriate business-continuity, operational-resilience, information-security, complaints, and incident-management arrangements.
* Provide concise, decision-useful reporting to Group leadership and the Board.

**Requirements**

* Senior leadership experience as a CEO, Managing Director, Country Head or equivalent within regulated payments, electronic money, B2B fintech or transaction banking.
* Strong UAE market knowledge, including practical experience engaging with regulators and understanding DIFC/DFSA requirements and the UAE mainland regulatory environment.
* Experience leading licensing or authorisation programmes, including regulatory submissions, coordination with external advisers and preparation for operational launch. UAE payments or electronic-money licensing experience is strongly preferred.
* Proven personal track record in B2B client acquisition, negotiating and closing high-value corporate clients and strategic partnerships, ideally in cross-border payments, multi-currency accounts or FX.
* An established UAE business and banking network, with the ability to develop relationships with corporate clients, local banks, payment providers and referral partners.
* Experience building and leading Sales and Business Development teams, with clear revenue targets, pipeline management, forecasting and performance accountability.
* Strong governance, risk and compliance expertise, including AML/CFT, sanctions, financial-crime controls and operational resilience.
* P&L and operational leadership experience, covering business planning, budgeting, cost management and sustainable revenue growth.
* Ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives, working closely with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product, Technology and Operations, and reporting effectively to Group leadership and the Board.

----------------

**Role Description:**

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. Without this role and process, KYC could introduce significant risks related to regulatory and internal audit findings for insufficient KYC program and controls. These results would lead to significant remediation population, remediation populations, procedures changes or even MRA (Matters Requiring Attention) if identified by a regulator.

Partner with internal units to ensure adequate due diligence process is carried out for customer accounts and documentation reviews.

Ensure all AML risks are mitigated based on local regulation and internal procedural requirements.

jobs.title: Transition Solution Design & Execution Lead, Finance Managed Services
jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Executive Director**
- Transition Solution Design & Execution Lead, Finance Managed Services
  
  
**Portfolio**
Finance Managed Services
  
  
**Primary focus**
Enterprise transition strategy, deal shaping, mobilization assurance and transition innovation
  
  
**Location -**
India GDS Location
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Executive Director - Managed Services Transition Principal is a senior individual contributor accountable for defining, shaping and assuring the most complex and strategically significant Finance Managed Services transitions across Finance Managed Services. The role operates as EY’s authoritative transition specialist on major pursuits and mobilizations, providing independent judgement, deep subject-matter expertise and executive-level client counsel from RFP strategy through stable operations.
  
  
The role does not rely on formal line-management authority. Its Executive Director scope is created through enterprise-wide influence, ownership of high-value and high-risk transition outcomes, direct engagement with C-suite and Partner stakeholders, and stewardship of EY transition methods, intellectual property and digitally enabled practices. The incumbent personally intervenes at critical points, resolves ambiguity across commercial, operational, technology and people dimensions, and sets the standard for transition quality across portfolios and geographies.
  
  
**Role Scope and Impact**

* Provide domain authority across Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Financial Planning and Analysis, tax, treasury and controllership transitions, adapting the scope to the services included in each client solution.
* Ensure transition designs protect financial control, statutory and regulatory obligations, close and reporting timetables, cash flow, working capital and business continuity.
* Provide transition leadership for the largest, most complex and highest-risk Finance Managed Services opportunities, including deals with multi-tower, multi-country, regulated, carve-out, transformation or accelerated-mobilization characteristics.
* Own the integrity of transition solutions and mobilization outcomes for assigned strategic deals, acting as the single senior subject-matter authority rather than as a people leader.
* Shape pursuits with Service Line Leads, Finance Managed Services Deal Leads, solution architects, commercial teams and delivery executives, translating client requirements into differentiated, executable and commercially viable transition strategies.
* Exercise enterprise-level influence across EY member firms, regions, service lines and third parties to secure alignment where priorities, risk appetites, contractual commitments or delivery models conflict.
* Create reusable transition assets, reference architectures, control frameworks, benchmarks and AI-enabled techniques that improve quality, speed, predictability and margin across the wider Finance Managed Services business.
* Represent EY’s transition proposition with senior client executives during orals, negotiations, governance forums and critical mobilization decisions.

**Essential Functions Of The Job**

* Strategic deal shaping and client leadership

+ Translate the client finance strategy, target operating model and retained-finance responsibilities into an executable transition solution, including service boundaries, controls, data, systems, governance and acceptance criteria.
+ Engage credibly with CFOs, Finance Directors, Controllers and process owners on financial close, reporting, compliance, working capital and service-performance outcomes.
+ Develop compelling transition strategies for complex RFPs, sole-source opportunities and strategic renewals, integrating finance organization, process, policy, controls, data, technology, service management, tax, treasury and commercial considerations.
+ Lead the transition narrative in client orals and executive workshops, using evidence-based storytelling to demonstrate value, manage concerns and establish confidence in EY’s ability to mobilize safely.
+ Advise client C-suite and senior EY leaders on transition feasibility, sequencing, risk exposure, investment choices and trade-offs, particularly where requirements are incomplete or competing objectives cannot all be achieved.
+ Challenge deal assumptions and contractual commitments where transition risk, dependency, cost or timing is not adequately understood.

* Transition solution design & execution assurance

+ Architect transition waves that account for period-end and year-end close, statutory reporting, audit dependencies, tax calendars, treasury cut-offs and business-critical finance cycles.
+ Assure the design and operation of financial controls, segregation of duties, data reconciliation, opening balances, knowledge transfer, service acceptance and retained-organisation readiness.
+ Architect end-to-end transition approaches for highly interdependent finance process towers, retained organisations, delivery locations and geographies, defining critical paths, entry and exit criteria, governance, control points, dependencies and operational acceptance requirements.
+ Provide independent assurance across mobilization, identifying systemic risks early and directing corrective action through accountable delivery owners without assuming permanent line-management responsibility.
+ Act as the senior escalation point for transition issues with material client, regulatory, financial, reputational or service-continuity implications.
+ Confirm that transitions achieve safe landing into steady-state operations, with clear ownership, measurable readiness and no unmanaged residual risk.

* Functional authority and innovation

+ Own and evolve selected elements of EY’s Finance Managed Services transition methodology, playbooks, quality standards and governance principles.
+ Develop industry-leading transition techniques using AI, automation, data-led assurance and digital collaboration tools.
+ Convert experience from strategic deals into reusable intellectual property, patterns, benchmarks and lessons that can be adopted across portfolios.
+ Provide expert coaching and technical direction to deal and transition practitioners through communities of practice, design reviews and targeted interventions, without direct supervisory accountability.
+ Build external market credibility through client forums, thought leadership, alliance activity and selected industry engagement.

* Analytical and Decision-Making Responsibilities

+ Evaluate finance-specific trade-offs involving control effectiveness, close stability, reporting accuracy, working-capital impact, service cost, standardisation and regulatory exposure.
+ Determine whether process, data and control readiness is sufficient to proceed with migration, parallel run, cutover and operational acceptance.
+ Solve novel, ambiguous and enterprise-scale transition problems for which established precedents may not exist.
+ Make or recommend high-consequence decisions on transition design, sequencing, risk treatment, governance and readiness within delegated authority.
+ Evaluate complex commercial and delivery trade-offs, including speed versus control, standardization versus client specificity, investment versus risk, and short-term mobilization needs versus long-term service sustainability.
+ Form an independent point of view from incomplete and sometimes conflicting information and communicate that view credibly to Partners and client executives.

jobs.title: Director-Technology Controls Testing Team Lead
jobs.description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest and growing banks in the world.

**Profile Summary:**

The Technology Controls Team Lead leads the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team and the EMEA Technology Internal Control Testing Programme.

The role is responsible for the risk-based assessment of technology controls, including control design and operating effectiveness testing, evidence quality, issue identification, remediation monitoring and management reporting. The role also develops data-led, automated and continuous control-assurance capabilities.

Working across EMEA Technology, the role partners with control owners, Technology leadership and relevant oversight and assurance functions to strengthen the technology control environment while maintaining clear accountability across the three lines of defense.

**Technology Controls Framework and Testing:**

* Own and maintain the EMEA Technology Controls Testing Framework.
* Lead the Technology Internal Control Testing Programme, including methodology, planning, scope, approval, execution, quality assurance and reporting.
* Develop a risk-based testing plan using RCSA results, process mapping, risk appetite measures, incidents, control failures, audit findings, regulatory priorities and material technology changes.
* Prioritize controls associated with Critical and High inherent risks, while including Moderate-rated controls where justified by risk concentration, limited assurance coverage, control failures or emerging risk.
* Maintain a technology testing inventory covering control ownership, risk linkage, testing frequency, previous results, existing assurance coverage and open issues.
* Lead control walkthroughs and assessments of control design and operating effectiveness.
* Define testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Ensure conclusions are supported by complete, reliable and traceable evidence.
* Coordinate with IT Risk Assurance lead on SOX, Compliance, Head Office and other assurance programmes to minimize unnecessary duplication.
* Continuously improve testing methodology, guidance, templates and supporting tools.

**Issues and Remediation:**

* Ensure control deficiencies, self-identified issues, risk acceptances and treatment plans are consistently identified, recorded and escalated.
* Challenge control ownership, testing conclusions, remediation plans and proposed issue closure.
* Ensure remediation actions have clear owners and target dates.
* Monitor remediation through to closure and arrange validation or retesting where required.
* Identify recurring or systemic control weaknesses requiring coordinated remediation.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue actions and risk appetite breaches through the appropriate governance channels.

**Audit and Regulatory Readiness:**

* Coordinate Technology responses to internal audit, external audit, SOX and regulatory assurance activity.
* Maintain a coordinated view of assurance activity, findings, evidence requests, management responses and remediation commitments.
* Improve the quality and timeliness of evidence, walkthroughs and management responses.
* Maintain a reusable regional evidence base to support assurance activity.
* Ensure recurring audit and regulatory themes inform the control framework, testing plan and remediation priorities.
* Support senior-management and regulatory briefings on material technology control matters.

**Reporting and Governance:**

* Own management information covering technology control testing delivery, control effectiveness, issues, remediation, risk acceptances and recurring themes.
* Provide concise, accurate and decision-oriented reporting to Technology leadership and relevant governance forums.
* Act as the central escalation and prioritisation point for Technology control-testing matters.
* Represent the Chief Technology Controls Team at relevant committees and working groups.
* Ensure material control weaknesses and risks are escalated promptly and transparently.

**Data, Tools and Continuous Assurance:**

* Own the Technology Controls testing toolset, workflows, dashboards and analytics capability.
* Ensure testing plans, evidence, samples, conclusions, issues and remediation records are accurately maintained in approved repositories.
* Establish standards for evidence quality, naming, ownership, version control, retention, permissions and audit traceability.
* Lead evidence coordination and quality review with process and control owners.
* Develop automated monitoring and continuous control-testing capabilities where supported by reliable data and repeatable testing logic.
* Define appropriate governance for automated testing, including data quality, access, change control, exception handling and periodic validation.
* Explore the responsible use of AI to support evidence review, control mapping, testing preparation, exception identification, thematic analysis and reporting.
* Ensure that automation and AI retain appropriate governance, validation and human oversight.

**Leadership and People Management:**

* Lead and develop the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team, initially comprising three VP-level control resources.
* Set team priorities and allocate coverage according to risk, assurance requirements and business demand.
* Lead implementation of the target operating model.
* Establish clear objectives, accountabilities and quality expectations.
* Build team capability through training, coaching and knowledge management.
* Promote a constructive, evidence-led risk and control culture.
* Provide broader local Technology Management or Operations oversight only where formally assigned.

**Decision Authority (Within delegated authority, the role may):**

* Approve the proposed testing plan and material scope changes before governance submission.
* Determine testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Require additional evidence, expanded testing or retesting.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue remediation and inadequate risk acceptance.
* Prioritise team activity and allocate testing resources.
* Recommend control improvements and automation opportunities.
  ***Control owners remain accountable for operating their controls and remediating identified weaknesses. Risk acceptance remains subject to approval under the applicable risk-management framework.***

**Experience and Skills:**

* Significant experience in technology risk, technology controls, IT audit, cyber risk or a related discipline within regulated financial services.
* Experience leading a technology control-testing or management-assurance programme.
* Strong knowledge of control design and operating effectiveness testing, including walkthroughs, evidence assessment, sampling, reperformance and issue validation.
* Experience of RCSA, risk appetite, issue management, risk acceptance and governance reporting.
* Broad understanding of material technology risks and controls.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews or SOX activity.
* Proven leadership of senior risk or control professionals.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to challenge constructively and explain complex control matters to senior management.
* Ability to work effectively across jurisdictions and multicultural teams.

jobs.title: Associate Director/Director - GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation
jobs.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation Lead to anchor the DESIS GenAI-for-Business ("GAIBiz") effort. Depending on the candidate’s location preference, the position is open for either of our Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram offices in India. This person will be responsible for translating the firm's GenAI strategy into tangible adoption and measurable outcomes across the DESIS environment, working in close partnership with the strategy and transformation core based in the firm's global offices. This is a role largely built around execution and adoption. The strategy setting and transformation agenda is driven centrally; the mandate here is to land that agenda well within DESIS, shaping it for the local context, driving uptake, and delivering results on the ground. There will be real opportunities to influence direction and expand scope over time, but a candidate who thrives will be one who is energized by making things happen, not solely by setting up the agenda. This role will offer a good mix of strategy formulation and hands on delivery experience, tilting more towards later.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will drive GenAI adoption across DESIS by moving initiatives from pilot to production use; conceptualizing and executing novel ways to increase adoption; and owning the associated logistics and change-management scaffolding (enablement, incentives, communications, feedback loops) needed to turn well-designed programs into genuine, sustained uptake. You will partner with the global strategy and transformation core, acting as the DESIS anchor for firmwide GenAI strategy, ensuring initiatives are contextualized, sequenced, and executed effectively in and for the DESIS environment. You will engage credibly with technical teams, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering and data teams, understanding architecture, model capabilities, and tradeoffs well enough to challenge, prioritize, and unblock. You will embed risk, compliance, and data governance, ensuring GenAI initiatives meet the firm's standards for data protection, model risk, regulatory expectations, and responsible-AI practice from the outset, not as an afterthought. Finally, you will measure and communicate impact by defining the metrics that matter, tracking adoption and value realization, and reporting progress clearly to senior stakeholders across DESIS and the global firm.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of experience in leading GenAI and tech transformation, including recent hands-on leadership of Generative AI initiatives
* Sound instincts on when to buy, when to build, and when a middle path serves best, with the commercial sense to weigh cost, speed, and control (Strategic and commercial judgment)
* A demonstrated track record of driving uptake, not just designing programs. Evidence of moving organizations from intent to embedded behavior (Change management and adoption)
* Deep enough understanding of GenAI and modern data/ML systems to engage engineers credibly and make informed trade-offs. You need not be a builder, but you must be conversant (Technical literacy)
* Experience in or adjacent to market finance, hedge funds, or investment management, with enough fluency to earn the trust of demanding stakeholders (Domain credibility)
* Practical familiarity with the risk, regulatory, and data-governance considerations that shape how AI can responsibly be deployed in a financial-services setting (Risk, compliance and data governance)
* Pragmatic and outcome-obsessed approach, with a high tolerance for ambiguity and rapid change. Ability to influence without authority across a distributed, matrixed organization, and comfort in operating primarily in a delivery-focused capacity within a globally driven agenda (Temperament and influencing skills)
* Creativity, critical thinking with excellent written and verbal communication skills and an entrepreneurial mindset to take on challenging, high-impact projects

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/ADGenAIOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

jobs.title: Lead Architect/Senior Associate Director
jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
