jobs.title: Associate Vice President Premier Relationship Manager
jobs.description:
Some careers open more doors than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To build and grow HSBC Premier Banking relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) customers, acting as a single point of contact and providing comprehensive banking support and financial advisory aligned to customer needs. The role focuses on delivering against business targets while meeting Global Premier Service Standards and ensuring strong conduct and regulatory outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibility**

* Grow profit and portfolio value across Premier client relationships through new and existing business
* Deliver agreed financial targets through effective relationship management and consistent service delivery
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services
* Identify wealth review opportunities and provide tailored wealth solutions aligned to customer goals
* Build long-term client relationships that improve retention satisfaction and wallet share
* Maintain accurate client information using client relationship management tools and disciplined record keeping
* Manage a prospect pipeline and apply structured plans to deepen and expand relationships
* Embed HSBC policies and controls including KYC AML and sanctions alongside sales quality requirements

**Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.**
**Eligibility & Educational Qualifications**

* Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline with 4-7 years of relevant experience
* Substantial experience as a Relationship Manager within the Retail or Premier Banking segment
* Proven outcomes in wealth products with a record of meeting portfolio and revenue goals
* Strong wealth management technical knowledge to provide suitable recommendations and advice
* Experience building trusted relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients as a consistent point of contact
* Capability using client relationship management systems to maintain accurate timely client data
* Experience partnering with Compliance Credit and Risk and Internal Control teams to deliver balanced risk outcomes
* Required local regulatory licences and accreditations for wealth management or equivalent demonstrable experience

**Additional Information**
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Director Relationship Manager (FI)
jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* Minimum 10 years’ enterprise sales or direct client coverage and relationship management of a broad spectrum of institutional clients: regional banks, central banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers
* Familiarity with Middle East, GCC and global markets, reflecting cross-border client engagement and product delivery
* Arabic language skills (spoken and written) are an advantage, supporting engagement with regional clients and senior stakeholders
* Strong knowledge of credit, risk, capital markets or regulatory workflows—and the ability to translate GCC regulatory requirements (such as those of the local Central Banks or Capital Monetary Authorities) into Moody’s solutions
* Working knowledge of Moody’s capabilities across KYC and customer onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, commercial and corporate lending, private credit and AI-enabled solutions, with the ability to position them to risk, compliance, credit and technology stakeholders
* Exceptional C-level relationship-building, consultative selling and contract negotiation skills, complemented by independent thought leadership and advisory sales expertise. Demonstrates the ability to generate impactful ideas for clients, influencing outcomes at the highest level
* Demonstrates a strong track record in building and leading high-performing sales teams, with a focus on cross-functional collaboration. Applies strategic planning, pipeline management and disciplined execution to consistently meet or exceed revenue targets
* Excellent communication—listening, presenting and writing—and the confidence to influence senior external and internal stakeholders
* High initiative, resilience and the ability to work independently while fostering teamwork in a matrix environment

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, applied finance, economics or a related field (post graduate finance or risk qualification advantageous)

**Responsibilities**

* Own and expand relationships with the GCC’s Tier 1 banks and a broad spectrum of institutional clients—including central banks, banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers —engaging board and C-suite stakeholders and setting multi-year account strategies aligned to client priorities
* Retain and grow revenue by cross-selling and up-selling the full Moody’s Analytics suite, leveraging advisory sales and innovative solutions across KYC and onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, lending and credit origination, private credit, AI-enabled solutions, credit, ESG, AML, regulatory reporting, data and analytics
* Partner with global product heads to position Moody’s insights in the context of local and regional regulatory and industry trends, including private credit, lending modernisation, AI adoption, automation, KYC and supplier risk management, climate risk and digitised credit workflows
* Travel (~30 %) across the GCC and wider Middle East and, when required, to regional hubs to strengthen senior relationships and align global strategy
* Build, lead and empower high-performing sales teams, fostering talent development and cross-functional collaboration with Product, Specialists, Finance and Legal to drive complex sales cycles, identify new use cases, negotiate commercial terms and close enterprise agreements
* Deliver accurate forecasting and client feedback to senior leadership, surfacing cross-business leads and supporting business growth objectives
* Participate in management and risk committees to support governance, conduct and best execution standards

**About The Team**
You will sit within the Moody’s Analytics Middle East Sales team, a high energy group of enterprise sellers, with this role based in Dubai and focused on the GCC. The team partners with the region’s biggest banks and FIs to deliver Moody’s data, analytics and workflow solutions. Collaboration is core: Relationship Managers lead opportunities while working hand in hand with Product Specialists, Solutions Consultants, Finance and Legal colleagues to solve complex client challenges, accelerate revenue growth and share best practices across the wider regional and global sales organisation.
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

**Job Summary**

* The Executive Director, Client Coverage, Public Sector is the strategic adviser and relationship lead for a portfolio of major public sector clients, primarily across the Middle East (GCC Region). The portfolio includes central banks, ministries of finance, government entities and agencies, export credit and development agencies, multilateral organisations, regional development banks and selected development organisations. The role is accountable for developing senior client relationships, originating and delivering relevant solutions across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking, and achieving sustainable revenues and returns while maintaining strong credit, financial crime, conduct and regulatory risk discipline. The role also supports the regional team head on origination and client engagement across the region and selectively develops approved prospect relationships.

**Portfolio Strategy And Financial Performance**

* Lead client strategies through disciplined account planning and deliver agreed revenue, profitability, RoRWA and franchise objectives for the designated portfolio.

**Origination And Trusted-adviser Coverage**

* Build senior relationships up to ministerial and C-suite level, anticipate client needs, originate new business and position the Bank as a consistent strategic partner rather than a transactional provider.

**Integrated Client Solutions**

* Mobilise Transaction Banking, Financial Markets, Global Banking, structuring, advisory and industry partners to deliver relevant solutions, deepen inbound flows and selectively deploy balance sheet where supported by appropriate ancillary returns and Group economics.

**Sustainable And Innovative Finance**

* Originate and structure sustainable finance solutions including debt-for-nature, debt-for-development and sustainable loans, and replicate successful structures across the public sector segment.

**Risk, Compliance And Portfolio Stewardship**

* Own client acceptance and ongoing risk management, including AML, CDD and credit; maintain accurate account plans, call reports and deal pipelines; identify, escalate and resolve conduct, regulatory, reputational and credit issues.

**Market Insight And Franchise Development**

* Maintain strong knowledge of political, macroeconomic, country-risk and industry developments; bring international best practice, investment opportunities and thought leadership to clients; support investor roadshows, RFPs and industry engagement.

**Collaboration And Execution**

* Maintain effective relationships with Country and Cluster leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Client Management and product teams; ensure timely meeting notes, coordinated execution and high-quality client outcomes across the Bank network.

**Role Scope**

* This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. The role holder is expected to contribute to team capability, knowledge sharing, diversity initiatives and the development of colleagues through informal coaching and collaboration.

**Individual Contribution and Team Leadership**

* Operate as a senior individual contributor, providing leadership through client judgement, execution discipline and collaboration across the regional Public Sector franchise.
* Invest in personal development, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues through coaching, inclusive teamwork and participation in learning and diversity initiatives.
* Maintain mandatory learning, professional development and risk-awareness standards applicable to the role.
* Share sector, thematic and market insights with clients and internal partners to strengthen strategic engagement and the Bank’s market position.

**Motivations**

* Strategic client impact: Energised by solving complex public sector priorities and building trusted relationships with senior government, central bank and development-institution stakeholders.
* Origination and innovation: Motivated by creating commercially sound, differentiated solutions across financing, markets, transaction banking and sustainable finance.
* International collaboration: Thrives in a cross-border environment that requires judgement, resilience, teamwork and effective mobilisation of the Bank’s network.

**Key Experiences, Qualifications And Languages**

* Relevant banking experience, preferably in senior relationship management, origination or sales covering public sector, sovereign, financial institution or development-finance clients.
* Regional market knowledge and exposure is critical.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships, originating cross-product opportunities and coordinating execution across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Banking, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline preferred.
* Strong knowledge of credit, AML, CDD, conduct and regulatory requirements. Any market-specific licence required to undertake banking business must be maintained.
* Fluent English is required.
* Arabic or other relevant regional language capability is advantageous.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.
  
  
This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across Africa. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.
  
  
Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.
  
  
This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.
  
  
Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).
  
  
**This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role based out of Dubai, UAE. We will help secure any required visas.**
**What You’ll Do**

* Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step
* Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account
* Onboard and manage our emerging markets bank partners: Serve as the day-to-day lead for banks across Africa. Guide them through onboarding and own the ongoing relationship once they’re live.
* Build and nurture relationships across various functions within a customer's organization, identifying and creating advocates wherever you go, and helping find new use cases for partnering with Column
* Proactively identify challenges and opportunities for growth, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to find solutions in order to move the relationship forward
* Share key findings and recommendations on market feedback and trends to inform Column’s growth strategy and product roadmap
* Perform day-to-day activities consistent with safe and sound business practices and regulatory requirements
* This role includes periodic travel to Africa to meet with our bank partners in person.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 5+ years of relevant work experience -- strong preference for a mix of Consulting, Private Equity, Investment Banking, VC or an equivalent role plus operating experience in an early stage company and/or selling a new line of business
* Professional fluency in French and English required
* A desire to become very knowledgeable on the financial technology and payments space. Prior experience in financial services can be helpful but certainly not required
* A growth and critical thinking mindset: You’re comfortable navigating ambiguous environments and are energized by the prospect of helping build processes with little guidance
* Excellent project management: You’re organized, can manage all aspects of partnering with customers, and effectively work with other internal teams
* Ability to turn naysayers into champions: You’re a persuasive communicator and understand the importance of being helpful, responsive, and solutions-oriented
* Curiosity: You know what questions to ask to uncover and understand customer needs and proactively learn more about the industry, competitive landscape, and product offerings to better support your customers
* Insatiable hunger for improvement: you’re a naturally curious person, enjoy digging into the data, and regularly solicit feedback

**What You’ll Get From Us**

* 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!
* 🌴 Competitive time-off policy - take the time off that you want and need to relax and recharge
* 🧳 Sabbatical Program - Reach your 5-year anniversary to take up to 8 weeks of fully paid leave to rest, recharge, and pursue personal interest - with full salary and benefits
* 👶 100% paid parental leave, including 16 weeks for birth mothers, 12 weeks for primary caregivers, and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers
* 🎉 Regular team building events, including annual offsite

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

jobs.title: Temenos - SME Business analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced T24 Technical Lead / Solution Architect to drive the end-to-end technical delivery of a core banking implementation. The role will be responsible for owning T24 application development, solution design, customisation, configuration, integration, and production readiness.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Temenos T24 application development, core banking architecture, system integrations, and end-to-end implementation delivery, including at least one full implementation from design through go-live. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, system integrators, and technology teams to ensure the solution aligns with banking requirements, regulatory standards, and approved architectural principles.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application and Development Ownership

* Take ownership of the T24 application build and customisation from project commencement until production go-live.
* Lead and govern the T24 design and development teams, interface teams, and system integrator developers, ensuring alignment with programme scope, plans, milestones, deliverables, risks, and testing from a technology standpoint.
* Establish quality standards for IRDs, IDDs, and FSD documents covering the incumbent bank's products, services, and configurations.
* Own end-to-end delivery governance across all phases and report progress to senior management and steering committees.

2. Solution Design and Architecture

* Coordinate and participate in detailed functional and technical deep-dive sessions with system integrators to validate architecture, scope, IRDs, IDDs, and FSDs against the bank's requirements.
* Lead design discussions with solution designers and bank stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions follow event-driven architecture principles and approved architectural patterns.
* Drive Low-Level Design (LLD) discussions covering T24 Chart of Accounts, customer and account structures, product setup, accounting entries, interfaces with SAS systems, and operational workflows.
* Conduct operational workshops with Finance, Compliance, Risk, Fraud, and Operations teams to finalise process flows and technology integrations.

3. Implementation and Configuration

* Oversee T24 environment setup, parameterisation, configuration, and development of standard and customised functionalities.
* Govern bank-specific configurations and Egypt-specific customisations, ensuring they are justified, documented, and upgrade-safe.
* Oversee DIT, SIT, UAT, performance testing, and Close of Business (COB) readiness.
* Drive cutover activities and ensure production readiness.

4. Integration and Middleware

* Own the T24 integration design with other system integrators and downstream applications, including DMS, Kafka, Camunda, Kong, CRM, AML/KYC, Sanctions, FRM, and Data Lake.
* Oversee Kafka event streaming and real-time messaging of T24 customer, account, and transaction events to SAS systems.
* Govern Camunda workflow orchestration for non-STP case handling, ensuring case outcomes are appropriately posted back to T24.
* Oversee Kong API Gateway integration, including API security and traffic management for T24 APIs.
* Ensure CRM integration supports non-STP workflows and customer interactions.
* Govern SAS system integrations covering customer and account data feeds, transaction screening, fraud checks, and posting of approved outcomes, including restrictions, blocks, and status changes, into T24 following Risk and Compliance clearance.

5. Regulatory and Compliance Alignment

* Ensure T24 configuration, General Ledger, and regulatory reporting meet Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) regulations.
* Ensure compliance with Egyptian AML/CFT requirements, data residency, and information security expectations.
* Apply relevant GCC and international banking compliance practices, including FATF recommendations and OFAC/EU sanctions requirements, while adapting them to the Egyptian regulatory context.
* Support regulatory inspections, audits, and technology-related evidence requests.

6. Stakeholder Management

* Engage and align senior business and technology stakeholders as required.
* Present project status, risks, dependencies, and action points clearly to executive leadership and steering committees.

Role Requirements and Qualifications

* Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in Temenos T24 application development, including at least one complete implementation from design to production go-live.
* Strong technical knowledge of T24 modules, architecture, configuration, customisation, Chart of Accounts, General Ledger, multi-currency processing, and core banking operations.
* Hands-on experience with T24 development tools and frameworks, including OFS, IRIS, REST/SOAP APIs, event and message frameworks, MQ, local routines, enquiries, COB configuration, and TAFJ.
* Strong understanding of core banking processes covering customers, accounts, deposits, payments, accounting, and day-end operations.
* Knowledge of banking integrations involving Kafka, Camunda, Kong, DMS, CRM, AML/KYC, Sanctions, FRM, and Data Lake.
* Understanding of AML/CFT, transaction monitoring, customer risk assessment, CDD/EDD, sanctions screening, and fraud management.
* Familiarity with Egyptian banking regulations, CBE reporting requirements, and data residency expectations.
* Experience in technical delivery governance, system integrator coordination, and stakeholder management.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in large-scale core banking transformation programmes.
* Exposure to Egyptian banking implementations and CBE regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of GCC banking compliance frameworks and regulatory expectations.

**Job Purpose**

The **Associate – Cash Applications** is responsible for the accurate and timely application of customer payments within the Accounts Receivable process. The role involves matching remittance information, clearing open items, reconciling cash receipts, resolving unapplied or unidentified payments, and supporting day-to-day Cash Application activities.

The Associate works closely with customers and internal teams to ensure accurate processing, timely resolution of exceptions, strong controls, and high-quality service delivery.

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Process and apply incoming customer payments accurately and within agreed timelines, including bank transfers, lockbox receipts, cheques, cards, direct debits, and other payment methods.
* Match remittance advice with customer payments and correctly allocate receipts against invoices, customer accounts, deductions, credit notes, and other open items in the ERP system.
* Perform daily cash and bank reconciliation activities and ensure alignment between bank statements, cash receipt records, and the Accounts Receivable sub-ledger.
* Investigate unapplied, unidentified, misapplied, duplicate, short, or excess payments and coordinate with customers and relevant internal teams for resolution.
* Maintain customer accounts, clear open items, process approved adjustments, and follow up on workflow items and process exceptions.
* Handle customer and internal queries through email, calls, workflow tools, and other communication channels.
* Record and execute transactions in line with approved process documentation, accounting policies, service-level agreements, and quality standards.
* Complete required Internal Control System activities accurately and on time and maintain supporting documentation for audit purposes.
* Support month-end and period-end closing activities.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports related to cash posting, unapplied cash, unidentified cash, ageing, productivity, quality, and other relevant KPIs.
* Identify recurring process issues and escalate exceptions or process gaps to the Senior Associate or Team Lead.
* Support process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI initiatives within Cash Applications.
* Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing, cross-training, and continuous-learning activities.

* Experience working in a shared-services, global, or multi-regional environment would be an advantage.
Fresh graduates with relevant accounting/finance knowledge and strong aptitude may also be considered depending on the business requirement.  

**Core Competencies**

* High attention to detail and accuracy.

* Customer-oriented mindset with clear written and verbal communication.

* Good collaboration skills and ability to work with teams across functions and regions.

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

  

**How you will contribute**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Associate – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation.

The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

Expertise across one or more of the following areas

  
  

1. FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment

* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
  

  

2. Finance Process Readiness

* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period-end and year-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven, highly customized, or non-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
  

  

3. Finance Master Data & Chart of Accounts Readiness

* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data.
* Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
  

  

4. Functional Readiness

* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
  

  

5. Data Migration Readiness

* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
  

  

6. Integration & Technology Readiness

* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with:
* MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
  

  

7. Reporting & Management Information Readiness

* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
  

  

8. Controls & Compliance Readiness

* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation-of-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
  

  

9. Stakeholder & Program Leadership

* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
  

  

10. Team Leadership

* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.

  

**Qualifications**

* 3-8 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and their ERP enabl

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  

**Role Summary**  
  
The IT Project Manager is a member of the global Agile Delivery & Project Management team within the Digital Services Team (DST) and reports to the Manager, Agile Delivery. The role leads a broad range of technology projects that support Husky's core business functions. These include Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Sales, Service, Finance and HR, as well as enterprise applications, system integrations, infrastructure and business process improvement.

Working closely with the Manager, Agile Delivery, business stakeholders, Steering Committees, technical teams and vendors, the IT Project Manager is responsible for planning, managing and delivering projects that achieve their intended business outcomes. All work is completed in accordance with the DST PMO project management model, governance standards and controlled templates.

**Key Responsibilities/Areas of Accountability**

* Manage multiple concurrent projects end to end, from initiation and charter through stage gates, Go/No-Go, go-live, hypercare and closure.

* Work with sponsors and business stakeholders to define scope, success criteria, deliverables and expected benefits.

* Understand the business processes behind each project, such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, plan-to-produce and record-to-report, and make sure solutions support how the business operates.

* Build and maintain integrated project plans that reflect dependencies, critical paths and resource needs. Track progress and re-forecast proactively when conditions change.

* Coordinate project teams across Business, IT, Operations, Engineering and Finance, bringing technical, process and people workstreams together into one coherent plan.

* Help bring unclear or stalled work back on track by clarifying scope, ownership and next steps.

* Manage vendor and partner engagements, including Statements of Work, onboarding, knowledge transfer and deliverable quality.

* Maintain project governance, including RAID registers, decision logs, Project Status Updates and Steering Committee reporting, using the governance profile appropriate to project size and risk.

* Identify and manage risks and issues, and escalate them in a timely way with clear impacts and recommended actions.

* Manage project financials, including budgets, forecasts and variance reporting.

* Engage Architecture, Information Security, Financial Controls/ITGC and Audit/SOX requirements where applicable.

* Coordinate testing, cutover and business readiness activities, and partner with business and change leads on training and communication to support adoption.

* Apply Agile, Waterfall or Hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate to the work.

* Support peers and project team members by sharing experience, and contribute to continuous improvement of PMO practices, templates and lessons learned.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related field.

* 5+ years of IT project management experience with a proven track record of delivering projects on time, on budget and to agreed scope.

* Experience delivering projects across multiple business functions, such as Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Sales, Service and Finance.

* Solid understanding of end-to-end business processes and how enterprise systems support them.

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and vendors, including aligning competing priorities and resolving issues.

* Experience working with global or distributed teams across time zones.

* Experience managing third-party vendors, including SOWs and deliverable management.

* Strong working knowledge of project governance, including stage gates, RAID management, status and Steering Committee reporting, and financial tracking.

* Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Strong planning, organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

* Working knowledge of Agile and traditional delivery methodologies.

* Proficiency with tools such as Planview, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, Excel and Microsoft 365/Teams.

**Assets**

* Experience delivering ERP projects (for example, BaaN, AX, Dynamics, or Oracle) across modules such as supply chain, procurement, sales, finance or manufacturing.

* Experience with supply chain and operations solutions, such as planning, procurement, inventory, warehouse management, logistics or MES.

* Experience with sales and service solutions, such as CRM, configure-price-quote (CPQ), e-commerce, field service or aftermarket systems.

* Experience with finance solutions and integrations, such as financial close, accounts payable/receivable, banking or tax systems.

* Experience with system integrations, infrastructure or application rollouts across multiple sites or regions.

* Experience applying Audit/SOX and ITGC controls within project delivery.

* Project management certification, such as PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, CSM/PSM or equivalent.

  
  
  

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

jobs.title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Automation & Test Automation
  
  

* Lead the design and build of scalable automation and test automation solutions across applications, APIs and services.

**Qualifications**

The Regional Delivery Executive (RDE) is a senior professional with deep (15+ years) program delivery experience. The purpose of this role is to ensure top-notch delivery. This means consistently meeting our customer commitments by grasping their needs. The Regional Delivery Executive must have the right qualifications, experience, and business knowledge. They will manage several large and high-risk projects and programs. These projects will involve various business units and service partners. They will also span across organizations and national borders. This position has a high level of responsibility and exposure within Company, the industry, and our market leading customers. They are a senior professional with an entrepreneurial mindset and business acumen as needed for this complex role.

They Improve Knowledge Management In The Company. They Share Lessons Learned From Collaboration, Portfolio, And Program Work. They Also Develop Best Practices To Ensure Delivery Excellence. There Are 3 Focus Areas Of The Regional Delivery Executive:

* Prevention: A champion for Delivery Excellence and Adoption through Continuous Improvement programs:

**Key Responsibilities & Tasks**

* Drive and supports the adoption of Clean Core and SAP AI

**Delivery**

* Oversee the delivery of multiple projects related to successful engagement or program execution.

**Sales and Business Development**

Professional Training & Certification

Agivant Technologies is a fast-paced, AI-first IT services company helping clients design, build, and scale autonomous solutions by combining deep engineering expertise with modern AI, cloud, and data capabilities. We move quickly, wear multiple hats, and expect our leaders to be builders first.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on, technically strong
**Engineering Director**
to lead our engineering organization from Pune. This is not a pure people-management or project-management role—we want a builder and solutioner who stays close to the technology, architects and troubleshoots alongside the team, and brings real, practical experience with AI systems.

You will lead a high-performing team, drive delivery excellence across client engagements, and act as a trusted technical voice for clients in a startup environment where priorities shift quickly and hands-on ownership matters more than process for its own sake.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Leadership & Solutioning**

* Personally architect, review, and troubleshoot complex solutions alongside the team rather than delegating every technical decision.
* Apply AI systems (LLM, agentic, and ML-based approaches) to client solutions and internal productivity.
* Set technical direction and standards across development, testing, and cloud administration.
* Stay close to execution details when needed, including code reviews, design reviews, and production issues.
* BFSI domain: strong background in banking, financial services, or insurance, including an understanding of regulatory, security, and compliance needs.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Recruit, onboard, and retain top talent across development, testing, support, and cloud administration while building a culture of continuous learning and growth.

**Delivery Excellence**

* Own the full product development and maintenance lifecycle for client projects and establish a robust quality assurance process.
* Drive adoption of efficient engineering practices such as Agile and DevOps.
* Deliver measurable productivity gains through AI-led tooling and ways of working.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Translate client business objectives into technical roadmaps and hands-on solution designs.
* Proactively identify opportunities to add value through AI-driven and autonomous solutions, new technologies, or process improvements.
* Treat revenue and account growth as a core part of client engagement alongside technical delivery.

Requirements

**Must-Have Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  10 to 15 years overall, including proven hands-on technical experience as an Engineering Manager or Director.
* **Technical Depth:**
  Strong track record of architecting, building, and troubleshooting complex systems.

  Strong background in banking, financial services, or insurance, including knowledge of regulatory, security, and compliance requirements.

**Description**
*Great People Work Here.*
BizTX: Co-Creating WOW Through Digital Innovation
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be part of BizTX at Twinings Ovaltine. At the heart of this iconic brand, we’re on a mission to drive exponential growth and productivity through cutting-edge technology to transform the business globally.
  
  
We’re not here to simply provide IT services. We’re technology leaders and strategic partners, co-creating innovative solutions that help the business run, grow, and transform. Everything we do is guided by our commitment to ‘WOW’ our consumers, customers and colleagues. WOW experiences, WOW solutions, and WOW impact.
  
  
Our people think differently. We have an exponential mindset that helps us push boundaries and shape what’s next. The future at Twinings Ovaltine is full of possibility and we’d love you to be a part of it.
  
**Role Purpose:**
To create one clear infrastructure roadmap across cloud and hosting, networks, workplace, site and manufacturing technology, resilience and automation as well as roadmap into a prioritised, funded programme of projects and lead delivery from business case and initiation through execution, go-live, benefits realisation and transition to operations.
  
**Scope:**
Global infrastructure strategy, standards, operational performance, site infrastructure and end-to-end delivery of the infrastructure project portfolio.
  
  
**Travel:**
Occasional international travel required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve the Global Infrastructure Strategy and Roadmap, aligned to business priorities and the BizTX technology strategy.
* Own the end-to-end global infrastructure project portfolio, including demand intake, prioritisation, business cases, funding, resource planning, delivery governance and benefits realisation.
* Translate the roadmap into a sequenced annual and multi-year project plan covering cloud, hosting, networks, workplace, sites, manufacturing and operational technology (OT), resilience, lifecycle and automation.
* Ensure every project has clear sponsorship, accountable project leadership, scope, outcomes, architecture, budget, resources, milestones, dependencies, risks and stage-gate approvals.
* Lead infrastructure portfolio reviews and provide concise executive reporting on project health, budget, schedule, risks, decisions, capacity and benefits.
* Hold direct accountability for infrastructure operations, lifecycle, resilience, investment planning and project delivery across UK and India sites.
* Directly lead the UK Site Infrastructure Lead and India Site Infrastructure Lead(s), setting clear priorities, objectives, accountabilities and performance expectations.
* Remotely lead the UK site infrastructure agenda from India through a structured operating cadence covering service performance, site risks, lifecycle, investment and project delivery, supported by effective UK on-site capability and targeted travel when required.
* Provide functional leadership to site infrastructure leads in all other geographies. Local leads retain direct reporting to geography leadership but take functional direction from this role on infrastructure strategy, standards, architecture and governance.
* Define and drive global infrastructure standards and guardrails across network, hosting and cloud, workplace, meeting rooms, site and manufacturing operational technology (OT) infrastructure, resilience, monitoring, lifecycle and automation.
* Monitor adoption of global standards, govern justified exceptions, identify technical debt and agree remediation plans with geography and site leadership.
* Ensure local infrastructure investments and projects align to the global roadmap and architecture, avoiding unnecessary local variation while accommodating justified regulatory, manufacturing or business needs.
* Provide senior accountability for the capacity, availability, recoverability and performance of the global infrastructure estate, including proportionate disaster-recovery testing for critical services.
* Own infrastructure operating expenditure (Opex) and capital expenditure (Capex) planning, forecasting, investment cases, project financial control and benefits realisation.
* Build an automation-first capability using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automated provisioning, patching, monitoring, recovery validation and AI-assisted diagnostics.
* Build a connected global infrastructure community across directly managed and dotted-line teams, developing engineering, commercial, programme and delivery capability.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

* 10+ years in enterprise infrastructure, including significant leadership responsibility in a complex, multi-site or global organisation.
* Proven ownership of a multi-year infrastructure strategy, investment roadmap and complex transformation portfolio.
* Strong knowledge of cloud and hybrid hosting, enterprise networks, workplace and site infrastructure, observability, resilience and disaster recovery.
* Experience managing significant operating expenditure (Opex) and capital expenditure (Capex) budgets and strategic suppliers or shared-service organisations.
* Commercial strength, with the ability to translate technical complexity and risk into clear investment and sourcing decisions.
* Credibility with senior leaders and the ability to lead globally through influence, matrix relationships and partners.
* Proven ability to lead geographically distributed teams remotely, combining direct line management with functional leadership through a matrix operating model.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, including concise executive reporting.
* Experience of infrastructure in manufacturing and operational technology (OT) environments.

**Desirable:**

* ITIL 4, PRINCE2, PMP or equivalent practical experience.
* Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS) or relevant cloud qualifications; familiarity with FinOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Understanding of Zero Trust, technology controls and recognised security frameworks.
* Lean, Six Sigma or equivalent continuous-improvement experience.
* Background in consumer goods, FMCG or manufacturing.

**Benefits**

* Monthly phone bill maximum reimbursement limit is Rs.3000.
* Annual check-up for employee and spouse including Doctor consultation - reimbursement up to INR 15,000.
* Medical Insurance 5 lakhs Flat Coverage.
* PF and Gratuity.
* Long Service Policy.
* Life Term Policy
* Monthly Broadband Bill Reimbursement - Rs.2000 or on actual whichever is lower
* Access to LinkedIn Learning
* Access to ABF Networking, connect, collaborate, and grow across the ABF Group.

jobs.description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

  

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

  

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

  

**About the role**

You will be the technical lead on Solace opportunities across Indian government bodies, public sector undertakings and the country's largest enterprises, working with Account Executives, system integrators and channel partners.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Be a trusted advisor, not just a demonstrator

* Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies and drive deals to closure.
* Educate customers on event-driven architecture (EDA) and agentic AI, and challenge them to think bigger about their real-time data and AI strategy.
* Guide customers on integration patterns and modernization strategies, including the convergence of EDA and multi-agent AI systems.

  

Build champions and relationships

* Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and CTOs to CIOs, department heads and programme officers, and turn users into advocates.
* Run on-site visits, regular check-ins and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving needs.
* Translate the Solace platform, from Event Broker to Agent Mesh, into outcomes customers care about.

  

Own technical validation and proof of value

* Lead demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proofs of Value (PoVs) that map to customer objectives, including tender-mandated PoCs and bid-stage technical presentations.
* Own the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials and technical validation.

  

Government and public sector engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across central and state government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), regulators, defense and strategic establishments, smart-city programmes and government-owned platforms, typically alongside system integrators and channel partners.

* Translate programme requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as citizen and agency services, transport and aviation operations, logistics and sustainment, command-and-control style situational awareness, and real-time data exchange between departments.
* Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh and Agent Mesh for on-premises, private-cloud and air-gapped deployments, including constrained or intermittently connected sites, and for hybrid deployments across state data centers and Indian cloud regions.
* Speak credibly to Indian security, data and compliance expectations, including MeitY cloud empanelment and GI Cloud (MeghRaj) hosting, the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, CERT-In directions, and sector rules such as RBI and SEBI requirements where public sector banks and market infrastructure are involved.
* Support government acquisition motions: respond to RFPs, RFIs and Expressions of Interest, write technical bid volumes and compliance matrices, handle pre-bid queries and corrigenda, and work within tender portals, GeM, GFR procurement norms and L1 and QCBS evaluation models.
* Understand Make in India public procurement preferences and local-content requirements, and help partners position Solace within them.
* Enable system integrators, OEM partners and channel partners (for example, national and global SIs with large public sector practices) so they can qualify, architect and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.
* Align Solace with national modernization priorities such as Digital India, data-centric and interoperable platforms, open standards, and responsible AI adoption.

  

Large enterprise engagement

Lead technical engagements with India's largest enterprises, where scale, resilience and regulatory pressure make real-time event infrastructure a board-level topic.

* **Banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI):** real-time payments and transaction flows, market data distribution, core banking modernization, fraud and risk signals, and AI agents for operations and customer service, within RBI, SEBI and IRDAI expectations on resilience, outsourcing and data localization.
* **Telecom and digital platforms:** real-time provisioning, recharge and balance events, customer 360 and channel modernization at very high volumes.
* **Aviation and transport:** airport and airline operations, flight and baggage events, and partner data exchange across heavily siloed ecosystems.
* **Manufacturing and energy:** plant-to-cloud event meshes, IoT and MQTT connectivity, supply chain visibility and Industry 4.0 programmes.
* **Logistics and retail:** shipment and fleet tracking, order orchestration and omnichannel inventory events.
* Help enterprises evolve beyond batch and request/response integration, and move from legacy middleware (IBM MQ, TIBCO, ESBs) towards a distributed, event-driven enterprise that can support real-time AI.
* Work with global system integrators and consulting partners that run large Indian enterprise transformation programmes.

  

Evangelise event-driven architecture

* Show deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns: publish/subscribe, event sourcing, CQRS, event streaming, and choreography versus orchestration, applied to real Indian enterprise and government architectures.
* Articulate the business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences: faster time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI applications on a live data fabric.
* Position Solace Event Brokers against Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, TIBCO and cloud-native brokers, and against locally hosted open-source deployments that customers often start with. Be ready to explain where multi-protocol support, hybrid and multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation, and to defend total cost of ownership in L1-driven evaluations.
* Guide customers through an EDA maturity model, from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a distributed, event-driven enterprise ready for real-time AI and autonomous systems.

  

Solace Agent Mesh subject matter expert

* Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production-grade foundation for agentic AI, bridging event-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Show how Agent Mesh extends an existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI and shortens time-to-production for AI initiatives.
* Explain horizontal scalability, fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging and governance to technical teams and executives, including how agents can run with models and data kept inside the customer's own or sovereign environment.
* Develop use cases where real-time event triggers drive autonomous agent actions: banking operations and service, airport and airline disruption handling, supply chain and plant operations, citizen service workflows, and public infrastructure monitoring.
* Serve as the field voice for Agent Mesh adoption in India, feeding real use cases and objections back to Product and GTM teams.

jobs.title: Head of Banking & Payment Partnerships
jobs.description:
**Who we are**
We are a global wealth-tech company powering the next generation of trading. We deliver cutting-edge centralised trading solutions and robust B2B financial infrastructure. Our proprietary trading platform offers clients seamless access to stocks, ETFs, bonds, futures, options, swaps, funds, and currency pairs- all within a single, multi-currency account.
  
  
We believe in the boundless flow of capital and information. Whilst developing EXANTE, we saw technology as a means to improve global connectivity of the financial services industry. Over the years, we have earned a reputation for providing superior service and for getting the results our clients and customers want.
  
  
Most importantly, people have come to know us for our technological insights and focus on privacy. Our inspiration stems from the talent and ambition of our clients. We are offering an ecosystem of financial products and services that would provide the most tailored assistance to traders.
  
  
**Our culture**
Everything at EXANTE starts with our people. We bring together almost 800 minds across 70 locations. We place trust in our team with real autonomy - the freedom to drive change across products, processes and everything in between. That trust fuels innovation, and the demands of the markets build resilience; we adapt, push forward, and we look after each other while we do it.
  
  
That freedom is matched by real investment in growth: we back our people with ongoing learning, hands-on development and the kind of stretch opportunities that turn good careers into great ones.
  
  
**The Role Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Head of Banking & Payment Partnerships to lead the development, expansion and management of EXANTE’s global banking and payment partner network.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on role with end-to-end responsibility for establishing and maintaining strategic relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
You will play a critical role in strengthening our banking infrastructure, diversifying counterparty relationships, optimising commercial terms and ensuring reliable banking and payment services that support our international business and clients.
  
  
Working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams, you will combine strong industry relationships, commercial negotiation skills and operational expertise to build a resilient, cost-effective and scalable banking network.
  
  
**Reporting Line**
— Chair Of Executive Committee
  
  
**Worksite**
— Remote
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and expand our global banking network: Identify, evaluate and establish new relationships with banks, payment service providers and e-money institutions across key jurisdictions, including Malta, Cyprus, the UAE and Mauritius, supporting EXANTE’s international growth and operational needs.
* Own the end-to-end counterparty lifecycle: Lead the entire process from initial engagement and commercial negotiations through due diligence, onboarding, account opening and ongoing relationship management, ensuring timely and successful execution.
* Drive commercial value: Negotiate competitive banking and payment terms, including transaction fees, interest on client balances, credit facilities, account conditions and service levels, with a focus on cost optimisation and long-term value.
* Manage and strengthen strategic partnerships: Build trusted, sustainable relationships with existing banking partners through regular engagement, proactive issue resolution and ongoing management of compliance requirements, account restrictions and service performance.
* Lead banking due diligence and onboarding: Coordinate complex KYC, AML and regulatory due diligence processes, working closely with internal Compliance, Risk and other stakeholders to address counterparty requirements and facilitate successful onboarding.
* Ensure operational readiness and resilience: Partner with Finance, IT and Operations to establish effective banking and payment processes, including account structures, payment connectivity, transaction flows, reconciliations and contingency arrangements.
* Optimise counterparty diversification and performance: Monitor banking relationships, service quality, costs and counterparty concentration, identifying opportunities to mitigate risks, improve efficiency and strengthen the resilience of our banking infrastructure.
* Drive cross-functional execution and reporting: Collaborate with senior leadership and teams across the business to prioritise banking initiatives, manage multiple onboarding projects and provide clear visibility of partnership pipelines, commercial outcomes and emerging risks.

**What You Will Bring**
- Extensive relevant experience: At least 8 years of experience in banking relationship management, treasury, payment partnerships or financial institution coverage, ideally within a brokerage, fintech, payment institution, e-money business or financial services environment.
  
  

* Established banking network: Strong, active relationships with banks, financial institutions and payment providers, ideally across key international markets, including Europe, the UAE and other relevant jurisdictions.
* Proven track record of establishing banking partnerships: Demonstrable success in securing new banking relationships, opening corporate and client-money or safeguarding accounts, and establishing payment solutions for regulated financial services businesses.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills: Experience negotiating banking fees, interest arrangements, credit facilities and service agreements, with the ability to demonstrate measurable commercial improvements and cost efficiencies.
* Deep understanding of banking due diligence: Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, regulatory requirements and financial institution onboarding processes, particularly for businesses operating across multiple jurisdictions with complex international client bases.
* Knowledge of banking and payment infrastructure: Solid understanding of banking operations, client-money arrangements, payment flows and relevant payment systems, such as SWIFT, SEPA, local payment rails and banking APIs.
* Excellent stakeholder and relationship management skills: Ability to engage confidently with senior banking executives, compliance and risk teams, internal leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, building credibility and maintaining productive long-term partnerships.
* Strong execution and project management capabilities: A proactive, structured and results-oriented approach, with the ability to manage multiple complex banking initiatives simultaneously and drive them through to completion.
* International financial services exposure: Experience supporting brokerage or financial services businesses with international client bases, particularly across European, CIS or Middle Eastern markets, would be a strong advantage.
* Communication skills: Fluency in English, with excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills

EXANTE is a global prime broker backed by proprietary technology and dedicated service. All regulated group companies and fully controlled affiliates and subsidiaries are committed to compliance with data protection laws, including the GDPR. We process personal data in line with the GDPR principles of fairness, purpose limitation, transparency, data minimisation, storage limitation and deletion, accuracy, confidentiality and integrity, and accountability. We rely on legitimate interests to assess and manage your application, after determining that our interests are not overridden by your rights and interests. You have the rights of access, rectification, data portability, erasure, restriction of processing, and objection to processing. To exercise your rights or contact our Data Protection Officer, please see our GDPR policy at https://exante.eu/
