jobs.title: Lead Architect/Senior Associate Director
jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – RCT**
**Manager – Data, Cloud & AI Engineering**
**Manager – Technology Consulting**
**Experience: Strictly 8+ years**
**Mandatory eligibility:**
Candidates must have 8 or more years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. Candidates below 8 years or without any mandatory capability are not eligible.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Lead the delivery of data, cloud, and AI-enabled Financial Crime solutions for global financial services clients. This Manager role combines technical depth with delivery leadership, stakeholder management, team development, and end-to-end ownership. The successful candidate will shape solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, review critical designs, resolve delivery risks, and assure quality.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with strong Python and advanced SQL capability, practical cloud and AI delivery experience, and broad Financial Crime Compliance knowledge. The role owns outcomes from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment, transition, and production stabilization. It also includes team leadership, work planning, governance, financial oversight, client communication, and development of reusable assets and delivery standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Financial Crime technology workstreams, programs, or managed-service outcomes.
* Own solution scope, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, quality, resource needs, and stakeholder commitments.
* Provide technical direction for Python applications, advanced SQL solutions, cloud architecture, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and AI components.
* Translate KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud requirements into scalable technical solutions and delivery roadmaps.
* Partner with compliance SMEs, product owners, architects, engineering teams, data teams, model-risk stakeholders, QA, infrastructure, and operations.
* Lead design reviews, code and SQL quality reviews, architecture decisions, defect triage, performance tuning, release readiness, and production stabilization.
* Ensure appropriate security, privacy, auditability, explainability, data lineage, model governance, monitoring, and regulatory-control considerations.
* Drive automation, reusable components, engineering standards, knowledge assets, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.
* Prepare and present status, decisions, risks, dependencies, and recovery plans to senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Support proposals, solutioning, effort estimation, staffing, capability development, and account growth activities.

**Deliverable ownership**

* Accountable for agreed deliverables, acceptance criteria, delivery schedule, quality, and business outcomes across assigned workstreams.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans covering requirements, design, data readiness, engineering, testing, deployment, transition, and support.
* Establish governance routines, delivery metrics, RAID management, change control, escalation paths, and executive reporting.
* Validate estimates, capacity, sequencing, dependencies, and release scope; act early on slippage, quality gaps, or unresolved decisions.
* Ensure traceability from business and compliance requirements to technical design, test evidence, deployment artefacts, and operational handover.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and secure timely sign-offs from business, compliance, technology, model-risk, security, and operations stakeholders.
* Own defect closure, production-readiness checks, go-live decisions, warranty support, and lessons learned for assigned deliveries.

**Team management and leadership**

* Lead multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, data engineers, analysts, QA professionals, and domain specialists.
* Define team structure, roles, goals, operating model, work allocation, and individual accountability for delivery outcomes.
* Provide regular coaching, technical mentoring, feedback, recognition, and career-development support.
* Monitor capacity, utilization, skills coverage, onboarding, knowledge transfer, succession needs, and delivery continuity.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, quality-focused environment with clear standards for ownership and communication.
* Resolve delivery conflicts, remove blockers, manage escalations, and support sound decisions under competing priorities.
* Identify capability gaps and create targeted upskilling plans across Python, SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime domain knowledge.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Python: Strong hands-on experience designing and reviewing production-grade Python solutions, including object-oriented design, data processing, APIs, testing, logging, exception handling, security, and performance optimization.
* Advanced SQL: Expert-level capability in complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, stored procedures, query optimization, large-volume analysis, reconciliation, data profiling, and investigation queries.
* Cloud: Mandatory delivery experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP, covering solution design, deployment, data services, security, monitoring, integration, scalability, and operational support.
* AI: Mandatory practical experience delivering AI or machine-learning capabilities, including generative AI or predictive analytics, model or prompt evaluation, API integration, responsible AI controls, security, explainability, and production monitoring.
* Engineering leadership: Ability to guide architecture, review code and designs, define standards, oversee CI/CD, manage non-functional requirements, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Data and integration: Experience with data pipelines, APIs, batch processing, data quality, lineage, metadata, and integration across enterprise platforms.

**Mandatory Financial Crime domain knowledge (2 or more mandatory)**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators and typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, regulatory reporting concepts, and control effectiveness.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario and rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning, back-testing, false-positive reduction, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, screening effectiveness, and data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, transaction and event analysis, rules or models, alert prioritization, investigation workflows, case outcomes, and prevention controls.

jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Manager – Control & Compliance**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support. We are looking for a professional to join EY FAAS, having expertise across the FAAS solutions and specifically for engagements related to Process and Control, Process compliance and reviews, SOX and, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Enterprise Risk Management & Payment application.
  
  
FAAS is a dynamic group of people focused on helping our clients solving tomorrow’s problems today through integrated solution service offerings in the area of risk, such as internal control assessment, risk management and financial controls. Risk continues to move up the agenda and our team work with many of today's front-running companies. Our clients want integrated, strategic, tech-enabled, end-to-end solutions and we deliver tailored risk offerings putting client value and relationships at the core of what we do. You can expect to work with senior client personnel and drive high quality work products.
  
  
Our Risk team consists of talented colleagues who invite you to bring your natural curiosity and innovative thoughts to work each day. Working within our team, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We offer excellent career development, diverse opportunities and fantastic work life balance including hybrid working. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated manager to join our dynamic Control & Compliance team. The ideal candidate will bring technical expertise in risk management, internal control assessment and implementation of internal control framework. In this role, you will lead the delivery of high-quality outcomes across a portfolio of clients in the internal audit and internal controls space. You will manage multiple engagement teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, taking full ownership of projects and relationships. Your focus will be on delivering impactful results, on time, within budget and in line with EY’s quality and risk management practices. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Client Delivery and Project Management: Lead and manage multiple client engagements. Oversee planning, fieldwork and reporting of findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ensuring high-quality deliverables, on time within budget.
* Technical Expertise: Act as a key trusted advisor in discussing complex regulations with clients, including UK Corporate Reform, US Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, Global Internal Audit Standards and other industry-specific regulatory compliance requirements.
* Quality and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with EY’s quality and risk management processes across client acceptance, contracting and engagement delivery. Proactively identify and manage risks across engagements, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and proactively manage client expectations to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines and deliverables. Collaborate cross-functionally with other EY service lines and subject matter experts to deliver high quality insights. Collaborate with internal leader/s, provide regular updates on engagement progress and support internal decision-making through clear communication and proactive escalation and the ability to flex communication styles.
* Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and coach junior team members through effective supervision to develop their technical and professional skills. Support career development through performance reviews and providing timely, regular and actionable feedback. You will contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism toward work challenges.
* Business Development: Build the EY brand through high quality delivery. Support in the identification of new opportunities and development of proposals. Build EY’s market presence through contribution to thought leadership and client events.
* Promoting EY’s values: Champion EY’s commitments to integrity, respect and teaming in all client and internal interactions. Foster an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
* Practice development: contribute to practice development and internal initiatives such as learning and development programmes and solution development.

**Skills And Experience**
You will be a trusted manager with proven technical expertise in risk, control and compliance that will complement our teams in delivering high-quality solutions to our clients. Your skills and experience will include:
  
  

* Control & Compliance experience: Proven and relevant professional experience across core process and controls solutions (e.g. internal audit, SOX and internal controls) in consulting, government or industry. Extensive experience in process mapping, walkthroughs, risk analysis (strategic, financial, operational and compliance) and control identification and design assessment. The ability to act as a trusted advisor to clients on risk and control issues, such as controls remediation or Enterprise Risk Management.
* Technical skills and knowledge: In depth understanding of core business processes, associated risks, and leading practice controls. Strong leadership and communication skills, technical knowledge, and the ability to write at a publication quality level in order to communicate findings and recommendations to clients. Strong business acumen, including the ability to compile information quickly and accurately, and to test data and assumptions for informed decision-making.
* Engagement management: Track record demonstrating success in leading high-performing teams, mentor junior staff and foster a culture of continuous learning. Experienced in managing complex project and multiple stakeholder groups including senior clients and internal leadership. Demonstrated ability to balance project management and delivery skills across a range of clients, including financial management, quality, and risk management requirements.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. Being an active listener, having self-awareness when dealing with others, and adapting your own approach to differences in individual style and backgrounds, recognising the risk of unconscious biases.
* Client delivery: Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions on time and within budget with a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
* Commercial acumen: Commercially aware, with a track record of developing relevant propositions and sales collateral and supporting business development efforts.

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. In this role at PwC, you will oversee Azure and AWS Databricks initiatives, bring banking industry knowledge to solution design and delivery, and contribute to work that focuses on data pipelines, analytics platforms, and modern cloud data environments.

jobs.title: Manager, Tax Process Strategy & Solutions
jobs.description:
The Tax Process Strategy & Solutions Manager supports process leads and the Tax Practice to understand how one or more product(s) fit into the overall “vision” for one or more business area(s). The goal of this role is to drive long-term scalability and sustainability of the business for a competitive advantage. To execute their area of responsibility, this role collaborates with staff, the tax practice, product teams, IT, other functional areas within the broader RSM firm, and field offices to ensure we achieve the vision cohesively and effectively.

You will play a key role in the build-out and continued improvement and stewardship of our process and technology for US individual and trust/estate taxation.

The ideal candidate will be a self-directed problem solver with an ownership mindset and will have: (a) extensive experience independently preparing and reviewing complex Form 1040 and 1041 tax returns, as well as having handled and advised on diverse issues and complexities (federal, state and foreign) arising from ownership of complex flowthrough (partnership, S-Corporation) operating businesses, real estate entities, fund of funds, hedge funds and private equity; and (b) played a key hand in technology, tax research, process improvement or workpaper standardization initiatives: whether at the practice, region or market level, or within the context of one or more large or complex engagements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

* Collaborates with process leads and Tax practice SMEs to understand how products fit into the overall "vision" for one or more business area(s).
* Acts as primary internal functional process owner/SME for how assigned third party or custom developed solutions are used in tax engagement team processes, maintaining expertise on products through their lifecycle, developing an in depth understanding of user experience and needs by partnering with tax professionals.
* Works with process leads, Change Management, and practice leaders to establish usage and product-related targets; assesses performance against these targets.
* Understands the long-term strategy of how the products fit into the overall digital ecosystem and end user process (e.g., assists with process-related deliverables, such as process mapping and business requirements).
* Partners with practice leaders and SMEs to understand, analyze, and prioritize business needs for providing requirements to BAs and product teams for custom developed solutions or for enhancement requests to vendors.
* Responsible for end-user product documentation/content including user guides, knowledge docs, and training materials.
* Leads efforts to improve internal processes, controls, and procedures through documentation, validation, and testing.
* Partners with tax practice subject matter experts in the development and maintenance of tax content within and between applications.
* Designs and develops workpapers, data mappings, and other tax specific deliverables and content within applications, actively using expertise in accounting, tax, and the tax engagement lifecycle.
* Elicit, gather and define business needs and prioritize functional business requirements with BAs
* Conduct tax research on tax technical topics and determine process implications
* Maintain currency of integrations with other solutions and assists in the pertinent testing
* Coordinates with RSM product team or vendor to understand new features/functionality and works with Change Management, process leads, and business teams to socialize the timing of new capabilities and how they fit into end-to-end process.

Candidates must have 8 or more years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. Candidates below 8 years or without any mandatory capability are not eligible.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Lead the delivery of data, cloud, and AI-enabled Financial Crime solutions for global financial services clients. This Manager role combines technical depth with delivery leadership, stakeholder management, team development, and end-to-end ownership. The successful candidate will shape solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, review critical designs, resolve delivery risks, and assure quality.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with strong Python and advanced SQL capability, practical cloud and AI delivery experience, and broad Financial Crime Compliance knowledge. The role owns outcomes from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment, transition, and production stabilization. It also includes team leadership, work planning, governance, financial oversight, client communication, and development of reusable assets and delivery standards.

* Own defect closure, production-readiness checks, go-live decisions, warranty support, and lessons learned for assigned deliveries.

**Team management and leadership**

* Lead multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, data engineers, analysts, QA professionals, and domain specialists.
* Define team structure, roles, goals, operating model, work allocation, and individual accountability for delivery outcomes.
* Provide regular coaching, technical mentoring, feedback, recognition, and career-development support.
* Monitor capacity, utilization, skills coverage, onboarding, knowledge transfer, succession needs, and delivery continuity.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, quality-focused environment with clear standards for ownership and communication.
* Resolve delivery conflicts, remove blockers, manage escalations, and support sound decisions under competing priorities.
* Identify capability gaps and create targeted upskilling plans across Python, SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime domain knowledge.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Python: Strong hands-on experience designing and reviewing production-grade Python solutions, including object-oriented design, data processing, APIs, testing, logging, exception handling, security, and performance optimization.
* Advanced SQL: Expert-level capability in complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, stored procedures, query optimization, large-volume analysis, reconciliation, data profiling, and investigation queries.

**Assistant Director – Treasury (EY GDS)**

  

**Role Overview**

The Assistant Director – Treasury will lead core treasury middle-office operations, including reporting, compliance, and risk monitoring, while supporting selected financial planning activities. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, cross-functional collaboration, and a focus on process automation to enhance hedging effectiveness, economic yield, liquidity management, and capital protection.

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Performance & Exposure Reporting: Monitor and report global foreign exchange (FX) exposures and outstanding hedges. Provide timely exposure updates to the Front Office
* MIS & Policy Compliance: Prepare management information system (MIS) dashboards covering FX, investments, and liquidity. Monitor compliance with investment policies and applicable regulatory guidelines.
* Monthly & Quarterly Close: Manage monthly close activities for derivative mark-to-market (MTM) valuations and related charges, investments, and borrowings. Lead quarterly close deliverables, including portfolio and economic yield reporting, accounting yield reconciliation, investment register maintenance, other income analysis, and contributions to the Quarterly Treasury Report
* Cross-Functional & Tax Optimization: Support internal requirements related to advance tax, accounting, and EDPMS. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to optimize tax, accounting, and economic outcomes
* Financing, Ratings & Structuring: Support external financing and banking arrangements across entities, as required
* Process Automation: Drive automation of recurring treasury workflows and reporting processes to improve efficiency and consistency

  

**Time Allocation & Additional Scope**

* 75–80% Middle Office: Core treasury reporting, valuations, close processes, exposure monitoring, and compliance.
* 20–25% FP&A and Process Automation: Support financial planning and analysis (FP&A) alignment and process automation, as required.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Education: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
* Experience: At least 8 years of experience in corporate treasury

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

jobs.title: PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

**Our Mission:**

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.

You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.

You will assist the PMO Director in monitoring time entry compliance in ServiceNow — reviewing entries and narratives for accuracy and routing corrections through the Project Manager and the engineer's resource manager, who are responsible for their team's accuracy.

And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.

Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. Success here takes exceptional attention to detail, the willingness to hold peers to a standard, and sound judgment about which calls are yours and which belong to the Project Manager.

**Opensity is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Employment decisions at Opensity are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, discipline, and termination.

Opensity is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities, for pregnancy related conditions, and for sincerely held religious beliefs, in accordance with applicable law. We do not tolerate retaliation against individuals who raise concerns or participate in an investigation related to equal employment opportunity.

**Recruitment Scam Notice:** Please be aware of fraudulent recruitment activity. Opensity will never ask candidates to provide credit card information, banking details, or payment of any kind as part of the interview or recruitment process. If you receive a communication that appears suspicious or does not come through an authorized Opensity channel, please verify its authenticity before providing any personal information.

**Job Title:** Financial Accountant  
**Experience:** 3+ years  
**Industry:** Engineering Consulting / Manufacturing / Project Management Company / EPC

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented **Account Manager** with at least **3 years** of experience in managing banking operations, personal accounting, and international trade (import/export). The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in **Bank Guarantees**, **Personal Accounting**, and **Import & Export documentation and compliance**. You will be responsible for managing financial records, ensuring regulatory compliance, and acting as the liaison between internal stakeholders and external financial institutions.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

**1. Bank Guarantees & Financial Instruments**

* Manage the full lifecycle of **Bank Guarantees** (issuance, renewal, cancellation).
* Work closely with banks to handle **Letters of Credit (LCs)**, **Standby LCs**, and **foreign remittance processes**.
* Ensure all financial instruments are in line with internal policies and regulatory standards.

**2. Personal Accounting**

* Oversee personal financial planning, expense tracking, investment reporting, and tax preparation for key stakeholders or directors.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in personal records, assets, and liabilities.
* Handle payments, credit card reconciliations, and property-related financial records.

**3. Import & Export Management**

* Prepare and review all documentation related to imports/exports including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and shipping instructions.
* Liaise with customs agents, freight forwarders, and banks for timely clearance and compliance.
* Monitor currency fluctuations and advise on cost impacts.

**4. Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and MIS reports.
* Analyse variances in budgets vs. actuals and recommend corrective actions.
* Support cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

**5. Vendor and Client Account Management**

* Maintain up-to-date records of receivables and payables.
* Ensure timely invoicing, collections, and vendor payments.
* Reconcile customer and vendor accounts regularly.

**6. Taxation & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with **GST, TDS, Income Tax, Customs Duties**, and other local and international tax laws.
* File statutory returns on time and support audits by internal and external authorities.
* Liaise with CA firms, legal advisors, and consultants as required.

**7. Banking & Treasury Operations**

* Handle all bank transactions including fund transfers, FD management, and online banking.
* Maintain strong relationships with banking partners to support financial needs.
* Monitor daily cash positions and support investment decisions.

**8. Internal Controls & Audit Support**

* Implement and maintain robust internal controls over financial transactions.
* Prepare documents and respond to internal, statutory, or external audit requirements.
* Ensure all transactions are properly documented and authorized.

**9. Coordination with Cross-Functional Teams**

* Work closely with logistics, procurement, legal, and sales teams to ensure end-to-end transaction support.
* Provide financial insights and data support for business decisions and planning.

**10. Technology and System Support**

* Use accounting software efficiently for bookkeeping, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Recommend and help implement automation or ERP tools for improving financial processes.

**Educational Qualification:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Finance or any related field.

**Office Timing:**  
10:30 AM to 7:30 PM / Flexible timing (Second and Fourth Saturday Off)

**Office Location:**  
Lower Parel West, Mumbai 400013

**Kindly share your updated cv at hr@airotherms.com or what's app on 8291570650**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

We support clients at every stage, from first discussions and licensing strategy through launch and ongoing monitoring. Our services include:

* licensing and authorisation with the DFSA, FSRA, VARA and CBUAE
* outsourced Compliance Officers and MLROs

* Develop licensing strategies and guide clients through DFSA, FSRA, VARA and CBUAE application processes
* Review and sign off regulatory business plans, application documents and compliance documentation
* Advise clients on AML/CTF programmes, governance structures, risk-based compliance and remediation
* Build and maintain strong relationships with regulators and key stakeholders
* Coach and mentor team members and oversee the quality of their work
* Contribute to business development and help shape the firm’s services and market positioning

**Qualifications**

* In-depth knowledge of UAE financial services regulation, including the DFSA, FSRA, VARA and CBUAE frameworks

* 10+ years of experience within Risk & Regulatory Affairs, Financial Services Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, Compliance, or Enterprise Risk Management .

* Strong experience serving Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking, Investment Management, Capital Markets, or Sovereign Wealth Fund clients.
* Deep knowledge of:
* Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
* Regulatory Compliance
* Governance Frameworks
* Operational Risk
* Conduct Risk
* Internal Controls
* Operational Resilience
* Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA)
* Compliance Monitoring Programs
* Regulatory Change Management
* Experience interacting with regional regulators and working knowledge of ADGM, DIFC, SCA, CMA, QCB, CBB, and related regulatory frameworks.
* Demonstrated experience leading large-scale risk transformation and regulatory remediation programs.

Preferred / Advantageous
  
  

* Experience leading or supporting practice-building or market-entry initiatives in the region.
* Prior exposure to sovereign wealth fund advisory or Ultra-High-Net-Worth client segments.
* Familiarity with key regional WAM technology platforms and fintech landscape.
* Experience in a dual-hat role (industry leadership + external advisory) or within a captive consulting unit of a financial institution.

Core Competencies
  
  
**Leadership & Commercial**
**Technical & Domain**
▸ Client relationship management & influence ▸ WAM operating models & value chain
  
  
▸ Business development & pipeline ownership ▸ Investment products & portfolio management principles

* Intellectual rigour — ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder problems with structured thinking and creative problem-solving.

Career Progression & Opportunity

jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**
---------------

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

jobs.description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

**The Team**

Deliveroo is on a mission to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders.

Our Grocery & Retail team manages Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail businesses. We work closely with our partners and cross-functional teams to drive growth, strengthen the customer proposition and improve business performance.

As the scale and complexity of Grocery & Retail continues to grow, the Strategy & Performance function plays a central role in setting market strategy, leading business planning, embedding strong performance management and ensuring we continue to improve the customer experience.

**The Role**

The Head of Strategy & Performance, New Verticals - Middle East is responsible for setting the strategic direction of Deliveroo's Grocery and non-food Retail business and ensuring we translate that strategy into measurable growth and performance.

This is a high-impact leadership role with significant exposure to senior local and global stakeholders, sitting at the centre of some of the most important decisions shaping the future of Grocery & Retail in the Middle East. You will work closely with the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team across strategy, business planning, performance, customer value proposition and high-priority cross-functional initiatives.

You will lead two core functions: Strategy & Performance and Category Management, setting their direction, building strong teams and bringing together data, customer insight and commercial context to determine where we should focus, what needs to change and how we deliver against our ambitions. Through Category Management, you will shape the customer proposition across key levers including conversion, selection, catalogue quality, pricing, promotions and merchandising, ensuring priorities translate into tangible improvements across the customer journey.

The role combines big-picture strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will need to be equally comfortable defining long-term priorities, diagnosing why the business is performing the way it is, influencing senior stakeholders and getting into the details to unblock complex initiatives.

You will directly manage the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager, with the wider Category Management team also sitting within your organisation.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* **Own Grocery & Retail strategy and planning:** Set the strategic direction for Grocery and non-food Retail, lead annual and quarterly planning, identify and size the biggest growth opportunities, and partner closely with Finance to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, business cases and clear targets.
* **Drive business performance:** Own the overall performance framework for Grocery & Retail, ensuring leadership understands what is driving performance and where action is required. Set the direction for WBRs, MBRs and performance diagnostics, and build a strong culture of accountability and follow-through.
* **Shape the customer proposition and Category Management agenda:** Own the overarching CVP strategy and set the direction for Category Management across key levers including selection, availability, pricing, promotions, merchandising, catalogue quality and conversion. Ensure priorities are grounded in customer behaviour, commercial performance and competitor insights.
* **Lead high-impact strategic initiatives:** Take ownership of complex, cross-functional opportunities and problems that do not naturally sit within one team, from initial diagnosis and strategic direction through to alignment, delivery and handover into BAU.
* **Lead and develop high-performing teams:** Lead the Strategy & Performance and Category Management functions, directly managing the Strategy & Performance Manager and Senior Category Manager. Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build the capabilities, tools and operating models needed for both functions to scale effectively.
* **Influence senior stakeholders and shape decisions:** Act as a strategic partner to the Director of Grocery & Retail and wider leadership team, representing Grocery & Retail in key local and central discussions and shaping decisions on the business's most important strategic priorities.

**Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, strategy, consulting, investment banking, commercial, growth or business operations, ideally in a high-growth technology, marketplace or startup environment; experience in on-demand delivery, Grocery, Retail or digital category management is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial and analytical judgement, with the ability to understand business performance, diagnose root causes and make clear recommendations grounded in data and commercial context.
* Strong ability to structure ambiguity, taking broad or loosely defined business problems, framing the problem clearly, identifying the right questions and translating them into a practical strategy and execution plan.
* Strong influencer and relationship builder, able to bring senior and cross-functional stakeholders on the journey, communicate in a way that resonates with different audiences and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.
* Proven end-to-end execution capability, including mobilising the right teams and resources, securing investment or headcount where needed, removing blockers and driving complex initiatives through to measurable outcomes.
* Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to set clear direction, develop high-performing teams, coach managers and build the capabilities and ways of working needed for teams to scale effectively.
* Strong data literacy and comfort using analytical and AI tools to accelerate analysis, problem-solving and decision-making; experience with tools such as Looker, Cursor, Claude or similar is an advantage.
